title: Senior Customer Success Manager - UK
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Constructor
description_html:
About You


You're a jack-of-all-trades with a passion for cool technology and interacting with people and making them happy. You're a self-starter who's good at triaging problems and working on the most important one. You've worked directly with customers for a long time and are comfortable being the face of the company to them. One of the things that pleases you most in life is customers successfully using your product, being thrilled with its value, and telling you they're happy they partnered with you. Further, you're a curious person, and you'd love the opportunity to work with a technology team that includes data scientists, algorithm experts, back-end and front-end engineers to expand your knowledge.

About Us

Constructor.io powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you've probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We're approximately doubling year over year despite the market slow down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical.

We're a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.

About The Position

As a Customer Success Manager, you'll be joining a rapidly growing team that helps our customers increase their revenue by improving the search and product discovery experiences of their websites and mobile apps through integrating with our services.

Your specific responsibilities will include:

  • Own the customer journey from project kick-off, launch, adoption, and ongoing value realization, ensuring customers achieve meaningful business outcomes and are delighted with the partnership.

  • Build trusted relationships across complex enterprise organizations, engaging confidently with stakeholders ranging from engineers, data and product teams to Heads and Directors of Ecommerce, Digital, Product, and Technology, as well as VP and C-level executives.

  • Understand the goals, priorities, and influence of different customer personas, and align technical and business stakeholders around a shared success plan.

  • Translate technical concepts, product capabilities, and performance data into clear business value, connecting Constructor’s work to outcomes such as conversion, revenue, customer experience, and operational efficiency.

  • Plan and lead effective QBRs and EBRs that go beyond reporting: communicate measurable impact, facilitate strategic conversations, make recommendations, and align stakeholders on priorities and next steps.

  • Identify risks, blockers, and changing customer priorities early. Lead escalations with clarity and urgency by defining the business impact, engaging the right internal teams, setting expectations, and maintaining customer confidence through resolution.

  • Advocate effectively for customer needs while exercising strong judgment about when engineering involvement is required, how requests should be prioritized, and when an alternative solution can deliver the desired outcome.

  • Use customer insights, performance data, and ecommerce best practices to provide proactive, strategic recommendations, not simply respond to requests.

  • Maintain clear success plans, stakeholder maps, account documentation, training materials, and agreed actions so that both the customer and Constructor teams remain aligned.

  • Partner closely with Account Management to support retention and growth by demonstrating value, strengthening executive relationships, and identifying opportunities to expand the partnership.

  • Continuously improve how we onboard, integrate, and support customers, sharing repeatable best practices that make our processes more scalable and the customer experience more effective.

Requirements

  • Based in UK!

  • At least three years of experience managing relationships with enterprise customers in Customer Success, Account Management, Solutions Consulting, or a similar customer-facing role.

  • Experience working with complex enterprise organizations and building trusted relationships with stakeholders ranging from technical teams and product leaders to Ecommerce Directors, VPs, and C-level executives.

  • Strong executive presence and the confidence to lead strategic customer conversations, including QBRs and EBRs.

  • Strong influencing and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to create momentum and drive progress without direct authority.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly in a fast-moving, technically sophisticated environment.

  • Experience in ecommerce, digital commerce, search, product discovery, or a related field is highly valued.


Benefits

  • A competitive compensation package including stock options

  • Fully remote team - choose where you live

  • Work from home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office

  • Apple laptops provided for new employees

  • Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year

  • Parental leave for qualified employees

  • Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact

  • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Constructor

At Constructor.io we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or affiliation in any other protected group.

How we handle your data. By submitting this application, you acknowledge that Constructor will collect and process the personal data you provide for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for this role. If you are not selected, we will retain your data for a limited period as described in our Recruitment Privacy Notice. After that period your data will be deleted or anonymized.

title: Founding Engineer

description_html:
About Share

Share is a venture-backed internet infrastructure network building Africa’s backbone. The company aggregates underutilised telecom infrastructure, fiber, subsea cables, and data centers, and provides ISPs with scalable access to bandwidth without traditional upfront costs. Through an open-access model, local internet providers can deliver dramatically faster speeds to their subscribers without raising their own costs.

The platform team builds the software that makes this work: billing, payments, subscriber management, RADIUS-based network authentication, and integrations with ISP billing systems and mobile money providers. We are replacing legacy, non-API systems with a modern API platform, and real money is already flowing through the system. This is a small, high-intensity engineering team building core infrastructure under real deadlines. You will own entire domains, not tickets.



The role

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to take ownership of the platform’s most critical technical domains: the payments pipeline (collections, revenue splitting, treasury operations), the billing engine (subscription lifecycle, cycle management, automated renewals), and the integration layer (BSS/OSS sync with partner systems). You will work directly with the CTO and a small team of engineers to ship production systems that handle real financial transactions for real ISP partners.

Non-negotiable

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in backend systems handling real financial transactions (payments, billing, ledger, or treasury)

  • Deep TypeScript/Node.js expertise. You should be able to design a NestJS microservice from scratch, not just work in one.

  • Production experience with payment gateway integrations (M-Pesa, Stripe, Adyen, or similar). You understand STK push flows, webhook idempotency, callback signature verification, and reconciliation.

  • Strong PostgreSQL skills. You can design schemas for financial data, write migrations, and reason about transaction isolation and locking.

  • Experience with event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar). You understand the difference between request-reply and fire-and-forget patterns and when to use each.

  • You ship. You can take a spec document and turn it into production code without waiting for someone to break it into small tasks.

AI-augmented engineering (required mindset)

We expect every engineer at Share to use AI tools as a daily part of their workflow. This is how we operate. Our entire project planning, specification, and documentation process runs through AI-assisted sessions. Our codebase includes AI-readable context files. We use Claude for architecture decisions, code review, spec generation, and technical writing.

What this means for you:

  • You already use AI coding assistants (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) daily and can articulate how they change your workflow.

  • You are comfortable working with AI-generated specifications and can critically evaluate them, push back where they are wrong, and extend them where they are incomplete.

  • You see AI as a force multiplier that lets a small team operate at the capacity of a much larger one. You are not threatened by it; you are faster because of it.

  • You are willing to contribute to improving our AI-assisted workflows

Compensation & Details:

  • Competitive Salary & Equity package

  • Additional Benefits

  • Paid Business Travel when needed

  • Ownership in a venture-backed early stage startup building the future of physical and digital infrastructure in Africa

title: Partner Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Rasa
description_html:
Your turn to start the conversation.

Write the future at Rasa.

Conversation. It’s the thread between our product and our people. The tool that enables us to forge relationships through compassion and expertise. To find the connection between our differences. It keeps us close together across borders and backgrounds and helps us create our shared vision.

Rasa means tight-knit. We get to the point and have the courage to ask ‘why?’. Because through relentless experimentation, passion, and vision, we’re transforming the way people interact with organizations through AI.

That’s Rasa. That’s our message.

Join us and add yours.

SUMMARY

We’re looking for a Partner Manager to join our Go-to-Market team. The person’s charter will be to expand our alliances and partner program, demonstrating clear revenue influence (pipeline created through the channel) and strong influence in closed business (i.e. through directly selling through the channel or having a partner source/or strongly influence our closed deal.) You will be reporting to the Director of Partnerships.

Full-time - 100% remote - Location: UK, Germany

  • This is a remote position, but we cannot hire anybody outside of the UK, Germany for this position.

  • Rasa can assist with work authorization (visa sponsorship) for candidates located in Germany only.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

As a Partner Manager at Rasa, you will play a pivotal role in accelerating adoption of the developer platform for enterprise AI agents. You will be the strategic centre of our partner ecosystem, moving beyond traditional channel management to build high-trust, revenue-generating alliances with leading System Integrators, digital consulting firms and technology partners.

You will act as the "connective tissue" between our partners and Rasa's internal teams. This means collaborating closely with Sales to co-sell and close complex enterprise deals, working with Marketing to drive joint thought leadership, and liaising with Product to ensure partner feedback shapes our open framework. Success in this role means not just hitting revenue targets, but cultivating a thriving community of experts who trust Rasa as the standard for building enterprise AI agents.

  • Identify, recruit, and onboard strategic partners (SIs, Consultancies, Tech Alliances) that align with Rasa’s enterprise mission, specifically focusing on firms capable of deploying complex, high-value AI transformations.

  • Own a partner-sourced revenue target; drive net-new pipeline by executing joint business plans, co-selling with internal Account Executives, and facilitating partner-led implementations.

  • Ensure partners are technically and commercially proficient in Rasa’s latest innovations.

  • Design and execute GTM campaigns—including webinars, case studies, and events—that showcase joint value propositions and generate qualified leads.

  • Serve as the internal voice of the partner; collaborate with Product to relay market feedback and with Customer Success to ensure partner-led projects meet Rasa’s high standards for deployment quality.

  • Maintain rigorous data hygiene in our SFDC system, tracking partners, enablement, certifications, deal registration, and pipeline health to forecast business growth accurately.

ABOUT YOU

You are a strategic business builder who thrives at the intersection of technology and relationships. You understand that in the world of enterprise AI, success isn't just about selling a product—it's about building a trusted ecosystem that delivers value. You have a "hunter" mentality for finding new opportunities and a "farmer" mindset for nurturing them into long-term revenue streams.

You don't just "manage" partners; you empower them. You are as comfortable discussing GTM strategy with a Practice Lead at a Global SI as you are navigating a technical conversation about LLMs with a solution architect. You are resilient, data-driven, and excited by the rapid pace of the Generative AI landscape.

We are looking for a candidate who brings:

  • You have 5+ years of experience in Channel Sales, Partner Management, or Business Development within the B2B SaaS or Enterprise Software space. Experience specifically in the AI, Data, or Developer Tool landscape is a major plus.

  • You have a history of carrying and exceeding partner-sourced revenue quotas. You understand the mechanics of co-selling and know how to drive pipeline from "hello" to "closed-won."

  • You can articulate the value of Conversational AI and LLMs to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • You are an exceptional communicator who can build credibility with C-level executives and influence stakeholders without direct authority. You write clear, compelling emails and deliver presentations that inspire action.

  • You can look at a partner’s business model and identify exactly where Rasa fits in. You are creative in structuring deals and initiatives that create "win-win-win" scenarios for Rasa, the Partner, and the End Customer.

  • You thrive in a high-growth, fast-changing startup environment. You are self-motivated, organized, and willing to roll up your sleeves to get the job done, whether that means fixing a contract or organizing a webinar.

Please keep in mind that we are describing the background that would best fit the role. Even if you don’t meet all the requirements, yet you are confident that you are up for the task, we absolutely want to get to know you!

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US

  • Flexible hours and a dedicated remote budget

  • A stipend for professional development & 6 paid education days to help you grow within your role

  • 26 days of PTO + paid sick leave + paid public holidays

  • A Macbook, and other tech to help you do your job

  • We have regular remote team events, as well as an annual company-wide offsite

  • Vitality Health (UK only)

  • Equity options

You can find more information about our benefits per location here: Rasa Perks & Benefits

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

You can find answers to FAQs from candidates about this role specifically on our Partner Manager - FAQ

ABOUT US

Rasa is the developer platform for enterprise AI agents. title: Legal Engineer - Applied AI Knowledge
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Legora
description_html:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

What you'll do

Legal AI is inventing its best practices in real time, and this role sits where that happens. You'll sit within the Legal Engineering team and work hand in hand with Product at one of the fastest-growing legal AI companies in the world, seeing new capabilities before almost anyone else, experimenting with them against real legal work, and turning what you learn into the standards a global function runs on. In a year here, you will see and vet more legal AI use cases than most people in the industry see in a career, working directly with some of the best legal engineers in the industry.

This is a judgement role, not a filing one. You'll be the person who vets the skills, workflows and use cases the function ships: testing them hands-on, separating the genuinely strong from the merely plausible, and quality-controlling practice-area workflows so that what carries the Legora name is consistently excellent. You'll research and experiment with prompting techniques and applied AI methods, author the exemplar use cases the rest of the function copies, and teach what you learn: delivering technical onboarding for new Legal Engineers in your region and broadcasting best practices to the team worldwide. And because judgement needs grounding, around 30% of your time stays on live client work, chosen for what it teaches.

Specifically, you will

• Vet the Skills Library and Legal Engineering outputs against the quality bar: review skills, workflows and use cases hands-on before they go live, and quality-control practice-area workflows for consistency.

• Research and experiment with prompting techniques, skill patterns and emerging AI methods, and turn what works into best practices the whole function adopts.

• Author the reference use cases that show what great looks like, published as the exemplars others copy.

• Work closely with the Product team on up-and-coming capabilities: early hands-on testing, the first best practices for new features, and structured feedback from real use.

• Produce materials that would support the technical onboarding and training for new Legal Engineers in your region, such as best practices to create use cases etc.

• Communicate new best practices, exemplars and platform changes to the Legal Engineering team worldwide.

• Support the flagship demos our CEO and C-suite take on stage at the industry’s biggest events: use case preparation, fixtures and rehearsal support.

• Oversee the quality and currency of the use case and skills libraries, including coordination across regions

• Spend roughly 30% of your time on live client work, selected for what it feeds back into the standards and libraries.

What you bring

You're a lawyer with real practice experience who has become genuinely technical: maybe you did a coding bootcamp, maybe you taught yourself, but either way you're the person colleagues ask how something actually works. You live in AI tools, and it shows: you can tell a strong use case from a plausible-sounding weak one, you know why a prompt underperforms before you've finished reading it, and you hold both halves of the judgement this role needs: what makes a prompt run well, and what makes a legal output substantively right rather than merely fluent. When you vet, you vet properly: line by line against the source, with the discipline to put the AI down when the job calls for your own eyes.

We're looking for

• A qualified lawyer with solid practice experience at a leading firm or in-house team, or equivalent: enough substantive judgement to vet outputs across practice areas.

• Real technical prowess: comfortable with code or scripting (a bootcamp or self-taught background counts entirely), and fluent in the mechanics of how AI tools actually behave.

• A heavy, habitual user of AI, ideally legal AI, with sharp prompt and use case discernment: able to rank a strong prompt against a mediocre one, articulate exactly why, and improve it.

• Visible pride in the craft of prompting and use case design: someone who wants to be the reference point for what good looks like.

• Rigour in review: line-by-line verification against source, and the judgement to know exactly when not to use AI.

• Comfortable running high-throughput workstreams: you triage well, keep many threads moving, and build process where volume demands it.

• Experience building skills, workflows or automations in a legal AI platform is a strong plus.

• Good to have: an M&A or wider transactional background, or deal coordination experience.

Where this role can go

This role is built to grow with the field itself. Applied legal AI knowledge barely exists as a discipline yet, and nobody accumulates evidence faster than the person vetting and testing the entire output of a global function. Do this job well and you are positioned to become one of the industry’s recognised voices on what good looks like. Inside Legora, the role is designed to grow into owning applied AI knowledge globally: the standards, techniques and systems every region operates on. Growth is subject to performance and company need, but the direction is deliberate: master the material here first, then define the standard for the industry.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: AI Strategist
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Supermodular.ai
description_html:
Who we are

At Supermodular.ai, we help enterprises navigate AI Transformation. We believe in strategy through execution.

Most organizations understand the potential of AI, but struggle to translate that ambition into real operational change. The challenge is rarely the technology itself. It is how AI fits into complex systems, workflows, and engineering organizations that have evolved over years. We believe AI transformation cannot be designed purely in strategy documents. The real strategy only emerges by building, deploying, and operating AI systems inside the organization.

That's why we work directly with enterprise IT and software teams to design and implement AI systems in real environments. This includes enabling engineering organizations to work in fundamentally new ways by introducing AI-native development practices, frameworks, and technical assets that change how teams build and operate software. It also includes building custom AI systems that unblock difficult modernization or harmonization efforts where traditional approaches have stalled.

Our team has a strong track record of building high-impact AI systems and scaling engineering teams inside complex enterprises. If you enjoy solving hard enterprise problems and turning ambitious ideas into systems that actually run in production, you'll feel at home at Supermodular.ai.

 

Your Role — AI Strategy

supermodular.ai operates through three core roles: AI Strategy, Deployment Strategy and Forward Deployed Engineering.

As an AI Strategist, you are responsible for defining the AI thesis inside the account and turning ambiguity into explicit commitments. You determine what problems are worth pursuing, where supermodular.ai should commit, how opportunities are framed and what success looks like.

Most enterprises do not struggle because they lack AI ideas. They struggle because they cannot separate meaningful transformation opportunities from noise, hype and organizational inertia. This role exists to create that clarity.

You work directly with enterprise executives, engineering leaders and operational stakeholders to identify where AI can create material leverage across systems, workflows and organizational structures. You shape the strategic direction of the engagement, define the offer and establish the boundaries of what the team commits to delivering.

Each account is led by a two-person leadership pair consisting of an AI Strategist and a Deployment Strategist. Together, you run the account end-to-end. There are no layers of managers, account coordinators or traditional consulting structures between you and the customer.

You work closely with Deployment Strategy to ensure commitments align with operational reality and can actually be executed inside the organization.

This is not a pure advisory or presentation role. You are expected to exercise strong technical and commercial judgment, drive decisions under uncertainty and create alignment across senior stakeholders in environments that are often politically and operationally complex.

You will frequently make decisions with incomplete information, competing incentives and evolving technical constraints. The role requires clarity of thought, high ownership and the ability to make strong commitments without hiding behind process.

 

What you own

  • The AI thesis and strategic direction inside the account

  • Identifying which problems are worth pursuing

  • Defining the offer, scope and success criteria

  • Positioning and executive alignment

  • Commercial shaping and commitment strategy

  • Risk management and scope boundaries

  • Translating ambiguous opportunities into executable engagements

  • Driving decision-making across senior stakeholders

  • Identifying expansion opportunities and shaping long-term account direction

  • Ensuring commitments align with operational and technical reality

 

What you bring

  • Strong understanding of modern AI systems and their practical enterprise applications

  • Ability to identify high-leverage transformation opportunities inside complex organizations

  • Strong commercial and strategic judgment

  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, high-stakes enterprise environments

  • Ability to frame complex technical initiatives in ways executives can understand and act on

  • Strong communication and executive presence across technical and non-technical audiences

  • Systems thinking across organizational structure, workflows, engineering and operations

  • Ability to challenge assumptions and drive decisions with clarity

  • High ownership, autonomy and accountability

  • Strong partnership instincts with deployment and engineering teams

  • Comfort making explicit commitments and defining boundaries under uncertainty

 

Hiring Process

Intro Interview > 2 Technical deep-dives > Culture & Offer

title: Employee Platform Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Wordsmith
description_html:
Employee Platform Engineer

Edinburgh

Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we're growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents and disconnected systems.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We're built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe and others, we're building one of the defining companies in legal AI.

Why this role is different

We treat internal IT as a product and our employees as its users, not as tickets. If your answer to a repeated problem is to do it faster by hand, this isn't the seat — and it isn't a back-room coding role either.

You'll be the engineer who builds the platform that provisions, supports and secures every Wordsmith employee, end to end. The goal is for the function to get more automated as we grow, not need more people.

The Role

You'll own onboarding, access, devices and offboarding as one connected system, and build the tooling — including coding agent workflows — that removes the manual steps at every stage. You'll be hands-on with the physical side of the job too, in the Edinburgh office.

What you'll do

  • Build a joiner pipeline that reads a new hire from Humaans, creates their identity in Okta, assigns app access by group rule, and triggers zero-touch laptop enrolment in Jamf — no manual steps

  • Build a Slack assistant, backed by a coding agent, that handles requests like “I need access to X” or “my laptop is slow” and either fixes them or routes them, resolving most without a human

  • Build a hardware vending machine for the Edinburgh office that dispenses chargers, dongles, headsets and loan laptops against an employee's identity, with stock reordered automatically

  • Write scripts and infrastructure as code that configure devices, enforce security baselines, and produce compliance evidence on their own

  • Build an offboarding flow that revokes access everywhere, wipes and reclaims the device, and files the record the moment someone is marked as a leaver

What good looks like in the first year

  • Zero-touch onboarding: within six months, a new hire's accounts, apps and access provision automatically from Humaans through Okta, and their laptop self-enrols — day one setup takes minutes, not hours

  • Self-service by default: within nine months, the top twenty employee IT requests — access, kit, resets, software — are self-served through automation, chat or a vending machine, not a ticket to a person

  • Automated joiner/mover/leaver: within twelve months, role changes and offboarding run automatically from the HRIS, with access removed same-day and hardware recovered

  • Build over buy: you ship internal tooling and coding agent workflows that remove manual steps, so the function scales on automation, not headcount

  • Secure and audit-ready: the fleet stays managed and SOC 2 evidence generates itself, rather than being assembled by hand before an audit

Who you might be

We're not hiring a traditional IT person — we're hiring someone who builds. That might mean you're:

  • a software engineer who likes owning systems end to end and wants a broad, high-ownership remit

  • a DevOps, SRE or platform engineer who automates infrastructure and wants to point that at people and devices

  • a strong IT or systems person who already codes and automates rather than clicking through consoles

  • someone from a smaller company or an MSP who has wired up tools, identity and devices and scripted the boring parts away

What matters is the instinct to automate anything you have to do twice, and to build the tool rather than do the task. We'll teach the IT domain to a strong builder — we won't teach someone to be a builder.

What we're looking for

  • You write real code and automate with APIs and scripts — Python, Bash or TypeScript. This isn't optional.

  • You think in systems: identity, access, data flows and lifecycle

  • You're comfortable using AI coding agents to build and ship tooling fast

  • You care about security and doing things properly, not just quickly

  • You're happy working on-site in Edinburgh and hands-on with real hardware

Bonus:

  • Exposure to identity and device tooling such as Okta, Google Workspace or Jamf

  • Experience with SOC 2 or security compliance

  • Having run or automated onboarding, endpoints or internal tools before

How we work

This role is on-site in Edinburgh, reporting into Security — you'll be hands-on with the actual fleet, not just its dashboards. It's a high-trust environment: you own the systems you build, end to end, with light process and a bias toward shipping.

This isn't a back-room coding role. You own real employee outcomes and the physical office setup alongside the software.

What you can expect

  • Real ownership over the platform that runs every Wordsmith employee, from identity to hardware

  • Freedom to build over buy — you ship the tooling, not just work the tickets

  • We'll teach you the IT and security domain — you bring the instinct to automate

Why Wordsmith

We're growing quickly, and every new hire adds more identity, access and devices to manage. Getting that right — automated, secure and audit-ready — is core to how fast and how safely we can scale as a company.

If you want to build the system that runs an entire company's IT, rather than staff it, this is a strong place to do it.

title: Data Compliance Administrator, Smugglers Way
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Cory Group
description_html:
At Cory, we're proud to play a key role in keeping London moving towards a more sustainable future. Every day, our teams help manage and recover valuable resources, supporting environmental goals while delivering critical services across the capital. Behind every successful operation is accurate information, robust compliance processes and people who care about doing things properly.

As a Data Compliance Administrator, you'll be at the centre of these activities. You'll support the collection, management and reporting of operational and compliance data, ensuring records remain accurate, organised and readily available. Your work will contribute directly to maintaining regulatory compliance and supporting business performance.

You'll work closely with operational teams, managers and other departments to gather information, verify data and resolve discrepancies. Whether you're updating records, producing reports, maintaining documentation or supporting audits, you'll help ensure that the business has confidence in the information it relies upon.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys combining administration, problem-solving and data management. If you take pride in accuracy, enjoy working with systems and spreadsheets, and want to make a real contribution within a growing environmental services organisation, we'd love to hear from you.


We're looking for someone with previous administrative experience in a compliance, operational, environmental, logistics or similarly regulated environment. You'll be comfortable handling large volumes of information and ensuring records are maintained accurately and consistently.

Strong Excel skills and confidence working with data are important. You'll need to demonstrate a methodical approach when reviewing information, identifying anomalies and maintaining high standards of accuracy across multiple systems.

Successful candidates will be strong communicators who can build positive working relationships with colleagues across different departments. You'll be proactive in following up outstanding information and ensuring compliance records remain complete and up to date.

Experience supporting audits, maintaining document control systems or managing compliance-related records would be highly advantageous. Knowledge of waste management, recycling, environmental compliance or related sectors would be beneficial, although not essential.

Most importantly, we're looking for someone who is organised, dependable and takes ownership of their work. You'll be motivated by doing things properly and contributing to a business where accurate data genuinely matters. Additionally, you’ll be flexible, adaptable and able to respond effectively to business changes and compliance requirements within a constantly evolving industry.

title: Creative Strategist (m/w/d) - Vollzeit, vor Ort in Lingen
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Commerce Ventures GmbH
description_html:
Du schaust auf einen Ad Account und siehst nach zwei Minuten, wo es hakt? Welcher Angle als Nächstes dran ist, welche Hook fehlt, warum der Winner gerade abbaut?

Dann lies weiter.

Wer wir sind

Commerce Ventures ist die führende Performance-Marketing-Agentur, im Food, Health und Beverage Bereich. Wir betreuen ausschließlich Brands, hinter denen wir stehen, von Gründern und Gründerinnen, die ambitioniert sind und wirklich coole Produkte entwickelt haben.

Monatlich laufen sechsstellige Meta-Budgets über unsere Accounts, und wir haben mehr als eine Brand von null auf achtstellig begleitet.

Der Hebel dahinter ist immer das Creative. Dafür haben wir ein Modell gebaut, das funktioniert: klare Prozesse, klare Zahlen, klare Verantwortung, und Leute, die liefern. Kein Agentur-Bullshit, keine 40-seitigen Decks.

Was du machst

Du übernimmst deine eigenen Brands, in kompletter Eigenverantwortung, drei bis vier Brands maximal, damit du dich voll und ganz auf die Ergebnisse unserer Kunden konzentrieren kannst.

Du übernimmst die komplette Creative Strategy, Media Buying, Kunden-Calls, Planung. Du briefst unsere Post-Production, du entscheidest, was live geht, du weißt jeden Morgen, was die Zahlen sagen und was heute zu tun ist.

Damit wir uns nicht falsch verstehen: Wir suchen keinen Strategen, der Konzepte präsentiert und andere machen lässt. Du setzt die Strategie und lieferst selbst: Angles, Hooks, Skripte, Briefings, Statics. Wer lieber Slides baut und mehr redet als macht, ist bei uns falsch.

Wie wir arbeiten

Wir sind ein kleines Team, remote aufgestellt, und trotzdem haben wir gerade unser Büro in Lingen vergrößert. Warum? Weil die Lernkurve neben Gründer und Team im Office steiler ist als in jedem Google-Meet. Wer die Rolle vor Ort macht, lernt es von denen, die es jeden Tag machen! Und bekommt JUUZ und Prepmymeal Meals im Kühlschrank obendrauf.

Heißt aber nicht, dass remote nicht geht. Wenn du gut bist und selbstständig arbeitest können wir reden. Lingen ist unser Wunsch, aber nicht die Bedingung.

Was bei uns gilt: Wir arbeiten hart, weil gemeinsam Ziele erreichen, Spaß macht!

Wir sagen uns direkt, was Sache ist. Und wir feiern, wenn ein Kunde den Umsatz verdoppelt.

Kurz, unser Motto: doing cool shit with cool people!

Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest die Creative- und Funnel-Strategie für deine Accounts: von der Analyse über den Testplan bis zum fertigen Creative.
  • Du analysierst die Ad Accounts, findest die Lücken (fehlende Angles, , schwache Hooks, schwache Landingpages) und leitest daraus konkrete Testpläne ab.
  • Du entscheidest, was als Nächstes launcht, und priorisierst nach Wirkunk und nicht nach Bauchgefühl.
  • Du schreibst Hooks, Skripte und Ad Copy selbst und baust Statics und Animations, wenn der Account sie braucht.
  • Du briefst UGC-Creator, Editoren und unsere Post-Production und challengst sie so lange, bis die Creatives performen.
  • Du führst deine Kunden-Calls selbst, präsentierst Zahlen und hast den vollen Überblick über deine Accounts (maximal drei).
  • Du iterierst Winner weiter und leitest aus den Performance-Daten die nächste Version ab.
  • Du arbeitest täglich mit Claude und Co., baust dir eigene Prompts und Workflows und nutzt AI, um schneller und besser zu liefern als der Markt.

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung als Creative Strategist, Media Buyer, Direct-Response-Marketer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle, idealerweise im D2C- bzw. E-Commerce-Bereich.
  • Du denkst in Funnels, Awareness Stages (Schwartz), Angles und Hypothesen, nicht in Branding-Kampagnen.
  • Du hast Creatives, Hooks, Skripte oder Funnels nicht nur konzipiert, sondern selbst gebaut, und sie haben performt.
  • Du arbeitest datengetrieben und schaust auf die Zahlen: ROAS, CAC, CTR, Hook-Rate, Hold-Rate.
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit KI-Tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Magnific und Co.) oder brennst darauf, sie in deinen Workflow zu bauen.
  • Du ziehst Themen eigenständig durch, lieferst sauber und gibst Gas, auch wenn keiner zuschaut.
  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Du redest nicht über Ideen, du setzt sie um.
  • Du willst vor Ort arbeiten, in Lingen (Ems) oder Umgebung.
  • Lebenslauf, Studium oder Titel auf dem Papier sind uns egal. Deine Erfahrung und Expertise zählt, sowie dein Character.

Benefits

  • Eine Lernkurve, die es so kaum irgendwo gibt: 6-stellige Meta-Budgets, direkter Draht zum Gründer, Feedback in Tagen statt in Quartalen.
  • Ausschließlich Brands, hinter denen wir stehen: Food, Health und Supplements. Keine Kunden, für die du dich rechtfertigen musst.
  • Geiles Office in Lingen, ein Ort, an dem man wirklich gerne arbeitet.
  • Neueste Hardware (Apple-Universum) und der komplette AI-Stack, den du brauchst.
  • JUUZ & Prepmymeal-Vorrat im Kühlschrank
  • Attraktives Fixum plus Performance-Bonus
  • Ergebnisse vor Anwesenheit: flache Hierarchien, kurze Wege, keine Konzern-Bürokratie.
  • Neue Arbeitskultur, positive Vibes, Hands-on statt Meeting-Marathon.
  • Die Chance, den Creative-Bereich einer wachsenden Agentur mitzugestalten und später ein eigenes Team zu führen.

Bis hierhin durchgelesen? Dann sind wir vielleicht dein Match.

Schick uns ein kurzes, ungezwungenes Anschreiben per du: Was hast du bisher gebaut, welche Creatives, Hooks oder Funnels von dir haben am besten performt, ab wann könntest du starten? Portfolio, Ad-Beispiele, Loom: immer her damit.

Bitte kein 5-Seiten-Roman mit "teamfähig und belastbar", sondern kurz und knapp zeigen, wer du bist und was du drauf hast.

Wenn du magst, nimm ein kurzes Video auf und beantworte zwei Fragen: Wer bist du? Und warum sollte man dich unbedingt im Team haben?

Danach lernen wir uns 15 Minuten kennen und schauen, ob es passt.

Ich freue mich besonders auf Leute aus Lingen und Umgebung.

Liebe Grüße,

Marek

description_html:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.


About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced and commercially minded Senior HR Business Partner to join our People & Culture team and partner closely with senior leaders across EMEA.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role for an HR professional who thrives in fast-paced, evolving environments and enjoys operating at both a strategic and operational level. You’ll play a key role in translating business priorities into people strategies that enable growth, strengthen organisational culture and deliver measurable business outcomes.

With teams across the UK, Portugal and Brazil, you’ll bring a strong understanding of working across different cultures and markets, while helping the organisation navigate transformation and change.

You’ll have the opportunity to influence leadership decisions, shape organisational design, develop talent and succession pipelines, strengthen performance management, and lead initiatives that enhance the overall employee experience.

What You’ll Do

Partner with Senior Leadership

  • Act as a trusted strategic partner to senior leaders across EMEA, providing insight and challenge on people, organisational structure, performance and workforce matters.

  • Translate business strategy and evolving priorities into practical People & Culture solutions.

  • Support leaders in making informed, people-focused decisions in a fast-moving environment.

Drive People Strategy & Transformation

  • Develop and deliver People & Culture initiatives that directly support business objectives and deliver measurable impact.

  • Lead and contribute to organisational transformation and change initiatives across the region.

  • Identify opportunities to improve HR processes, policies and ways of working, ensuring they remain agile and fit for purpose.

Lead Core HR Processes

  • Own and support end-to-end workforce planning and headcount management.

  • Drive succession planning and talent development pipelines.

  • Lead performance management cycles, including calibration and development planning.

  • Support employee engagement, culture and organisational effectiveness initiatives.

Use Data to Drive Decisions

  • Leverage people analytics and HR metrics to identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement.

  • Turn data and insights into clear recommendations for leaders.

  • Use evidence-based approaches to continuously improve people processes and employee experience across diverse teams.

Coach & Develop Leaders

  • Provide hands-on coaching to leaders on effective people management, feedback, performance, conflict resolution and leadership development.

  • Help leaders build high-performing, inclusive teams and foster a culture of open communication and continuous improvement.

Collaborate Across People & Culture

  • Work closely with Talent Acquisition, People Development, Compensation & Benefits and Culture teams.

  • Ensure HR policies, programmes and practices are aligned, consistent and responsive to the needs of the business and our people.

What We’re Looking For

You’ll bring:

  • Proven experience in an HR Business Partner, People Partner or strategic HR role, ideally within an organisation experiencing significant growth, transformation or change.

  • A strong track record of partnering with senior leaders in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

  • A hands-on approach, with the ability to move confidently between strategic thinking and operational delivery.

  • Strong experience across performance management, talent development, succession planning and organisational culture.

  • Excellent commercial and strategic thinking, with the ability to understand business priorities and translate them into effective people solutions.

  • Experience working across different countries, cultures and organisational contexts within EMEA.

  • A strong analytical mindset, with experience using people data, HR metrics and reporting to inform decisions and improve processes.

  • Exceptional communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.

  • The ability to build trusted relationships at all levels and confidently challenge and coach senior leaders.

  • A proven ability to operate effectively through ambiguity, change and evolving organisational priorities.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working within a technology, startup or high-growth environment.

  • Experience leading organisational transformation or change management initiatives across multiple regions.

  • Knowledge of Portuguese would be an advantage.

 
Collaboration is our superpower, diversity unites us, and excellence is our standard. 
We value diverse identities and life experiences, fostering a diverse, inclusive, and safe work environment. We encourage applications from diverse and underrepresented groups to our job positions.

Bei uns erwartet dich ein vielfältiges Aufgabengebiet, bei dem du Verantwortung in der Gestaltung und Umsetzung von IT-Infrastrukturprojekten bei unseren Kunden übernehmen kannst. Dabei ist es dir auch wichtig, dich einzubringen, mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln? Dann stehen dir alle Türen offen und unser Team freut sich über deine Unterstützung.

Aufgaben

  • Verantwortung für die Umsetzung von IT-(Teil-)Projekten sowie Beratung unserer Kunden in Hinblick auf unsere Services
  • Betreuung der Bereiche Server, Storage, Netzwerk und IT-­Security sowie von Projekten im IT­-Admin-­Umfeld
  • Installation und Administration von Microsoft Servern­ und Microsoft/Apple- Clientsysteme (physisch und virtuell) unserer Kunden sowie Analyse und Fehlerbehebung
  • Konzeption und Pflege aller Dienste eines Windows-­Netzwerkes
  • Auswahl, Beschaffung, Installation und Dokumentation der IT-­Systeme gemäß Kundenauftrag
  • KEINE Helpdesk-Tätigkeiten (1st und 2nd Level), dafür haben wir ein zentrales Team

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung bzw. Studium
  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung als Systemadministrator (bestenfalls in einem IT­-Systemhaus)
  • Mindestens gute Kenntnisse in der Microsoft 365 Umgebung
  • Gute Kenntnisse in Netzwerktechnologien (LAN, WAN, VLAN, VPN)
  • Umfassende Erfahrungen in größeren IT-Umgebungen mit den gängigen Windows Server-und Clientbetriebssystemen
  • Gute Kenntnisse in Virtualisierungstechnologien von Hyper­V (oder VMware/Proxmox)
  • Umfangreiche Erfahrungen in der Microsoft Cloud - Microsoft 365, Azure, SharePoint, Teams, Intune etc. wünschenswert
  • Idealerweise Erfahrungen mit alternativen Betriebssystemen (z.B. Linux)
  • Gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten, auch in Präsentationen gegenüber Kunden
  • Ausgeprägte Service­ und Kundenorientierung
  • Hohe Motivation, Kommunikationsfähigkeit, sicheres Auftreten sowie Teamfähigkeit

Benefits

  • Unbefristeter Vertrag, attraktives Gehaltspaket, Mobile Office oder gerne im Team im modernen Büro
  • Regelmäßige Schulungen und Weiterbildungen sowie die Möglichkeit, dich mit Technikern anderer Standorte auszutauschen

title: Senior PR Manager (m/w/d) - Freelance
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at getpress
description_html:
Overview

PR steht vor einem strukturellen Bruch. Vertrauen verschiebt sich, Sichtbarkeit wird neu verteilt, KI wächst exponentiell. Wir bei getpress glauben, dass Reputation in den nächsten zehn Jahren der entscheidende Wettbewerbsvorsprung für Unternehmen wird. Und dass die Agentur, die das ernst nimmt, anders aussehen muss als die Agentur von gestern.

Deshalb bauen wir die PR Company der Zukunft. Outcome-getrieben statt Retainer-Stunden. KI-first statt KI-on-top. Automatisiert, wo es skaliert und menschlich, wo es wirklich zählt. Unser über 40 köpfiges Team aus Journalist*innenund PR-Strateg*innen hat seit 2017 die PR für 450+ der spannendsten Wachstumsunternehmen Europas gesteuert – und hat Hunger auf mehr.

Für Phasen, in denen unser Pipeline-Tempo schneller ist als unsere Teamgröße, bauen wir uns einen festen Pool erfahrener Freelancer*innen auf. Bist du dabei?

Deine Rolle

  • Verstärkung im Team, nicht allein auf Distanz: Du arbeitest gemeinsam mit dem zuständigen PR-Team an einem oder mehreren Mandaten, nicht isoliert für dich allein. Die Kundenkommunikation läuft über das Team, mit dem du regelmäßig im Kontakt stehst und dich austauscht.
  • Klare Ziele, eigenständige Umsetzung: Team und Kunde geben Ziele und die Zielmedienliste vor – wie du deinen Teil einbringst, entscheidest du. Du entwickelst Storys, pitchst Journalist*innen und bringst dich aktiv ins Team ein.
  • Skalierbar für dich: Ein Pilotprojekt ist der Einstieg. Läuft die Zusammenarbeit für beide Seiten gut, begleitest du je nach Bedarf und deiner Kapazität gerne auch weitere Mandate parallel.

Wer du bist

  • Mehrjährige, wirklich eigenständige PR- oder journalistische Erfahrung.
  • Du bringst ein aktives, belastbares Netzwerk zu Journalist*innen mit, keine Kontaktliste aus der Vergangenheit, sondern Redaktionen, mit denen du heute noch sprichst.
  • Du deckst mindestens eine unserer Kern-Verticals ab (z. B. VC, Mobility, Cleantech, HealthTech) und weißt, wie die jeweilige Medienlandschaft tickt.
  • Du bist mit ergebnisbasierter Vergütung vertraut oder offen dafür.
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, kannst auch auf Englisch professionell kommunizieren.

Was dich erwartet

  • Klare Konditionen von Anfang an: Du bekommst einen Rahmenvertrag mit transparenter Umsatzbeteiligung – wir legen Zahlen offen auf den Tisch, nicht erst im dritten Gespräch.
  • Kein Vertrag ohne Mandat: Die Unterschrift des Rahmenvertrags verpflichtet dich zu nichts. Erst wenn wir ein passendes Mandat für dich haben, sprechen wir konkret über Kunde, Ziele und Zielmedien – und du entscheidest, ob es passt.
  • Unkomplizierte Zusammenarbeit: Kein Mikromanagement. Ein Kick-off und danach je nach Bedarf regelmäßigen Austausch mit dem Team – so, wie es für euch beide funktioniert.

Wie gehts weiter?

Wenn du jetzt denkst: „Klingt nach spannend!", dann melde dich bei uns , ganz ohne klassisches Anschreiben. Wir sprechen offen über Themen, Netzwerk und Konditionen, damit für beide Seiten schnell klar ist, ob es passt.

description_html:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials for energy, infrastructure, and construction in wholesale and beyond.

We trade with global suppliers and distribute to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade and distribution end-to-end: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, and embedded financing. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier; for our partners, it is the most convenient and safe way to do business across borders. Behind it, our software and agentic AI do the heavy lifting that used to take an asset-intensive supply chain with four or five intermediaries and weeks of manual coordination.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover

  • Seven European markets live

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), offices in London, Mumbai, and Shanghai

$40M Series B just closed, $75M raised to date from Atomico, Project A, and Inven Capital, institutional financing from international banks.

We are building the world's first and last industrial-grade AI operating system for materials, redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

What You’ll Do

Dive in as the strategic force behind our post-sales customer journey, transforming satisfaction into a powerful engine for growth. As a key player in a nimble, high-impact team, you'll own the customer experience for the DACH market, shaping processes and driving initiatives that directly enhance customer lifetime value and accelerate our market expansion.

  • Architect and implement a best-in-class post-sales strategy for the DACH market, serving as the expert for all customer-related initiatives and elevating their lifetime value.

  • Proactively identify and resolve complex customer challenges, utilizing creative problem-solving to ensure customer satisfaction while leveraging insights to drive improvements.

  • Design, champion, and operationalize highly scalable processes that enhance customer experience, working in tandem with other internal teams to ensure operational excellence.

  • Manage end-to-end post-sales journeys, including onboarding, claims handling, and delivery issues, to ensure the successful resolution of customer queries, whether large or small.

  • Drive critical cross-functional alignment with Tech, Logistics, and other departments, ensuring customer insights directly inform roadmaps.

  • Execute high-touch, multi-channel communication, engaging directly with customers via phone and email to resolve inquiries and provide a premium support experience.

Who You Are

You're a hands-on and execution-driven individual contributor with a proven track record of shaping outcomes in fast-paced environments. As a vital member of a small team, you're ready to make a significant impact on our customer success architecture and contribute directly to our disruptive mission in the DACH market.

  • You are enrolled in a university or have recently graduated and you are looking to gain work experience in a fast paced venture backed environment (minimum 6 months).

  • Deeply curious and passionately aligned with the vision of hyper-growth startups, eager to contribute to scaling.

  • You are motivated and passionate about new ideas and possess a creative solution oriented mindset.

  • Excellent analytical and communication skills in German and English. C1 German is required for this role.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

title: Backend Engineer - Data & Orchestration
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Melotech
description_html:
Who we are

Melotech is revolutionizing media and entertainment. We create art through technology for humans to enjoy. In just 24 months, our work has been heard, watched and loved for over 3 billion minutes worldwide.

Founded by entrepreneur and investor Soheil Mirpour, we are backed by top VCs Cherry Ventures, Speedinvest and GFC, alongside world-class angels from firms such as Spotify, Blackstone and KKR.

What you will do

Everything we ship runs on data, and the systems that collect, move and store that data need an owner. As Backend Engineer - Data & Orchestration, you take a data platform that grew fast and turn it into one system the whole company can rely on. You keep it running, you keep it clean, and you make it simpler every month. This is not a pure ETL or warehouse role: you work across the pipelines and the backend services they depend on. We will walk you through exactly what we are building as you go through the process. On a typical day, your tasks may include:

  • Data collection: keeping our scrapers and platform integrations running across flaky sources, rate limits, anti-bot measures and APIs that change overnight

  • Pipelines and storage: owning our event-driven pipelines end to end, from orchestration (Airflow, Dagster or similar) to databases and warehouses, built to survive failures and to keep costs in check

  • Monitoring and reliability: building the monitoring and alerting (Datadog or similar) that keeps our services and integrations healthy, and the checks on freshness, volume, schema and values that catch a wrong number before anyone downstream notices

  • Backend services: working on the production services and APIs our data flows through, including our JavaScript backends

  • Infrastructure and security: owning CI/CD, infrastructure as code and cloud for our data systems, plus access and secrets: who and what can reach which system, including AI tools

  • Simplification: consolidating what grew fast into one documented system, and removing what is no longer needed

  • Working across the team: explaining what the data can and cannot do to non-technical colleagues, and guiding junior engineers as the team grows

Who you are

We are looking for an engineer who runs what they build, and builds things that keep running. You have operated real production systems in a small, fast-moving company, and people trust you with them.

Typically, your profile will look like this:

  • Experience: 3 to 10 years of hands-on engineering, most of it in small or fast-growing companies where you owned production systems yourself rather than handing them to a platform team

  • Python and backend: advanced Python, including async code and long-running data jobs, and enough backend experience to work on production services and APIs, including basic JavaScript or TypeScript backends

  • Scraping and data acquisition: you have kept unreliable external sources running in production (scrapers, platform APIs, unofficial endpoints) and you know how to handle proxies, rate limits and anti-bot measures; using LLMs to extract data from messy sources is a plus

  • Pipelines and storage: you have designed and run event-driven, fault-tolerant pipelines handling millions of records a day, with Airflow, Dagster or task queues, on databases such as Postgres, ClickHouse, MongoDB or Redshift, and you know what they cost to run

  • Data reliability and monitoring: your systems report their own problems through freshness, volume, schema and value checks, and you use Datadog or an equivalent to keep services and integrations reliable, because a wrong number that nobody noticed is the outcome you design against

  • Infrastructure and security: you are comfortable with Docker, Terraform, CI/CD and cloud, and ideally you have run an access review and set up role-based access and secrets management

  • Ownership and communication: you have owned a messy data setup end to end at a smaller company and left it simpler, documented and maintainable; you explain trade-offs to non-technical colleagues, push back when it matters, and have guided junior engineers or led a small team

  • Engineering fundamentals: you learned to build solid systems before AI coding tools were everywhere, and today you use them to go faster, not to replace that judgment; you ship fast, keep the codebase clean, and take the time to understand the context before you build

  • Pace: you thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment

What makes this exciting

Our data systems feed everything the company does, and you own them outright. You are not maintaining someone else's legacy: you decide how these systems should work and you make them work that way. You're not a cog in the machine but the captain of your own ship, rewarded for performance and respected for leadership. Flat hierarchies mean that your voice matters, your ideas get implemented, and your impact is immediate.

We pay competitive salaries and make you an owner of the business with equity. We work remotely to give you complete freedom over your life, while meeting regularly around the world for global offsites where we strategize, bond, and push boundaries together.

What the process will look like

We hire on a rolling basis. Earliest starting date is always ASAP.

Once you begin our process, you can progress from start to offer within a week, depending on how quickly you can move through each stage:

  1. Initial interview: 30-minute introductory call - getting to know you

  2. Case interview: 90-minute case discussion - present and debate your skills

  3. Founder interview: 90-minute interview with our CEO - going deep on all topics

  4. Offer, contract signing and onboarding

Note: As we are still in stealth, you will learn more about Melotech as you progress through the stages. By the end of the Founder interview, you will have a full grasp of our business and the details of your role.

description_html:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to provide clean, safe, and virtually unlimited energy to the world. We are rapidly scaling and looking for talented individuals who thrive in building clarity and structure within fast-growing environments.

Join us as a Control Systems Engineer and help to provide the clean energy of the future. In this role, you will lead the design and delivery of critical control systems across our experimental and production environments in Germany and the USA, and work closely with a passionate, cross‑functional team.

About the Role

You will report to the Controls Engineering Lead and join a small, collaborative team of 3–5 engineers. The role is hybrid, with the expectation of occasional travel to our Austin, TX site. Working hours follow standard business schedules, and on-call needs are minimal and largely confined to regular working hours.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the design and development of PLC-based control subsystems, supporting cutting-edge laser fusion technologies, and work in collaboration with scientists and engineers to gather requirements and iterate solutions.

  • Own the integration and control systems for critical experiment support infrastructure such as vacuum, pneumatics, and cooling plant.

  • Develop control software for modern PLCs such as Beckhoff TwinCAT in Structured Text (IEC 61131-3) for machine safety and process control systems.

  • Commission complex experimental equipment together with scientists and engineers, including field debugging and systematic fault-finding of cutting-edge technology.

  • Specify and implement SCADA systems and HMIs, including alarms, logging, data acquisition, and database integration.

  • Contribute to team standards and solution architecture, and mentor junior engineers through design reviews and guidance.

Who You Are

  • Degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Control/Automation, Mechatronics/Robotics, Physics or similar, with a focus on PLC-based control, embedded or real‑time systems.

  • 5+ years in plant control systems, factory automation, embedded software, or complex scientific experimental work with significant PLC-based elements.

  • Proficient in PLC programming in Structured Text (IEC 61131-3) following good software engineering practice, including modularization, version control (e.g. Git), and unit testing.

  • Knowledge of SCADA systems (e.g. Ignition, EPICS, Tango, WinCC, FactoryTalk, AVEVA) and hands-on experience of delivering HMIs to stakeholders, including alarm and error handling, status and data visualization.

  • Proficient in reading electrical wiring diagrams and P&IDs, collaborating with electrical and mechanical engineering teams to deliver physical systems.

  • Familiarity with industrial networking and fieldbus protocols such as EtherCAT, OPC UA, and Modbus TCP.

  • Familiarity with risk assessment processes and relevant safety standards (e.g. ISA 84, IEC 61508).

  • Clear communicator in English, comfortable working in hybrid and international cross-site teams, self-organized and proactive, comfortable leading technical discussions and decisions.

  • Practical, hands-on approach with proven experience in hardware/software integration, and a strong track record in debugging and fault-finding on real systems.

Desirable Skills and Knowledge (be sure to highlight any of the following in your application):

  • Beckhoff PLCs and TwinCAT.

  • DDS (Data Distribution Service) protocol, related tools and utilities.

  • OPC UA protocol, related tools and utilities.

  • Design of vacuum control systems.

  • Designing control cabinet hardware to EU standards (IEC 60204 -1).

  • Safety-critical systems design: safety relays, SIL determination, LOPA, risk assessment.

  • Proficiency in at least one higher-level language (LabVIEW, Python, MATLAB/Simulink, C/C++).

  • Higher LabVIEW qualifications (CLD, CLED, CLA) and NI hardware experience (PXIe, cRIO).

  • Other non-PLC embedded or real-time systems (FPGAs, RTOS, microcontrollers, robotics).

  • Experience working on complex scientific equipment or large-scale research facilities.

  • Image processing and machine vision, motion control and robotics.

About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to provide clean, safe, and virtually unlimited energy to the world. We are rapidly scaling and looking for talented individuals who thrive in building clarity and structure within fast-growing environments.

Your Role

As our Legal Operations Specialist, you will build and run the operational backbone of Focused Energy’s growing Legal function. You will own the systems, processes, records, and calendars that enable our lawyers to focus on high-value legal work across Corporate, Commercial, IP, and Compliance.

You will have broad ownership and the opportunity to build legal operations from the ground up — from corporate entity administration and contract lifecycle management to IP docketing, compliance records, workflow design, and automation. You will work independently across German and US corporate structures and become a trusted operational partner to the VP Legal and the wider Legal team.

What you’ll do

  • Build and own the legal operations backbone for a growing international company — creating reliable systems, processes, and standards that make a visible difference every day.

  • Take end-to-end responsibility for corporate administration across our German and US entities, including registers, minute books, cap tables, powers of attorney, filings, restructurings, and notarial processes.

  • Lead the contract lifecycle from signature to renewal, managing CLM and e-signature workflows, keeping agreements accessible, and ensuring no important deadline is missed.

  • Create structure across IP and Compliance, maintaining patent and trademark docketing, IP registers, compliance records, policy documentation, and key legal calendars.

  • Turn recurring legal work into scalable processes by mapping workflows, developing templates, introducing automation, and selecting tools that reduce manual effort for the whole Legal team.

  • Work directly with decision-makers and external partners, including the VP Legal, specialist counsel, Finance, notaries, registry offices, and external IP advisers.

  • Spot what needs to be done and make it happen — proactively identifying gaps, managing risks, and improving how Legal operates without waiting for instructions.

Who You Are

  • You have extensive experience in legal operations, corporate administration, paralegal work, entity management, or a comparable role.

  • You understand German corporate formalities and ideally have exposure to US corporate administration.

  • You are organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing records, deadlines, and recurring processes.

  • You have experience with contract management, e-signature, document management, or legal operations tools.

  • You work independently, improve processes, and know when to escalate matters requiring legal judgement.

  • You communicate clearly and proactively and are fluent in German and English.

Nice to Have

  • Background as a Rechtsfachwirt/in, Paralegal, or legal operations specialist.

  • Experience with CLM, entity management, e-signature, or workflow automation tools.

  • Experience in a fast-growing international company or across German and US legal environments.


Why Work with Us

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers, and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges, and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Flexibility: Work should fit around your life, not the other way around. We offer the ability to work from our office, but some flexibility to work from home as well.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide on a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.
