title: Interim Staff Systems Engineer - IT & Infrastructure (d/f/m)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Taxfix
description_html:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

 

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

 

The opportunity (Interim/Freelance basis):

As our Staff Systems Engineer within the IT & Infrastructure team, you'll be responsible for keeping the enterprise systems that power Taxfix running reliably, securely, and intelligently — from cloud infrastructure and identity management to network, device, and application performance. Reporting to our Director of IT & Infrastructure, and collaborating closely with cross-functional stakeholders across the business, you'll architect and operate the backbone that enables every team at Taxfix to do their best work. In a company that moves fast and thinks big, you'll be the person who makes sure the foundation never wobbles.

This is an interim position on a freelance basis.

 
 

Your responsibilities:

  • Maintain and operate enterprise cloud infrastructure that serves employees and internal systems, ensuring high availability, performance, and security at all times.

  • Lead and evolve identity management across the enterprise — including platform management and Okta — developing concepts and processes to govern both human and agentic identities in a scalable, secure way.

  • Support the integration of new tools and systems based on business requirements, owning the technical evaluation, onboarding, and configuration end to end.

  • Ensure enterprise systems remain up to date, with security configurations, patches, and compliance standards consistently applied across the board.

  • Maintain security backups and redundancies for enterprise infrastructure, proactively identifying and closing gaps before they become incidents.

  • Manage and improve network, device management, and systems, keeping the environment stable, modern, and fit for a growing, hybrid workforce.

  • Develop automations, AI-powered and agentic solutions, and scripts that reduce manual toil and improve the efficiency of infrastructure maintenance.

  • Provide third-level support for cloud applications, acting as the deepest technical escalation point for complex issues and enablement of internal app deployment.

  • Collaborate with SRE and platform engineering to assess risk, develop guardrails, and resolve incidents together with application owners.

  • Collaborate with the Director of IT to continuously improve the enterprise architecture and infrastructure landscape, contributing strategic thinking alongside hands-on execution.

  • Own performance tuning of application stacks, including communication and messaging between applications, load management, and components such as Apache and Ruby.

 
 

Your profile

  • You bring strong, hands-on experience in enterprise cloud administration — ideally with GCP — and know how to design, operate, and scale cloud environments that real businesses depend on.

  • You have solid practical experience with Kubernetes, containerisation, and virtualisation technologies such as Docker and VMware, and you're comfortable navigating complex, layered infrastructure.

  • Your networking knowledge is deep and grounded — TCP/IP and related protocols are second nature to you, and you can diagnose and resolve network issues with confidence.

  • You implement best practices for network security and governance, ensuring that access, segmentation, and policy controls are consistently applied and continuously improved.

  • You're proficient in at least one scripting or programming language such as Python or shell, and you use code as a tool to make infrastructure smarter and more maintainable.

  • You have hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting Google Workspace and Linux environments, and you know how to keep them healthy and secure.

  • You've set up and improved monitoring and visualisation systems, and you understand how good observability translates into faster incident response and better decision-making.

  • A background in engineering or computer science is a plus — what matters most is that you bring structured thinking and hands-on experience to make systems work together.

 
 

Why Taxfix?

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions.

  • A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

  • Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

  • 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.

  • A generous learning budget to support your personal and professional development and guidance from our internal L&D experts.

  • Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.

  • Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.

  • Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

  • Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.


Excited? So are we. Learn more about Team Taxfix on our blog and get a glimpse of our culture.

 

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves.

 

Not sure if you meet all the requirements for this role? Please apply anyway. You might bring something special to the team that we hadn't considered previously.

Please note: This role is offered on an interim/freelance basis.

title: Project Manager - Software Implementation (m/f/x)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Makersite GmbH
description_html:
Job Title: Project Manager - Software Implementation (m/f/x) 

Location: EU

(Remote) 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Project Managers who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:

  

  • Lead the planning and implementation of software projects related to system connections with our customers, ensuring they are delivered on time and within scope. 

  • Maintain and update project plans, proactively identifying and managing any project risks. 

  • Ensure the availability of the right expertise for each project phase, coordinating with internal and external resources as necessary. 

  • Manage stakeholder expectations, delivering regular and comprehensive project updates and effectively resolving any arising issues. 

  • Contribute to the standardization of project implementation methodology and project templates to improve project standardization and efficiency. 

  • Generate thorough Project/Solution Documentation, outlining project goals, deliverables, and timelines. 

  • Handle all customer communication across various projects, ensuring clear, consistent, and timely communication with all stakeholders. 


  • Master's degree in project management or related technical field required. 

  • Background in Electronics/Electricals

  • Professional Project Management Certification from an accredited institution preferred. 

  • Demonstrated understanding of Project Management processes, strategies, and methods 

  • Excellent time management and organizational skills and experience establishing guidelines in these areas for others. 

  • 3+ years of Project management experience in the field of software implementations 

  • Experience with complex data projects where a systematic approach is crucial to success. 

  • Dexterity with software tools and data manipulation & analysis 

  • A creative mind that can think outside the box. 

  • Curiosity to find disruptive as opposed to incremental solutions to challenging data problems. 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

 

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact. 

If you want to find out more about what it’s like to work at Makersite, check out our Careers Page here 

  

Diversity and Inclusion 

If you have a medical condition or an individual need for an adjustment to our process, and you believe this may affect your ability to be at your best – please let us know so we can talk about how we can best support you and make any adjustments that may be needed.  

 

At Makersite, we are dedicated to fostering an environment that champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and success, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and will consider all applications regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, nationality, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rest assured, all applications will be handled with the utmost confidentiality.

description_html:
Teamleiter Finanzbuchhaltung (m/w/d)

Übernehmen Sie Verantwortung. Gestalten Sie Prozesse. Entwickeln Sie Strukturen weiter.

25 Gesellschaften. Unterschiedliche Geschäftsmodelle. Anspruchsvolle buchhalterische Herausforderungen.

Sie arbeiten gerne strukturiert, übernehmen Verantwortung und möchten ein Team fachlich führen, während Sie gleichzeitig nah am operativen Tagesgeschäft bleiben?

Dann erwartet Sie bei uns eine Position mit Verantwortung, Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.

Als Teamleiter Finanzbuchhaltung (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie die fachliche Führung der Finanzbuchhaltung und tragen aktiv dazu bei, Prozesse, Strukturen und Standards innerhalb unserer Unternehmensgruppe weiterzuentwickeln.

Das bieten wir Ihnen

  • Attraktive Vergütung zwischen 60.000 € und 66.000 €, abhängig von Erfahrung und Qualifikation

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

  • Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle

  • Modern ausgestatteter Arbeitsplatz und hochwertige IT-Ausstattung

  • Monatliches Mitarbeiterfrühstück

  • Wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur

  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege

  • Verantwortungsvolle Rolle mit fachlicher Führungsverantwortung

  • Möglichkeit, Prozesse und Strukturen aktiv mitzugestalten

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Fachliche und organisatorische Führung der Finanzbuchhaltung

  • Operative Mitarbeit in den Bereichen Debitoren-, Kreditoren-, Hauptbuch- und Anlagenbuchhaltung sowie Zahlungsverkehr

  • Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Tagesgeschäfts und einer hohen Datenqualität

  • Vorbereitung und Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB

  • Weiterentwicklung, Strukturierung und Digitalisierung bestehender Prozesse

  • Unterstützung bei der Einführung und Optimierung von Standards innerhalb der Finanzbuchhaltung

  • Ansprechpartner für Steuerberater, Wirtschaftsprüfer und interne Fachbereiche

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung, Controlling und Finanzleitung

  • Mitwirkung bei Auswertungen, Reportings und finanzwirtschaftlichen Fragestellungen

Ihr Profil

  • Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise mit Weiterbildung zum Bilanzbuchhalter (m/w/d) oder vergleichbarer Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Finanzbuchhaltung

  • Erste Führungserfahrung oder der Wunsch, den nächsten Karriereschritt zu gehen

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse im HGB sowie im Bereich Abschlusserstellung

  • Sicherer Umgang mit DATEV und MS Office

  • Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise

  • Kommunikationsstärke, Teamorientierung und Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen

Warum diese Position spannend ist

Diese Position richtet sich an Fachkräfte, die nicht ausschließlich verwalten, sondern aktiv gestalten möchten.

Sie übernehmen Verantwortung für die Finanzbuchhaltung einer wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe, arbeiten eng mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen zusammen und erhalten die Möglichkeit, Prozesse, Strukturen und die Zusammenarbeit innerhalb des Teams nachhaltig weiterzuentwickeln.

Wenn Sie eine Aufgabe suchen, bei der Sie fachliche Verantwortung übernehmen, operativ mitwirken und gleichzeitig Veränderungen vorantreiben können, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

title: Lead Full Stack Engineer (Berlin)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at GeneralMind
description_html:
GeneralMind builds AI Systems of Action for complex enterprise workflows. We deploy AI employees that automate messy operational handovers across supply chains - processing orders, validating invoices, coordinating suppliers, and handling exceptions directly on top of enterprise systems like SAP, Oracle, JDE, and Dynamics.

Our platform combines AI agents, operational context graphs, and real transaction data to achieve Autopilot-grade automation in real operational environments. We work closely with leading global companies across manufacturing, retail, and logistics to deploy AI into mission-critical workflows.

Tasks

  • Design, build, and evolve production-grade full-stack applications using Python (FastAPI) and React (Next.js).
  • Architect and develop next-generation interfaces for our Systems of Action, enabling seamless human-in-the-loop interactions and complex data visualization.
  • Build durable backend workflow systems using tools like Temporal to support asynchronous AI agent execution.
  • Improve reliability, observability, and operational tooling across both client and server applications.
  • Integrate with enterprise systems such as ERP platforms (SAP, Dynamics, etc.) and external APIs, surfacing that data intuitively on the frontend.
  • Scale multi-tenant systems, database architectures (PostgreSQL), and platform abstractions.
  • Work closely with product and forward-deployed engineering teams to translate real customer problems into cohesive end-to-end features.

Requirements

  • Strong full-stack engineering fundamentals and production experience owning end-to-end feature delivery.
  • Deep experience with React and modern frontend ecosystems, coupled with a strong eye for user experience and interface design.
  • Deep experience with Python and distributed / backend systems.
  • A strong ownership mentality and systems thinking - you care just as much about UI state management as you do about backend database query optimization.
  • Ability to design reliable, observable, maintainable systems.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving startup environments.
  • Clear communication and sound engineering judgment.
  • Excitement about AI-native software development and agentic systems.

Join GeneralMind as a Lead Full Stack Engineer! Drive innovation in AI, transform enterprise workflows, and grow with us. Be part of a team shaping the future of business automation!

title: Quality Assurance Engineer (Berlin)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at GeneralMind
description_html:
GeneralMind is a Berlin-founded AI company building its own System of Action for modern enterprises: an operational AI layer on top of ERP systems. This is not a copilot. It's an autopilot: human-supervised, with approvals where needed. Our AI Autopilot autonomously executes recurring, complex workflows end-to-end across email, Excel, and enterprise systems. Incoming tasks are captured, analyzed, and completed with human-level capability, tracking handovers, meeting deadlines, and ensuring compliance across multiple stakeholders. Designed for mid-sized and large enterprises, GeneralMind helps organizations eliminate inbox-driven work, improve execution across goods and money flows, and keep supply chains moving at scale. Founded in 2025, GeneralMind serves customers across industry, commerce, and logistics in Europe and beyond.

Tasks

  • Test the platform from a real user's perspective, running through both typical flows and the unusual ones ("what happens if I enter the wrong thing?").
  • Track down bugs, crashes, display issues, and illogical behaviour, and document them clearly with steps to reproduce.
  • Judge whether features work the way they should, and flag anything confusing, clunky, or inconsistent (usability).
  • Check different devices, browsers, and screen sizes to make sure everything works everywhere.

description_html:
Du willst Systemadministrator Linux nicht einfach administrieren, sondern selbst entscheiden, wie eine moderne Open Source IT Landschaft aussehen soll?🚀

Dann bekommst du hier den Freiraum dafür. Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes, familiengeführtes Technologieunternehmen aus Freiburg, das Hard- und Softwarelösungen für die industrielle Bildverarbeitung und Automation entwickelt. Die eigenen Systeme kommen heute in mehr als 15.000 Maschinen weltweit zum Einsatz.

Als Systemadministrator Linux verstärkst du einen bewusst klein gehaltenen IT Bereich und bekommst entsprechend viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Statt starrer Konzernstrukturen erwarten dich kurze Wege, direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung und die Möglichkeit, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten. 

Der technologische Fokus liegt konsequent auf Linux und Open Source. In den kommenden Jahren stehen spannende Themen an: bestehende Anwendungen sollen auf Open Source Alternativen migriert, Cyber Security und Resilience weiter ausgebaut und ein eigener interner Linux basierter KI Server kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden. 

Wenn Linux dein fachliches Zuhause ist und du lieber neue Lösungen entwickelst, als nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen zu halten, kannst du hier eine IT Landschaft langfristig mitprägen. 

Deine Benefits

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Entscheide aktiv mit, wie sich die interne IT in den Bereichen Linux, Open Source, Cyber Security, Resilience und Automatisierung weiterentwickelt.  

  • Spannende Zukunftsprojekte: Arbeite unter anderem an Open Source Migrationen, dem Ausbau der IT Security und einem eigenen internen Linux basierten KI Server.  

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Arbeite eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und profitiere von kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Freiheit bei technischen Lösungen.  

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Nutze flexible Arbeitszeiten ohne feste Kernarbeitszeit und arbeite in der Regel einen Tag pro Woche im Homeoffice. Individuell kann nach Absprache auch mehr Remote Arbeit möglich sein. 

  • 30 Urlaubstage: Profitiere von 30 Tagen Urlaub und individuellen Lösungen, wenn du darüber hinaus einmal eine längere Auszeit benötigst.  

  • Bonus: Zusätzlich zu deinem Fixgehalt erhältst du einen vom Unternehmenserfolg abhängigen Jahresbonus, der in erfolgreichen Jahren bereits bei mehreren Tausend Euro lag.  

  • Mobilität: Nutze das bezuschusste Deutschlandticket, JobRad, Firmenparkplätze, kostenloses Laden deines E Autos sowie Poolfahrzeuge für dienstliche Termine.  

  • Sport & Gesundheit: Profitiere von Hansefit, einem Boulderfelsen und einer Tischtennisplatte direkt am Standort sowie zahlreichen von Kollegen organisierten Aktivitäten wie Klettern, Mountainbiken oder Kajaken.  

  • Team & Events: Freue dich auf Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier, gemeinsame Grillnachmittage auf der Dachterrasse sowie mehrtägige Entwickler Camps, bei denen bewusst neue Technologien und Themen ausprobiert werden.  

  • Weiterentwicklung: Erhalte individuell abgestimmte Weiterbildungen und einen Mentor aus einem anderen Unternehmensbereich als persönlichen Sparringspartner.  

  • Gehalt: Jahresbruttogehalt ab 60.000 € mit Bereitschaft zur deutlichen Überzahlung abhängig von Qualifikation und Erfahrung. 

Deine Aufgaben

Als Systemadministrator Linux hältst du nicht nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen, sondern entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team die zukünftige IT-Landschaft des Unternehmens. 

  • Linux & Infrastruktur: Verantworte und optimiere die Linux Systemlandschaft sowie die zugehörige Netzwerk- und IT-Infrastruktur.  

  • Open Source: Entwickle bestehende Systeme konsequent weiter und begleite Migrationen von Standardsoftware zu geeigneten Open Source Alternativen.  

  • Virtualisierung & Automatisierung: Arbeite mit Technologien wie Proxmox, Docker und vSphere und automatisiere Prozesse beispielsweise mit Python und Ansible.  

  • Cyber Security: Entwickle Security und Resilience weiter und beschäftige dich mit technischen Anforderungen rund um NIS 2, DSGVO, CRA und TISAX.  

  • KI Infrastruktur: Betreue und erweitere den unternehmenseigenen Linux basierten KI-Server und schaffe eine sichere Infrastruktur für die interne Nutzung künstlicher Intelligenz.  

  • Technischer Support: Löse komplexere interne IT-Fragestellungen für überwiegend technisch versierte Anwender mit Schwerpunkt auf dem zweiten und dritten Supportlevel. 

Dein Profil Systemadministrator Linux

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker, IT-Systemadministrator, abgeschlossenes Informatikstudium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.  

  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung mit klarem Schwerpunkt auf Linux Administration nach Abschluss deiner Ausbildung oder deines Studiums.  

  • Sehr gute Linux Kenntnisse: Du arbeitest bereits routiniert mit Linux und möchtest dich nicht erst in das Betriebssystem einarbeiten.  

  • Solides Verständnis von Netzwerktechnik, Netzwerkprotokollen und IT-Infrastruktur.  

  • Erfahrung mit Virtualisierung oder Containertechnologien wie Proxmox, Docker oder vSphere.  

  • Kenntnisse in der Automatisierung, beispielsweise mit Python, Ansible oder vergleichbaren Technologien.  

  • Begeisterung für Open Source und Interesse daran, eine IT-Landschaft langfristig auf offenen und sicheren Lösungen aufzubauen.  

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1 Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse.  

  • Eigenständige, pragmatische Arbeitsweise und Lust darauf, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten und gemeinsam im Team neue Lösungen auszuprobieren.  

  • Kenntnisse in Nextcloud, Open Xchange, Nginx, pfSense, OpenVPN, Git oder Ceph sowie Erfahrung mit IT Security sind von Vorteil. 

Du suchst keinen Job, in dem du nur Tickets abarbeitest, sondern möchtest eine Linux und Open Source Landschaft wirklich mitgestalten? 🚀 

Sende uns deinen Lebenslauf und erfahre in einem kurzen 10 minütigen Kennenlerngespräch mehr über das Unternehmen, die IT Landschaft und die Möglichkeiten, die du in dieser Rolle hast.

title: Tech Operations Analyst - Graduate (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Distribusion Technologies
description_html:
About us

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by two leading VCs (TQ Ventures & Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Technical Operations Analyst to join our Control Room team. You will support the management of ongoing escalations and investigations, help ensure clear communication with our partners and management during issue resolution, and contribute to operational flows that keep all company products running smoothly.

What you will do

  • Operational Support: Monitor system operations daily to help maintain smooth processes across the platform.

  • Incident Management: Assist in investigating reported issues, troubleshooting errors, and helping the team resolve incidents quickly.

  • Problem Solving: Develop a deep understanding of our stack in order to perform technical investigations to identify issue root causes and support long-term fixes.

  • Data Analysis: Run database queries to gather insights, validate technical issues, and spot areas for improvement.

  • Process Support: Collaborate with senior team members on operational projects and test new internal tools.

  • Effective Communication: Manage internal and external communication effectively, collaborating across teams to ensure seamless issue resolution and clear, transparent updates.


Workplace: Berlin- hybrid; Germany- remote; Remote.


Who you are:

  • Experience: 0–2 years of experience or a relevant degree (e.g., Computer Science, IT, Business Information Systems).

  • Technical Skills: Familiarity with basic SQL queries, log analysis and database concepts; comfortable learning monitoring tools like Grafana, Prometheus, or New Relic.

  • Mindset: Curiosity to learn how complex systems work and a desire to solve technical problems.

  • Communication: Good written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical details clearly.

  • Adaptability: Comfortable working in a fast-paced tech environment and juggling different tasks.

A view into our Tech stack:

  • Tracking and analytics: Prometheus, Grafana, New Relic, BigQuery.

  • Database: PostgreSQL.

  • Project management: Jira.

Our hiring team:

Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Anh Do, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Ygor Alvarez.

title: (Senior) M&A Associate (w/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Arsipa GmbH
description_html:
Du möchtest den Wachstumskurs einer dynamischen Unternehmensgruppe durch anspruchsvolle M&A-Transaktionen aktiv mitgestalten? Dann suchen wir genau Dich, zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als:

Senior M&A Associate (w/m/d) - Berlin

Als Senior M&A Associate (w/m/d) gestaltest Du die Buy-&-Build-Strategie der Arsipa Gruppe aktiv mit und steuerst anspruchsvolle Buy-Side-Transaktionen eigenverantwortlich von der Identifikation potenzieller Akquisitionsziele bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Dabei übernimmst Du Verantwortung für Unternehmensbewertungen, Transaktionsstrukturen und Due-Diligence-Prozesse und koordinierst interne sowie externe Stakeholder. Im engen Austausch mit unserem M&A-Team, dem Head of M&A sowie unserem Management leistest Du damit einen direkten Beitrag zum weiteren Wachstum der Arsipa Gruppe. Dafür brauchen wir Deine Unterstützung!

Die Arsipa Gruppe ist eine schnell wachsende Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 90 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-&-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt – unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, People, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Steuerung von M&A-Transaktionen

    • Buy-Side-Transaktionen steuerst Du eigenverantwortlich von der ersten Analyse bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss.

    • Unternehmensbewertungen führst Du durch und entwickelst geeignete Transaktions- und Finanzierungsstrukturen.

    • Angebote und relevante Transaktionsdokumente erstellst und verhandelst Du gemeinsam mit dem M&A-Team.

    • Due-Diligence-Prozesse begleitest und koordinierst Du über die relevanten Fachbereiche hinweg.

  • Deal Sourcing & Akquisitionsstrategie

    • Potenzielle Akquisitionsziele identifizierst und analysierst Du mit besonderem Fokus auf den Health-, Safety- & Environment-Markt.

    • Geeignete Zielunternehmen sprichst Du proaktiv an und entwickelst bestehende Kontakte im Rahmen unserer Buy-&-Build-Strategie weiter.

    • Markt- und Unternehmensanalysen nutzt Du, um attraktive Akquisitionsmöglichkeiten frühzeitig zu erkennen und zu bewerten.

    • Strategische und wirtschaftliche Potenziale möglicher Akquisitionen beurteilst Du und bereitest fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen für das Management vor.

  • Projektsteuerung & Stakeholdermanagement

    • Sämtliche am Transaktionsprozess beteiligten internen und externen Stakeholder koordinierst Du eigenständig und stellst einen strukturierten Deal-Prozess sicher.

    • Eng arbeitest Du mit unserem M&A-Team, dem Head of M&A sowie CEO und CFO zusammen.

    • Externe Berater:innen steuerst Du zielgerichtet und sorgst dafür, dass die relevanten Workstreams effizient zusammenlaufen.

    • Transaktionsprozesse behältst Du hinsichtlich Zeitplan, Meilensteinen und relevanter Entscheidungsgrundlagen kontinuierlich im Blick.

Deine Startvoraussetzungen:

  • Das bringst Du mit:

    • Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Finance, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung bildet Deine fachliche Grundlage.

    • Mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung im Bereich M&A, Corporate Finance, Investment Banking oder einer vergleichbaren transaktionsnahen Tätigkeit bringst Du mit.

    • Nachweisliche End-to-End-Deal-Erfahrung, idealerweise auf der Buy-Side, ermöglicht Dir die eigenständige Steuerung von Transaktionen.

description_html:
Want a 3D Career? Join Norgine. 

At Norgine, our colleagues Dare themselves to be different and try new things, Drive to achieve their goals and beyond, and Develop themselves and their community.  

We call it the 3D career at Norgine and it offers you a fully-rounded experience with no limits.  

Bring everything about yourself that you’re proud of, whether that’s your passion for making a difference, focus on others’ well-being, or intellectual curiosity to unleash in a fast-paced environment and supportive community.  

In return, get a sense of belonging, a long-term career with ongoing development and upskilling, and a company that cares about people’s wellness as much as you do.  

Norgine: Transforming Healthcare, Backed by Over a Century of Expertise.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced Senior Brand Lead DACH (Consumer Health) who combines strategic marketing expertise with strong commercial acumen and a passion for driving growth. In this highly visible role, you will be the local ambassador for our consumer health portfolio across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, leading the development and execution of brand and commercial strategies that maximize business performance and market impact.

Working closely with cross-functional teams and key external partners, you will take full ownership of the local business, ensuring the successful implementation of global strategies while identifying and unlocking opportunities tailored to local market needs. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our brands, inspiring teams, building strong customer relationships, and delivering sustainable growth in a dynamic and entrepreneurial environment.

Requirements

Financial Management

  • Drive sustainable growth by achieving agreed sales, profit and market share targets across the Consumer Healthcare portfolio.
  • Take full ownership of the local Brand P&L, ensuring efficient resource allocation and identifying opportunities to improve profitability.
  • Deliver key business KPIs, including financial performance, forecasting accuracy, market share growth and strategic project execution.
  • Optimize marketing and commercial investments to maximize return on investment and business impact.

Commercial Management

  • Lead the commercial strategy and execution across the DACH region to deliver profitable channel growth.
  • Manage relationships with distributors, customers and third-party partners, including contract negotiations and performance management.
  • Develop and implement effective route-to-market, trade and channel strategies to ensure optimal market coverage and commercial success.
  • Drive e-commerce and digital growth initiatives in line with the global digital strategy.
  • Monitor commercial performance, identify opportunities and implement corrective actions where required.
  • Equip sales teams and external partners with the tools, insights and support needed to achieve business objectives.
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders and ensure high levels of engagement with Norgine brands.

Consumer Marketing

  • Adapt and implement global brand strategies to meet local market needs and drive market share growth.
  • Lead the development and execution of local brand and marketing plans aligned with company objectives.
  • Deliver impactful marketing campaigns from concept to execution, ensuring measurable business results.
  • Collaborate closely with media agencies and internal stakeholders to maximize brand visibility across all relevant channels, with a strong focus on digital.
  • Monitor campaign effectiveness and optimize activities based on agreed KPIs and market insights.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of market trends, consumer behaviour and competitive dynamics to identify growth opportunities.
  • Work cross-functionally with global and local teams, including Marketing, Digital, Regulatory, Supply Chain and other operational functions.
  • Contribute to annual and long-term business planning while sharing best practices to support global brand development.

SKILLS

  • Strategic mindset with a strong commercial vision.
  • Excellent leadership, decision-making and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to inspire and engage others.
  • Highly analytical, results-driven and customer-focused.
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen, including P&L management experience.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive and hands-on approach.
  • Ability to work independently while successfully leading cross-functional collaboration.
  • Adaptable, resilient and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment.

EXPERIENCE

  • Significant experience in brand marketing and/or commercial leadership roles within the Consumer Healthcare and/or FMCG industry.
  • Proven track record of delivering profitable growth, building brands and managing commercial performance.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing cross-functional teams, external partners and multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong P&L management experience with the ability to translate strategy into measurable business results.

This job description is a summary of the typical functions of the job; not an exhaustive or comprehensive list of all possible responsibilities, tasks and duties. Norgine reserves the right to change responsibilities to meet business and organisational needs as necessary. 

Benefits

Why Join Norgine?

Why Join Us? 

At Norgine, you’ll be part of an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued. You will have the opportunity to grow your career while making a meaningful impact on patients’ lives. 

Bring your curiosity, creativity, and drive — however you work best, you will find the support to succeed. 

Ways of Thinking & Working to Support Your Growth 

  • Curious, reflective, and open to different perspectives 
  • Collaborative across teams, functions, and geographies 
  • Comfortable working independently and asking questions when needed 

  

Apply via LinkedIn or through our careers page. 

This job advert summarises key responsibilities and is not exhaustive. Norgine may adjust responsibilities as needed. 

We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from all backgrounds. 

Our benefits may vary per location. Please liaise with the Norgine TA representative to obtain more information.  

If you want a multi-dimensional 3D career in a leading healthcare organisation, join us.

To help us create clear and engaging job adverts, we may use AI-assisted drafting based on an approved job description. Every advert is reviewed and approved by our recruitment team before publication to ensure it accurately reflects the role and our organisation.

title: Solution Architect - LangGraph & Agentic AI
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Belmont Lavan Ltd
description_html:
We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect with hands-on experience designing and deploying LangGraph-based AI solutions to lead the architecture of enterprise agentic AI platforms and applications.

You will work with business and technology stakeholders to identify high-value AI opportunities and translate them into secure, scalable, and production-ready architectures.

The role combines AI architecture, enterprise integration, cloud engineering, agentic AI, security, governance, and stakeholder leadership.

You will be expected to understand LangGraph at a practical level and be able to challenge architectural decisions, guide engineering teams, and ensure that AI solutions can operate reliably at enterprise scale.

Requirements

AI Solution Architecture

  • Lead the architecture and design of enterprise AI agent and agentic workflow solutions.
  • Design LangGraph-based architectures for single-agent and multi-agent applications.
  • Translate business requirements, processes, SLAs, security requirements, and technical constraints into solution architectures.
  • Evaluate architectural alternatives and document key technical decisions and trade-offs.
  • Define reusable architecture patterns for agentic AI solutions.

Enterprise Agent Architecture

  • Design architectures incorporating:
    • LLMs
    • LangGraph
    • RAG
    • Enterprise data
    • APIs and business systems
    • Workflow engines
    • Human approval processes
    • Observability
    • Security and governance
  • Define appropriate boundaries between AI reasoning and deterministic business logic.
  • Design state management, persistence, recovery, and long-running agent workflows.
  • Determine when to use single-agent, multi-agent, or conventional application architectures.

Cloud and Platform Architecture

  • Design scalable AI application architectures on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Define compute, networking, storage, API, security, and platform requirements.
  • Design architectures suitable for enterprise-scale production workloads.
  • Evaluate cloud services and AI platform capabilities based on performance, security, scalability, and cost.
  • Work with platform engineering and DevOps teams to establish deployment standards.

Integration Architecture

  • Design integration between AI agents and enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and SaaS platforms.
  • Define secure mechanisms for agent tool access and business-system interactions.
  • Design authentication, authorisation, secrets management, and access-control approaches.
  • Ensure AI-driven actions are traceable, auditable, and appropriately governed.

AI Security and Governance

  • Establish security and governance principles for enterprise AI agents.
  • Address risks including:
    • Prompt injection
    • Data leakage
    • Unauthorised tool usage
    • Excessive agent permissions
    • Inaccurate or unsafe actions
    • Sensitive-data exposure
  • Define appropriate human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Ensure solutions comply with organisational security, privacy, regulatory, and responsible-AI requirements.

AI Evaluation and Observability

  • Define architecture for AI application monitoring and observability.
  • Establish approaches for evaluating agent accuracy, reliability, latency, cost, and task completion.
  • Define appropriate logging, tracing, metrics, and alerting.
  • Establish operational processes for monitoring and continuously improving production agents.

Stakeholder and Technical Leadership

  • Work directly with senior business and technology stakeholders to define AI strategies and roadmaps.
  • Lead architecture workshops and technical design sessions.
  • Communicate complex AI concepts and architectural trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Provide technical direction to AI engineers, developers, data teams, and platform engineers.
  • Review solution designs and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards.
  • Mentor engineering teams and promote reusable AI architecture patterns.

Required Experience

  • Significant experience in solution architecture, software architecture, AI architecture, or a related role.
  • Hands-on experience designing and deploying LangGraph-based AI applications or agentic workflows.
  • Strong understanding of LLM application architectures.
  • Experience with enterprise AI/ML solutions in production.
  • Strong understanding of RAG, tool calling, agent orchestration, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
  • Strong experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns and APIs.
  • Experience with security, governance, observability, and operational requirements for production systems.
  • Strong technical understanding of Python and modern software engineering practices.

Desirable Experience

  • LangChain / LangSmith
  • Multi-agent architectures
  • Enterprise RAG platforms
  • Vector databases
  • Kubernetes
  • Event-driven architectures
  • Microservices
  • Infrastructure as Code
  • CI/CD
  • MLOps / LLMOps
  • AI security
  • Responsible AI
  • Large-scale enterprise transformation
  • Experience working directly with senior client stakeholders

# Lead / Principal AI Infrastructure Architect

## Über die Position

Wir suchen einen **Lead / Principal AI Infrastructure Architect**, der die durchgängige Verantwortung für den Entwurf, die Bereitstellung und die Optimierung der Infrastruktur für groß angelegte Workloads im Bereich Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) und maschinelles Lernen (ML) übernimmt.

Der Schwerpunkt der Rolle liegt auf der Architektur hochskalierbarer und kosteneffizienter Rechenumgebungen, einschließlich **GPU-Clustern, Plattformen für verteiltes Training, Infrastruktur für Model-Serving, Netzwerktechnik, Speicherlösungen, Orchestrierung sowie cloudbasierten KI/ML-Plattformen**.

Sie übersetzen Geschäftsziele, Service-Level-Anforderungen, Sicherheitsstandards und technische Rahmenbedingungen in robuste Infrastrukturarchitekturen. Sie evaluieren alternative Lösungen, treffen fundierte Architekturentscheidungen und stellen sicher, dass die Plattformen auf **Leistung, Skalierbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit, Sicherheit und Kosteneffizienz** ausgelegt sind.

Als technische Führungskraft übernehmen Sie die architektonische Leitung, etablieren Engineering-Standards und Best Practices, betreuen (mentoren) Ingenieure und Architekten und arbeiten eng mit Kunden und Stakeholdern zusammen, um Infrastrukturstrategien und Roadmaps zu definieren.

## Kernaufgaben

### KI/ML-Infrastrukturarchitektur

* Übernahme der Gesamtverantwortung für Architektur und Design der Infrastruktur für groß angelegte KI/ML-Systeme – vom ersten Konzept bis zur Implementierung und Bereitstellung.

* Entwurf der Infrastruktur für verteiltes KI/ML-Training, Inferenz und Model-Serving-Workloads.

* Architektur und Optimierung des gesamten Rechen-Stacks, einschließlich **Rechenleistung, GPUs/Beschleunigern, Netzwerktechnik, Speicher, Orchestrierung und Model-Serving**.

* Evaluierung von Architekturalternativen und Treffen fundierter Entscheidungen auf der Basis von Leistung, Skalierbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit, Kosten, Sicherheit und Kundenanforderungen.

* Sicherstellung, dass die Infrastrukturarchitekturen mit vereinbarten geschäftlichen SLAs, technischen Standards und betrieblichen Anforderungen im Einklang stehen.

### GPU- und Distributed Computing

* Entwurf und Optimierung groß angelegter **GPU- und beschleunigerbasierter Cluster** für KI/ML-Workloads.

* Evaluierung und Auswahl geeigneter GPU-/Beschleunigertechnologien basierend auf den Anforderungen der Workloads.

* Entwurf von Hochleistungsnetzwerken und Interconnect-Architekturen für verteiltes Training.

* Architektur von Speicherlösungen, die KI/ML-Workloads mit hohem Durchsatz unterstützen.

* Identifizierung und Behebung von Infrastruktur-Engpässen, die sich auf Training, Inferenz, Durchsatz oder Skalierbarkeit auswirken. * Optimierung der Infrastruktur hinsichtlich Leistung, Energieverbrauch, Auslastung und Kosten.

### Cloud-KI/ML-Architektur

* Fungieren als technischer Experte für mindestens eine der großen Hyperscaler-Plattformen, wie z. B. **AWS, Microsoft Azure oder Google Cloud**.

* Anwendung fundierter Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Cloud-KI/ML-Dienste, Rechenplattformen, Beschleuniger (Accelerators), Netzwerk, Speicher, Orchestrierung und Preismodelle.

* Bewertung von Cloud-Architekturoptionen und Empfehlung von Lösungen, die den Anforderungen an Workload, Sicherheit, Leistung und Kosten entsprechen.

* Entwurf skalierbarer Cloud- und Hybrid-Infrastrukturen für KI/ML-Workloads auf Unternehmens- und Großskalenebene.

* Identifizierung von Möglichkeiten zur Optimierung der Cloud-Auslastung und der Infrastrukturkosten.

### Architekturbewertung und Governance

* Leitung von Bewertungen und Überprüfungen bestehender und geplanter KI/ML-Infrastrukturumgebungen.

* Identifizierung von Architekturlücken, technischen Risiken, Leistungsengpässen, Skalierbarkeitsproblemen und Optimierungspotenzialen.

* Festlegung von Strategien zur Problembehebung und Erarbeitung technischer Empfehlungen.

* Etablierung von Architekturstandards, Mustern (Patterns) und Best Practices für die KI-Infrastruktur.

* Dokumentation von Architekturentscheidungen, Annahmen, Abwägungen (Trade-offs) und technischen Begründungen.

* Sicherstellung der Einhaltung relevanter Sicherheits-, Regulierungs-, Governance- und Kundenstandards.

### Infrastruktur-Roadmap und Kapazitätsplanung

* Definition und Pflege der Technologie-Roadmap für die KI/ML-Infrastruktur.

* Entwicklung von Kapazitätsplänen unter Berücksichtigung der Anforderungen von Geschäftsbereichen, Produkten und KI/ML-Workloads.

* Prognose des Bedarfs an Rechenleistung, Speicher, Netzwerkkapazität und Beschleunigern.

* Entwicklung von Kostenmodellen für die Infrastruktur und Identifizierung von Möglichkeiten zur Kostenoptimierung.

* Planung der technologischen Weiterentwicklung, des Workload-Wachstums und der Plattform-Skalierbarkeit.

### Automatisierung, Bereitstellung und Betrieb

* Entwurf von Bereitstellungs- und Automatisierungsstrategien für eine zuverlässige, reproduzierbare und skalierbare KI/ML-Infrastruktur.

* Etablierung geeigneter **CI/CD- und Infrastructure-as-Code-Ansätze** für KI/ML-Plattformen und -Workloads.

* Unterstützung der automatisierten Bereitstellung von KI-Systemen, Modellen und Datenpipelines in Produktionsumgebungen.

* Definition von Betriebsprozessen zur Gewährleistung von Zuverlässigkeit, Skalierbarkeit und Reproduzierbarkeit.

* Etablierung von Strategien für Monitoring und Observability über Infrastruktur- und MLOps-Umgebungen hinweg.

* Definition und Überwachung von **SLAs**.

title: AI Application Engineer - LangGraph & Agentic AI

description_html:
We are looking for an experienced AI Application Engineer to design and build intelligent applications powered by LLMs, LangGraph, and modern agentic AI technologies.

You will focus on transforming business requirements into AI applications capable of reasoning through tasks, retrieving information, interacting with tools and enterprise systems, requesting human approval when required, and completing business processes.

This role sits at the intersection of AI engineering, software development, workflow automation, and business process transformation.

Requirements

Agentic AI Application Development

  • Design and develop AI applications using LangGraph and LLM technologies.
  • Build agents capable of executing complex, multi-step business processes.
  • Design stateful workflows incorporating reasoning, tool usage, validation, approvals, and exception handling.
  • Develop single-agent and multi-agent solutions where appropriate.
  • Translate business requirements into practical agentic AI architectures.

LLM Application Engineering

  • Integrate LLMs into production applications.
  • Develop prompt strategies, structured outputs, tool calling, and context-management approaches.
  • Select appropriate models based on accuracy, capability, latency, security, and cost.
  • Develop mechanisms to improve reliability and reduce hallucinations.
  • Implement appropriate guardrails around AI-generated decisions and actions.

RAG and Enterprise Knowledge

  • Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions.
  • Connect AI applications to enterprise documents, databases, APIs, and knowledge repositories.
  • Develop retrieval and ranking strategies to provide agents with relevant context.
  • Work with embeddings and vector databases.
  • Implement data and context pipelines supporting AI agents.

Business Process Automation

  • Analyse business processes and identify opportunities for agentic automation.
  • Design AI workflows that combine LLM reasoning with deterministic business logic.
  • Build agents capable of retrieving information, making decisions, invoking tools, and completing actions.
  • Implement human-in-the-loop approval and escalation processes.
  • Ensure automated actions are controlled, auditable, and reversible where appropriate.

title: Senior Legal Counsel – Major Projects and Construction (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Vulcan Energie Ressourcen GmbH
description_html:
We want you for...

Vulcan Energie Ressourcen GmbH is an innovative, fast-growing company in the field of sustainable lithium extraction and renewable energies. With our lithium plant, we are making a decisive contribution to the decarbonization of European industry and to securing a sustainable supply of lithium in Europe. Support our dedicated team in making our vision of a climate-neutral future a reality.  

We are looking for you to join our growing team in Karlsruhe either full-time (40 hours per week) or part-time with a minimum of 32 hours per week as Senior Legal Counsel – Major Projects and Construction (m/f/d) .


Your mission

Construction & Procurement Contracts

  • You draft, review, and negotiate a broad range of project agreements, including EPCM, EPC, D&C, framework, consultancy, and other commercial contracts.
  • You advise on contractual rights, obligations, claims prevention, and effective risk mitigation strategies.
  • You support sourcing, tendering, and contracting activities, including commercial negotiations with contractors, suppliers, and strategic partners.
  • You drive contractual consistency across projects, contribute to standard contract development, and participate in project governance and risk reviews.
Project Development
  • You provide practical, business-oriented legal support across the full project lifecycle, from origination and development through construction and operations.
  • You support land acquisition activities, permitting processes, and the securing of regulatory approvals.
  • You advise on contract structures, commercial arrangements, and risk allocation strategies to support successful project delivery.
  • You engage with governmental authorities, landowners, contractors, strategic partners, and other key stakeholders.
 
Operations
  • You collaborate with the Supply Chain team to develop and implement contracting strategies that support operational activities.
  • You draft, review, and negotiate maintenance, service, works, hire, and other operational agreements.
  • You provide practical legal guidance on operational contract management and ongoing commercial relationships.
  • You support business stakeholders in managing contractual risks throughout the operational phase.
 
Claims Management
  • You lead the legal management of claims arising from construction, procurement, and commercial contracts.
  • You assess contractual entitlements, liabilities, and potential exposure while developing effective claims strategies with cross-functional teams.
  • You prepare and review notices, claims submissions, responses, and supporting documentation to protect the company's interests.
  • You coordinate external legal counsel and technical experts in litigation, arbitration, adjudication, and settlement negotiations.


Your profile

  • You have 5-10 years of post-qualification experience gained in a leading law firm and/or within a multinational in-house legal team and have achieved at least satisfactory results in both German State Examinations.
  • You have extensive experience advising on project development, construction law, procurement matters, and the drafting and negotiation of complex commercial contracts.
  • You have supported large-scale projects in sectors such as renewable energy, industrial, chemicals, utilities, mining, or comparable industries.
  • You have knowledge of project delivery and construction frameworks, including VOB/B, FIDIC, permitting processes, regulatory requirements, and public law matters.
  • You have experience managing contractual claims, disputes, and risk-related matters throughout the project lifecycle.
  • You work effectively with cross-functional teams and diverse stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions and business functions.
  • You demonstrate strong commercial judgment, a pragmatic approach to problem-solving, and the confidence to engage with senior leadership and project executives.
  • You are highly organized, resilient, and adaptable, act with integrity and discretion, communicate effectively, and are fluent in German and English, both written and spoken.


We offer

  • Flexible working hours and the option of mobile working.
  • 30 days of vacation (based on a 5-day week).
  • Onboarding program “Vulcan Starter Days.” Includes a visit to the power plant and a tour of our laboratory.
  • Company pension scheme.
  • Corporate benefits platform with many attractive discounts offers.


We are looking forward to meeting you!

Interested? Just send us your resume using the application form and tell us why you would like to join Vulcan.  

*** Please note that all applications must be submitted using the application form—we do not accept applications by email. ***

title: Senior Sales Consultant Smart Grids (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Envelio
description_html:
About Working at envelio

Too easy is boring! Together, we are on a mission to drive forward the energy transition. We love what we do, and we are unafraid to dive in. We believe in taking ownership of our work and in continuously growing and evolving. In short: own it, love it, grow with it.

We are a humble team of coffee and maté lovers with over 20 nationalities. With our geek humor, our love for emojis and random facts is only natural. Over 200 envelians are already on board. Dive in and thrive!


Your Role

As part of our Sales and Business Development team, you will directly influence the growth of envelio. Your task is to develop new projects for our product, the Intelligent Grid Platform (IGP), and to win grid operators as satisfied and long-term users. Within the team we attach great importance to a trustful cooperation as well as self-initiative and a high degree of responsibility.

As Senior Sales Consultant Smart Grids (all genders), you will be responsible for building, nurturing and expanding relationships with our enterprise customers in the DACH region.


How You Make an Impact

  • You develop and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with our key clients in the DACH region
  • You develop strategic account plans to achieve and exceed sales targets and business objectives
  • You develop and implement strategies to attract and acquire new high-value customers and to expand existing accounts by cross-selling or upselling new features, projects or applications
  • You are responsible for the entire sales cycle from identifying opportunities and delivering presentations to preparing quotes and negotiating contracts
  • You identify new customer requirements and support the strategic development of our product and solution portfolio
  • You own the strategic direction of tenders, ensuring customer alignment and work together with the Bid Manager and Sales Engineer in developing compelling responses
  • You act as a technology sparring partner at your customers: you uncover their pain points, match them to our IGP portfolio and drive new use cases
  • You work closely with internal teams, including marketing, customer success, and product development, to ensure a seamless client experience


Your Profile

  • You have completed a university degree in the field of industrial engineering, business administration with a specialization in technology management or a comparable course of study
  • You have a proven track record as a Key Account Manager, Sales Manager, or in a similar role in the energy space
  • You think strategically and are skilled at navigating complex customer organizations, identifying opportunities, aligning stakeholders and shaping successful outcomes
  • You are a strong communicator, have a confident manner and bring a solution-oriented "hands-on" thinking with you
  • You see yourself as a team player and support your colleagues at all times in order to achieve the common goal
  • You are fluent in German and English
  • You bring a high degree of initiative and enjoy working independently


Your Benefits

  • Join us fully remote or at our lovely office in Cologne in a hybrid working mode
  • Option for remote work from abroad (up to three months per year from anywhere in the EU or the USA)
  • 30 holidays + 3 corporate holidays
  • Support for your health through sports membership cooperations
  • Flexible use of a monthly mobility budget (e.g. Jobrad, ÖPNV)
  • Time and resources for individual growth
  • envelio pension plan
  • Professional mental wellbeing support through our partner nilo for you and your family
  • Regular tech and growth talks for internal knowledge sharing
  • Regular company and team events

title: Account Executive (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at JUNE GmbH
description_html:
HERAUSFORDERUNG UND PERSPEKTIVE

Du liebst es, Deals zu jagen statt Leads zu verwalten? Dann lies weiter. 

JUNE ist die Plattform, auf der Rechtsabteilungen und Kanzleien komplexe und hochvolumige Verfahren führen – weitgehend automatisiert, durchgängig KI-gestützt: von der Erfassung eingehender Post und Falldaten über Fristen und Dokumentenerstellung bis zur gemeinsamen Fallarbeit. Dabei sind wir Vorreiter darin, KI und Case Management zu verbinden – im Einsatz bei Rechtsabteilungen wie Lufthansa und Swiss Life sowie bei Kanzleien wie CMS und Pinsent Masons. Ein echter Markt-Disruptor in einer Branche, die viel zu lange stillstand – und dafür brauchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung nicht suchen, sondern einfach übernehmen. Als Senior Account Executive führst du den gesamten Sales-Cycle – von der ersten Ansprache bis zum unterschriebenen Vertrag – eigenständig, mit klarem Kopf für Pipeline, Forecast und die Menschen auf der anderen Seite des Tisches.
 
Was dich erwartet:

  • End-to-End Ownership deiner Deals – Steuerung, Forecasting, Zielerreichung liegen bei dir
  • Eigene Verticals, die du strategisch aufbaust statt nur abzuarbeiten
  • Direkter Draht zu Tech & Customer Success, sobald es technisch wird – du bleibst der Owner der Beziehung
  • Ein Produkt, das du wirklich verstehst und erklären kannst, statt es nur zu verkaufen
  • Messen, Events und Kundentermine live vor Ort statt nur Zoom-Kacheln


PERSÖNLICHKEIT UND QUALIFIKATION

Was du mitbringst:

  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger SaaS-Lösungen und ein sicheres Gespür für komplexe Sales-Zyklen
  • Die Fähigkeit, dich souverän zwischen Fachabteilung und Entscheidungsebene zu bewegen
  • Analytisches Verständnis für Geschäftsprozesse – du leitest Mehrwert und ROI her, statt nur Features aufzuzählen
  • Drive: Du treibst deine Deals aktiv voran und lässt kein Follow-up liegen
  • Eine strukturierte, verbindliche Arbeitsweise – dein CRM ist bei dir immer sauber, nicht nur vor dem Forecast-Call
Warum JUNE?
Weil Arbeit sich gut anfühlen soll, wenn großartige Dinge entstehen: Remote-Arbeit an erster Stelle, 30 Tage Urlaub, Family-First-Politik, keine Kleiderordnung, technische Wahlfreiheit. Unser Culture Code: Real Connections, Own Your Impact, Disruptive By Default, Serious Fun.

Klingt nach deinem nächsten Kapitel? Dann lass uns reden.


UNTERNEHMENSKULTUR UND UMFELD

Wir sind ein founder-led AI-Scale-up mit kurzen Wegen, hoher Geschwindigkeit und dem Anspruch, eine ganze Branche neu zu denken. Bei uns arbeitest du in einem Team, das sich gegenseitig vertraut, unterstützt und gemeinsam wächst #RealConnections. 
Jeder übernimmt Verantwortung, gestaltet aktiv mit und kann echten Einfluss auf unseren Erfolg nehmen #OwnYourImpact. Wir lieben es, Bestehendes herauszufordern, neue Ideen auszuprobieren und mit modernster Technologie Grenzen zu verschieben #DisruptiveByDefault. 
Wir arbeiten fokussiert, feiern Erfolge gemeinsam und verlieren dabei nie die Freude am Aufbau von etwas Großem. Denn die besten Ideen entstehen dort, wo Neugier, Teamgeist und der Mut zum Ausprobieren aufeinandertreffen #SeriousFun. 
Weitere Informationen zu June und unserem Arbeitsumfeld findest du auf unserer Karriereseite: 
https://www.june.tech/de/karriere/

title: (Senior) CRM Automation & Lifecycle Manager (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at HolidayCheck Group AG
description_html:
Start your very own journey – with HolidayCheck!

At HolidayCheck, everything revolves around making vacations better – together. We’re not only enabling the best time of the year for our travelers, but also creating an inspiring work environment for our team in our modern offices in Munich or Bottighofen. 

We live our company values every day: as #TeamHolidayCheck, we build trust, take ownership, and love what we do – all for the perfect holiday experience. 

As (Senior) CRM Automation & Lifecycle Manager (all genders), you own the customer relationship across the entire lifecycle – from first inspiration to rebooking. You don’t think in one-off campaigns, but in intelligent journeys: who should be contacted, when, through which channel, with which message, and based on which data signals? 

You connect strategy, data, technology, and content into one coherent system and make sure our CRM activities create measurable impact on journey performance, retention, rebooking, and Customer Lifetime Value. 


Your Tasks

  • Design and implement automated customer journeys end-to-end, from strategy to go-live in our CDP, including trigger logic, channel orchestration, and A/B testing
  • Define contact strategies and frequency logic across the customer lifecycle for email, push, and WhatsApp
  • Translate RFM, CLV, and churn scores into concrete segmentation, prioritization, and reactivation actions

title: Senior Infrastructure & Network Engineer - Germany
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Sungrow Europe - Welcome traveler!
description_html:
Your mission

Servus und hallo bei uns in Sungrow! Join our Munich IT team and help keep the infrastructure behind Europe’s clean-energy growth secure, reliable, and ready for what comes next. Curious what this is all about? Let’s dive right in:

  • Own the daily operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of Sungrow Europe’s data center infrastructure, networks, servers, storage, and virtualization platforms.
  • Manage and optimize enterprise network services across European locations, including routing, resilience, performance, capacity, and high-availability design.
  • Take dedicated responsibility for Munich office connectivity, including switches, Wi-Fi, firewalls, VPNs, internet services, and meeting-room networks.
  • Lead technical troubleshooting, incident response, root-cause analysis, and sustainable corrective actions for complex infrastructure issues.
  • Support modernization, expansion, migration, disaster recovery, and technology-refresh initiatives across infrastructure platforms.
  • Strengthen security, compliance, and operational excellence through robust documentation, change management, vulnerability remediation, SOPs, and runbooks.


Your profile

All right, that was intriguing, wasn’t it? To thrive in this role and enjoy building reliable services for the long term, your background could look like this:

  • You hold a degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, along with at least three years of relevant infrastructure or enterprise network engineering experience.
  • You bring hands-on experience with Fortinet firewalls, SD-WAN, Cisco Firepower FTD, Cisco Nexus 9000, and Cisco enterprise switching environments.
  • You have strong knowledge of routing, switching, and security technologies, including BGP, OSPF, VRF, ACLs, QoS, STP, NAT, link aggregation, and high-availability architectures.
  • You are comfortable operating VMware, Nutanix, and KVM-based virtualization platforms, with knowledge of VMware NSX-T and its security capabilities.
  • You have worked with monitoring and observability tools such as Zabbix, Prometheus, and Grafana, and can use Python, Shell, PowerShell, or Perl for automation.
  • You combine structured problem-solving with a proactive mindset for capacity planning, service improvements, documentation, implementation plans, and rollback procedures.
  • You communicate confidently in English at C1 level; German at B2 level is an advantage, and Mandarin Chinese at B2 level or above is a strong advantage for collaboration with global technical teams.
  • Certifications such as VMware VCP, CCNA or CCNP, Microsoft Azure Administrator, ITIL Foundation, Fortinet NSE, or Nutanix Certified Professional are welcome.


Why us?

Join a collaborative IT department where your work directly supports Sungrow Europe’s growth and operational resilience. You will have real ownership of a diverse infrastructure landscape, work closely with international technical teams, and contribute to the systems that enable colleagues across Europe to stay connected, productive, and secure.
At Sungrow, you will help modernize enterprise infrastructure in a fast-moving greentech environment, while building practical solutions across data centers, networks, cloud platforms, and workplace technology.

title: Werkstudent:in Sales & Operations (m/w/d)
description_html:
1KOMMA5°

Bei 1KOMMA5° verfolgen wir eine Vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. Dafür bauen wir mit Heartbeat AI das Energiesystem der Zukunft. Bist du dabei? 

Wir bringen regionales Handwerk und skalierbare Software zusammen: Solar, Speicher, Wärmepumpe und E-Mobilität denken wir nicht einzeln, sondern steuern sie als intelligentes, integriertes Gesamtsystem in unserem virtuellen Kraftwerk. Direkt verbunden mit dem Strommarkt – in Echtzeit, vollautomatisiert. So wird Energie dann genutzt, wenn sie erneuerbar verfügbar und besonders günstig ist. Bis 2030 wollen wir 1,5 Millionen Haushalte auf erneuerbare Energien umstellen. Über 3.000 Menschen arbeiten jeden Tag daran, an mehr als 80 Standorten weltweit, von Finnland bis Australien. 

Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen und Lösungen bauen, die wirklich zählen? Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte mit uns die Energiewelt von morgen.


Deine Position

Als Werkstudent/in im Vertrieb übernimmst du vom ersten Tag an Verantwortung im direkten Kundenkontakt und sorgst für reibungslose interne Prozesse:

  • Lead-Vorqualifizierung: Du übernimmst den Erstkontakt zu potenziellen Neukunden, qualifizierst Anfragen vor und filterst relevante Leads für unsere Energie-Experten im Sales-Team
  • Proaktives Terminmanagement: Du koordinierst und terminierst Kundengespräche (z. B. für digitale Beratungen oder Vor-Ort-Checks) und übernimmst die selbstständige Umplanung bei Terminverschiebungen
  • Informationsbeschaffung: Du bist hartnäckig, aber charmant, wenn es darum geht, fehlende Dokumente oder wichtige Fotos (z. B. vom Zählerschrank, Hausdach oder Heizungskeller) von Kunden rechtzeitig einzuholen
  • Prozessoptimierung (Sales to Ops): Du stellst sicher, dass alle relevanten Kundeninformationen und technischen Details vollständig vorliegen, um eine saubere und schnelle Übergabe vom Vertrieb an unsere Installations-Teams (Ops) zu garantieren.


Dein Profil

Wir suchen niemanden, der nur abarbeitet, sondern jemanden, der mitdenkt und anpackt. Folgende Punkte sind uns wichtig:

  • Kommunikationstalent: Du hast großen Spaß am Telefonieren, bist redegewandt, schlagfertig und triffst im Kundenkontakt stets den richtigen Ton

  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe: Du durchdringst Problemstellungen in Sekundenschnelle und weißt genau, welche Informationen das Ops-Team für die reibungslose Installation der Energiesysteme benötigt

  • Zielorientierung & Drive: Du arbeitest strukturiert, verlierst das Ziel nie aus den Augen und hakst proaktiv nach, bis alle Unterlagen vollständig sind

  • Studentischer Status: Du bist aktuell an einer Hochschule immatrikuliert (der Studiengang ist zweitrangig, wichtig ist deine Motivation)

Zusätzliche Pluspunkte (Nice-to-have):

  •  Passion for Impact: Du brennst für die Themen Klimaschutz, Energiewende und Nachhaltigkeit

  •  Branchenwissen: Du hast bereits erste Berührungspunkte oder Vorwissen im Bereich Wärmepumpen, Photovoltaik oder Energiemanagement gesammelt (Kein Muss – wir bringen dir das Wichtigste bei, aber es hilft dir beim Start enorm!)



Benefits

  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit: Du bist Teil der Lösung und gestaltest die Energiewende bei einem der innovativsten Climate-Tech-Unternehmen Europas aktiv mit

  • Start-up-Spirit & Professionalität: Ein dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien, direkten Entscheidungswegen und einem hochmotivierten Team

  • Steile Lernkurve: Tiefe Einblicke in Vertriebsstrukturen, Verkaufspsychologie und die Zukunftstechnologien der erneuerbaren Energien

  • Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich optimal mit deinem Vorlesungsplan vereinbaren lassen

Hast du Lust, die Energierevolution mit uns anzugehen? Dann bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil unserer Mission!


Deine Position

  • Motivation & Mindset: Du bringst eine ausgeprägte Can-do-Mentalität mit, arbeitest gerne operativ und unterstützt das Team flexibel dort, wo du gebraucht wirst – ohne deinen Qualitätsanspruch aus den Augen zu verlieren.

Benefits

  • Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Berlin oder remote
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Viel Eigenverantwortung und die Möglichkeit, eigene Themen zu übernehmen
  • Direkter Einblick in strategische Entscheidungen auf VP-Ebene

  • Du kannst aktiv mitgestalten und leistest mit Deiner Arbeit einen Beitrag zur Energiewende

GeneralMind builds AI Systems of Action for complex enterprise workflows. We deploy AI employees that automate messy operational handovers across supply chains: processing orders, validating invoices, coordinating suppliers, and handling exceptions directly on top of enterprise systems like SAP or Oracle.

Our platform combines AI agents, operational context graphs, and real transaction data to achieve Autopilot-grade automation in real operational environments. We work closely with leading global companies across manufacturing, retail, and logistics to deploy AI into mission-critical workflows.

Tasks

  • Win enterprise customers through partners. Work with our partners to open doors to large accounts and convert them into customers together.
  • Own partner relationships from start to finish. Be the trusted contact for our partners, understand their goals, and build the trust that turns into joint deals.
  • Build solutions with partners. Turn messy operational challenges into clear, well-scoped solutions on top of systems like SAP, Oracle, JDE, and Dynamics, matching what our platform can do with what the end customer needs.
  • Drive adoption and growth. Guide joint customers from first deployment to scaling AI across more workflows, and keep finding new ways to grow the business with each partner.

  • Strong curiosity for AI tools and a real willingness to make them part of how you work.
  • Excellent communication in German and English; additional languages are a plus.

Join GeneralMind as a Partnership Manager and drive AI innovation in enterprises. Shape the future of automated workflows, enhance operations, and make a real impact. Apply today!

description_html:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Paper.io 2, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual, and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing, and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

Joining our Live games team means collaborating with gaming industry experts on globally renowned, enduring games while embracing exciting new entrepreneurial ventures. With over seven billion downloads worldwide and a portfolio of more than 10 resilient hybrid games generating more than $20m per year, we are the world's largest and most successful hybrid publisher.

You will be joining one of our Live Studios, working on Paper.io2.

Role

Paper Party is the multiplayer mode of Paper.io 2. We are looking for a dedicated Game Designer to improve the modes we already have and create new ones from scratch.

All modes will keep the Paper universe, camera and controls. Beyond that, there is a lot of creative freedom. You will explore new rules, objectives, win conditions, pacing and team setups to create a broad range of fun and replayable multiplayer experiences.

You will:

  • Design and prototype new gameplay modes

  • Improve existing Paper Party modes

  • Define simple, readable rules for one-finger controls

  • Iterate quickly through testing, feedback and playtests

  • Balance accessibility, competition, pacing and replayability

  • Identify weak ideas early and confidently cut or reshape them

  • Work closely with the Paper.io 2 team to turn concepts into playable experiences

  • Document your designs clearly

  • Fine-tune modes directly in Unity whenever possible

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys moving quickly from an idea to a playable prototype, testing it and improving it.

Profile

  • 5+ years of experience in mobile F2P games, designing new games, gameplay modes or prototypes from scratch

  • Experience shipping player-facing content, ideally in mobile games

  • A strong understanding of multiplayer and competitive gameplay

  • A good sense of pacing, clarity and player motivation

  • A pragmatic and iterative approach: prototype, test, cut and retry

  • The ability to work independently and take full ownership

  • Strong English communication and collaboration skills

Nice to have

  • Strong Unity experience

  • Ability to prototype directly in the engine

  • Experience with mobile controls, multiplayer or party games

  • Experience working on live games or live content
