title: Fullstack Software Engineer (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Rhein Nadel Automation Gmbh
description_html:
Wer wir sind

  

RNA Digital Solutions wurde 2016 als Industrial Tech Startup gegründet. Unsere Expertise liegt im Digitalen Maschinenbau und wir beschäftigen uns insbesondere mit der digitalen Auslegung und Herstellung automatisierter Zuführlösungen. In 2021 erfolgte der Anschluss des Startups an den Weltmarktführer in der Zuführtechnik, der Rhein-Nadel-Automation GmbH. Unser Fokus liegt zu 100% auf der Softwareentwicklung. Unsere Software-Teams verteilen sich auf die Standorte München und Aachen. In München entwickeln wir unsere Dienste für Künstliche Intelligenz und Simulation. In Aachen nutzen wir die Nähe zum Shop Floor für Sonder-Digitalisierungsprojekte und Shop Floor-bezogene Software. 

Die Kombination von jahrzehntelanger Erfahrung im Bereich Zuführtechnik gepaart mit modernsten Technologien im Bereich der künstlichen Intelligenz ermöglicht es uns, die Zuführtechnik von Morgen zu entwickeln. 

Zur Verstärkung unseres Entwicklungsteams suchen wir einen erfahrenen Fullstack Software Engineer (m/w/d) mit Sitz im Raum München. Die Arbeit erfolgt größtenteils mobil, jedoch ist eine regelmäßige Anwesenheit im Office in München vorgesehen (ca. 1 Mal pro Woche).


Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung: Du treibst zusammen mit dem Team den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung interner Apps zur Prozessdigitalisierung und -automatisierung voran. Die React-basierten Apps kommunizieren über REST mit verschiedenen Django-Backends/-Microservices. Die containerbasierte Architektur umfasst auch KI-/ML-Module sowie automatisierte Physik-Simulationen.
  • Aufgabenspektrum: Du wirkst von der Anforderungsaufnahme über die Implementierung bis zur Auslieferung mit.
  • Schnittstellen: Du arbeitest in einem dynamischen Umfeld und stehst im engen Kontakt mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen, um Nutzeranforderungen zu verstehen und umzusetzen.


Dein Profil

  • Ausbildung: Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium in einem MINT-Fach oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Berufserfahrung: Du hast mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung/Webentwicklung.
  • Soft-skills: Dich zeichnen deine Teamfähigkeit, Kommunikationsstärke und Durchsetzungsvermögen aus.
  • Arbeitsweise: Du verfügst über eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du kannst dich fließend auf Deutsch (mind. C1) und Englisch verständigen.
Für die Aufgabe sind folgende Toolkenntnisse notwendig:

- Fundierte Kenntnisse in:
  • Python/Django (oder andere ORM-Tools oder fundierte SQL-Erfahrung)
  • Javascript/React (oder ähnliche Frontend-Frameworks)
- Wünschenswert:
  • Docker
  • ERP-Kenntnisse


Warum wir?

  • Hohe Gestaltungsfreiheit und Flexibilität im Zukunftsthema Digitaler Maschinenbau
  • Flache Hiararchie und Startup-Spirit
  • Idealer Mix aus mobilem Arbeiten und Office-Präsenz
  • Corporate Benefits: Urban Sports Club, Coffee Bar & Snacks, Team Events
  • Ein großartiges internationales Team, das nicht nur am Arbeitsplatz Höchstleistung erbringt, sondern auch bei gemeinsamen Events
  • 30 Tage Jahresurlaub

title: Senior AI Architect & Consultant (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Mayflower
description_html:
Wer wir sind

Die Mayflower GmbH baut Individualsoftware mit Fokus auf Generative AI – seit 1998 inhabergeführt. 

Wir bringen komplette AI-Infrastrukturen in Produktion: Model-Serving, Agent-Gateways, Chat und Voice – direkt in der Umgebung des Kunden. Dich erwartet ein agiles Arbeitsumfeld mit echter Verantwortung und flachen Strukturen – Entscheidungen triffst Du selbst, statt sie durch Freigabeschleifen zu schieben.

Wir suchen Dich – jemanden, der AI-Systeme nicht nur konzipiert, sondern ihren Weg in die Produktion aktiv mitverantwortet. Von der Architekturberatung auf C-Level bis zum Produktivbetrieb: Du entwirfst die Lösung und bringst sie mit dem Team in den echten Einsatz.


Was dich erwartet

  • Anspruchsvolle Projekte mit LLMs, Agentic RAG und AI-Agent-Frameworks (z. B. LangGraph, PydanticAI, Mastra oder OpenAI Agents SDK) – inklusive Deep-Agent-Architekturen. Du baust Evaluation-Pipelines und Observability (Logging/Tracing mit LangSmith, Langfuse o. Ä.) auf und arbeitest mit modernem MLOps-Stack sowie Vector Databases.
  • Du entwirfst Lösungsarchitekturen für komplexe Kundenvorhaben – mit Security, Compliance, Skalierbarkeit und Datenschutz im Hinterkopf – von der ersten Skizze im Gespräch bis zur konkreten Roadmap.
  • Gemeinsam im Team führst Du Deep-Dive-Calls und Workshops mit Kunden durch und bringst sie in die nächste Projektphase.
  • Du begleitest die Anbahnung neuer Projekte und unterstützt unser Team im Pre-Sales mit technischer Glaubwürdigkeit.
  • Du kommunizierst souverän auf C-Level – Du verstehst ökonomische Ziele, sprichst die Sprache von Entscheider:innen und verbindest technische Exzellenz mit Business-Impact.
  • Der Schwerpunkt Deiner Rolle liegt mit etwa 50 % in Kundenprojekten, in intensiven Phasen auch darüber. Den übrigen Teil Deiner Zeit investierst Du in Pre-Sales-Gespräche und Workshops, die Du vorbereitest und durchführst, sowie in die strategische Unterstützung von Geschäftsführung und Sales.
  • Konferenzen, Community-Events, Fachbeiträge: Präsenz ist ein Plus, keine Bedingung. Wichtig ist uns nur, dass Du bereit bist, Dich fachlich zu zeigen.
  • Du reist 4–8 Tage im Monat zu Kunden und Kolleg:innen – Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands, bei Bedarf auch in Österreich und der Schweiz, ist Teil der Rolle.


Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Langjährige Erfahrung als Architekt:in oder Senior Engineer, idealerweise bei einem Dienstleister oder in der IT-Beratung.
  • Projekterfahrung mit Agentic-AI-Implementierungen, die über Prototypen hinausgeht: LangChain, LangGraph und Deep Agents im echten Einsatz – oder vergleichbare Tiefe im TypeScript-Umfeld (Mastra) bzw. im Microsoft-Ökosystem (Semantic Kernel / Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure AI Foundry). Vector Databases und MLOps sind ein Plus.
  • Die Kompetenz, Kunden AI-Konzepte und Architekturen anschaulich und praxisnah zu vermitteln.
  • Du kannst Lösungen im Kundengespräch skizzieren und überzeugend vertreten – Storytelling und Präsenz sind Deine Stärken.
  • Du begegnest C-Level auf gleicher Ebene – Du verstehst, welche Aspekte Entscheider:innen bewegen und wie Du technische Konzepte in wirtschaftliche Relevanz übersetzt.
  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C1+) und konversationssicheres Englisch.


Das haben wir zu bieten

  • Kompetitive Vergütung: Attraktives, marktgerechtes Gehaltspaket, das zu Deiner Erfahrung und Kompetenz passt.
  • Echte Produktionsverantwortung: Deine Systeme laufen produktiv bei großen Unternehmensgruppen - nicht in der Demo-Umgebung.
  • Gute Software bauen: Hier wird echter Wert auf Code- und Softwarequalität gelegt.
  • Kein 08/15: Abwechslung durch unterschiedliche Branchen, Use Cases und Technologien - vom GPU-Cluster bis zum Voice-Agenten.
  • Kundenbeziehung auf Augenhöhe: Wir pflegen eine ehrliche und vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden.
  • Mache einen Unterschied: Viel Verantwortung, großer Gestaltungsspielraum - in einem Mittelständler, in dem dein Beitrag den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg direkt beeinflusst.
  • Lerne immer dazu: Weiterbildung (intern und extern), Training-on-the-job und regelmäßige Weiterentwicklungs- und Gehaltsgespräche.
  • Wie arbeiten selbstorganisiert:  Wir geben dir den Freiraum, den Rahmen für gute Arbeit selbst mitzugestalten – im Team wie beim Kunden.
  • Werde berühmt: Eine technische Redaktion unterstützt dich beim Schreiben und Publizieren, sodass du als Experte nach außen sichtbar wirst.
  • Du musst nicht die klügste Person im Raum sein: Echte Sparring-Partner, die deine Ideen gemeinsam mit dir auf die Probe stellen und weiterentwickeln.
  • Schalte einfach ab: Niemand erwartet Erreichbarkeit nach Feierabend, im Urlaub oder trotz Krankmeldung. Viele Überstunden sind bei uns nicht üblich.
  • Gut für die Psyche: Ersthelfer psychische Gesundheit, Employee Assistance Programm und ein offener Umgang mit mentaler Gesundheit.
  • Freiraum für dein Privatleben: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, bis zu vier Tage Homeoffice die Woche, spontan einen Tag frei, Arbeiten aus dem EU-Ausland, Sabbatical oder 4 Wochen Urlaub am Stück.
  • Bring dein +1 mit: Brave Bürohunde oder Kinder an schulfreien Werktagen sind herzlich willkommen.
  • Finanzielle Benefits: Regelmäßige Teamevents, Wellpass, 30 Tage Urlaub, Kindergartenzuschuss, Deutsche Dienstrad.


Der Kontakt zu uns

title: Senior Engineer (m/w/d) — On-Site & Vollzeit
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Fulfin
description_html:
Intro

Wir machen Unternehmensfinanzierung einfacher: digital, schnell und mit zunehmend intelligenten Lösungen. Mehr als 7.500 Unternehmerinnen und Unternehmer nutzen fulfin bereits.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Tech Teams suchen zum sofortigen Start einen Senior Engineer. Du wirst Teil eines kleinen, erfahrenen Teams und übernimmst weitreichende Verantwortung für geschäftskritische Lösungen.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst und betreibst zuverlässige, wartbare Software.
  • Du übernimmst wichtige Projekte von der Problemdefinition bis zur Umsetzung und zum laufenden Betrieb.
  • Du hinterfragst Annahmen, erkennst Risiken und übersetzt geschäftliche und produktbezogene Anforderungen in wirkungsvolle, pragmatische technische Lösungen.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Produktteam, der Geschäftsführung sowie internen und externen Stakeholdern zusammen.
  • Du unterstützt andere Entwickler und hilfst dabei, unsere technischen Standards und Arbeitsweisen weiterzuentwickeln.


Dein Profil

Anforderungen:

  • Du kommunizierst ausgezeichnet auf Englisch und kannst komplexe Themen technischen wie nicht-technischen Zielgruppen klar vermitteln.
  • Du zeigst Eigeninitiative, denkst kritisch, setzt klare Prioritäten und treibst Themen eigenverantwortlich bis zum Ergebnis voran. Dabei bist du neugierig und motiviert, dir fehlendes Wissen selbstständig anzueignen.
  • Du verfügst über ein solides Fundament in der Softwareentwicklung und praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und im Betrieb von Produktivsystemen.
  • Du kannst und möchtest überwiegend vor Ort in unserem Münchner Büro arbeiten.
Von Vorteil:
  • Du verfügst über professionelle Deutschkenntnisse.
  • Erfahrung in FinTech, Finanzdienstleistungen oder einem anderen regulierten Umfeld.
  • Kenntnisse in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, AWS, Docker, Node.js, React, GraphQL, Serverless- oder ereignisgesteuerten Architekturen.
  • Erfahrung in einem kleinen Team mit breitem individuellem Verantwortungsbereich.
Du musst nicht jede genannte Technologie oder Branche kennen. Lernbereitschaft, Verantwortungsübernahme und klare Kommunikation sind uns wichtiger als ein perfekt passender Lebenslauf.


Benefits

  • ÖPNV-Ticket: Wir bezuschussen dein Ticket für deine berufliche und private Mobilität.
  • Fitness: Mit einer bezuschussten Urban-Sports-Club-Mitgliedschaft kannst du flexibel in ganz Deutschland trainieren.
  • Kostenlose Getränke: Kaffee, Wasser und weitere Getränke stehen dir im Office kostenlos zur Verfügung.
  • Teamlunch: Regelmäßige gemeinsame Lunches gehören bei uns dazu.

Wenn du dich in dieser Beschreibung wiederfindest, freuen wir uns, von dir zu hören! Falls du Git-Repositories mit Code hast, auf den du besonders stolz bist, sehen wir uns diese sehr gerne an.

title: Product Manager – Platform Experience & Cloud Administration (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Jedox GmbH
description_html:
What is Jedox?

Jedox is a leading provider of Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) solutions, helping organizations plan, analyze, and drive business performance with confidence. More than 2,000 companies worldwide, from ambitious mid-sized businesses to global enterprises, rely on Jedox to streamline planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes.
Recognized as a leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™, Jedox combines powerful planning capabilities with a modern cloud platform that enables businesses to adapt quickly and make informed decisions. At Jedox, we believe in innovation, impactful results, people centricity, and the power of #OneTeam to help our customers succeed.


Your Responsibilities

As Product Manager – Platform Experience & Cloud Administration, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of key platform experiences including navigation, onboarding, user access, and cloud administration. Working closely with Engineering, Design, and Architecture, you will drive improvements that enhance usability, customer trust, and platform scalability, helping shape how thousands of users experience Jedox every day.

What You'll Do

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap: Define and drive the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for Platform Navigation, BaseUI, and Cloud Console capabilities.
  • Lead discovery and product validation: Conduct user research, gather stakeholder input, analyze customer needs, and validate opportunities to ensure impactful product investments.
  • Shape the platform experience: Improve navigation, onboarding, login experiences, session management, and integrations with platform services such as analytics and feature flagging solutions.
  • Drive Cloud Console evolution: Enhance the self-service administration experience, enabling IT teams to efficiently manage environments, users, permissions, and access controls.
  • Manage end-to-end product delivery: Guide initiatives from concept through delivery, launch, and communication while ensuring high-quality execution and measurable outcomes.
  • Prioritize and make trade-offs: Balance customer needs, technical complexity, business priorities, and long-term platform goals to make informed product decisions.
  • Partner with Engineering and Architecture: Collaborate closely with technical leaders to align short-term delivery with sustainable platform architecture and scalability.
  • Enable cross-functional alignment: Work with Product, Design, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and Leadership teams to build shared understanding and drive successful execution.
  • Monitor product success: Define key outcomes, measure adoption and user experience improvements, and continuously optimize platform capabilities.
  • Champion customer-centric innovation: Ensure platform experiences support both end users and IT administrators while strengthening customer trust and satisfaction.
What Success Looks Like in Your First Year
  • Administrators can complete common configuration and management tasks independently without requiring support tickets.
  • Time-to-value for new users is significantly reduced through enhanced onboarding and navigation experiences.
  • A clear, credible multi-year platform roadmap is established and supported by Engineering, Sales, and Leadership stakeholders.


Your Profile

  • 3–5 years of experience as a Product Manager within enterprise SaaS environments.
  • Experience owning and developing foundational product areas such as platform services, administrative experiences, developer portals, or similar infrastructure-related products.
  • Strong understanding of the needs of both IT buyers/administrators and end users.
  • Proven ability to define product strategy, prioritize initiatives, and drive execution in complex, cross-functional environments.
  • Ability to build trust with engineering teams through clear problem definition, structured thinking, and pragmatic decision-making.
  • Experience navigating dependencies across multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working in ambiguous environments and turning complexity into actionable plans.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Based within a European time zone.


What’s in It for You

  • Join a profitable, growing software company with a strong global presence across Europe, North America, and APAC.
  • Play a key role in shaping the future of a rapidly scaling cloud platform used by thousands of organizations worldwide.
  • Work on high-impact platform experiences that influence how tens of thousands of users interact with Jedox every day.
  • Collaborate with talented international teams in a culture built around #OneTeam, innovation, and impactful results.
  • Enjoy the opportunity to grow professionally while contributing to products that deliver real customer value.
  • Help define strategic platform decisions that will shape the Jedox experience for years to come.


Transparency Note: Use of Artificial Intelligence

As a tech-driven company, Jedox uses modern technologies — including AI — to continuously improve our processes.
In recruiting, AI may support us in screening and structuring applications. It does not replace human judgment, but helps us reduce bias and ensure a consistent candidate experience. Your application is always reviewed by real people.
 
If you would like to learn more about the process, please visit the website of our partner Hi People. Here you will find information about the data protection guidelines as well as the most recent security checks. This gives you complete clarity on how your data is protected and processed. Of course, you can also contact us at any time if you have any questions.

description_html:
What is Jedox?

Jedox is a leading provider of Enterprise Performance Management solutions, helping organizations streamline planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting. Our intelligent platform empowers finance teams and business leaders to make confident, data-driven decisions while adapting quickly to change.
At Jedox, we believe that great results come from working as #OneTeam. We foster a people-centric environment where curiosity, innovation, a growth mindset, and a commitment to executing with excellence enable our teams to create meaningful impact.


Your Responsibilities

As Director Product Marketing, you will shape the positioning and go-to-market strategy for Jedox product offerings. You will serve as a strategic bridge between Product, R&D, Sales, Sales Engineering, Marketing, executive stakeholders, customers, and external industry audiences. With a hands-on approach and strong ownership mindset, you will lead cross-functional product launches, refine company positioning, enable the sales organization, and communicate the value of Jedox solutions throughout the customer buying journey. 
What You’ll Do

  • Lead cross-functional product launches: Develop and execute multi-channel launch plans for new Jedox product offerings, ensuring effective internal readiness and strong external market activation. 
  • Shape positioning and thought leadership: Lead and support the development of company and product positioning, informed by market research, analysis, and relevant industry perspectives. 
  • Optimize the customer buying journey: Build a strong understanding of why organizations choose Jedox and create a content library that delivers the right value to the right prospect at the right time, helping improve sales-stage conversion rates. 
  • Translate technology into customer value: Partner with R&D, Product Management, and Sales Engineering to turn complex technical concepts into clear, specific, and compelling customer value propositions. 
  • Enable sales success: Create high-quality sales collateral that equips the global sales organization to communicate Jedox’s value consistently and effectively. 
  • Deliver engaging product webinars: Coordinate with internal and external subject-matter experts to develop and present Jedox product webinars for relevant audiences.
  • Drive analyst and influencer engagement: Identify priority analysts and influencers, relevant upcoming research, and published reports to maximize opportunities for meaningful engagement. 
  • Build strategic industry relationships: Work directly with Jedox C-level executives as well as Product Management and Marketing teams to educate and engage industry analysts, including firms such as Gartner and BARC. 
  • Create impactful results across teams: Bring together stakeholders with a #OneTeam mindset, establish clear priorities, and execute with excellence across multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment.


Your Profile

  • 5-7 years of product marketing experience in B2B SaaS environments, supporting mid-market and enterprise customers. 
  • Strong knowledge of Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), finance organizations, and Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) processes. 
  • Proven track record of owning and successfully delivering at least three product or service launches. 
  • Hands-on experience in technology product marketing, analyst relations, or public relations, with the ability to translate complex technology into clear customer value. 
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage diverse audiences and create compelling content; fluent in English. 
  • Self-starter mindset with strong ownership, the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment, and a willingness to embrace AI as a productivity catalyst.


What’s in It for You

  • Strategic market impact: Play a central role in shaping how customers, prospects, analysts, and influencers understand the Jedox platform.
  • Executive and cross-functional exposure: Collaborate directly with C-level executives and work closely with Product Management, R&D, Sales Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.
  • End-to-end ownership: Influence the full product marketing lifecycle, from positioning and launch strategy to sales enablement, webinars, and analyst engagement. 
  • Room to innovate: Use technology and AI to enhance productivity, develop new approaches, and continuously improve how Jedox brings its products to market. 
  • A values-led environment: Work with colleagues who value #OneTeam collaboration, people centricity, continuous growth, innovation, execution excellence, and meaningful outcomes.


Transparency Note: Use of Artificial Intelligence

As a tech-driven company, Jedox uses modern technologies — including AI — to continuously improve our processes.
In recruiting, AI may support us in screening and structuring applications. It does not replace human judgment, but helps us reduce bias and ensure a consistent candidate experience. Your application is always reviewed by real people.
 
If you would like to learn more about the process, please visit the website of our partner Hi People. Here you will find information about the data protection guidelines as well as the most recent security checks. This gives you complete clarity on how your data is protected and processed. Of course, you can also contact us at any time if you have any questions.

description_html:
We are looking for a Senior Technical Project Manager to lead the homologation of Advanced Driver‑Assistance and semi‑autonomous driving systems in Europe and China.
You will work at the intersection of engineering, regulation, and customer engagement, ensuring our L2++ safety and comfort features meet regulatory, safety, and customer expectations on the path to mass production.


How your job will look like:
  • Initiate, plan, and execute semi‑autonomous vehicle programs for globally known OEMs
  • Own the end‑to‑end homologation of ADAS and automated driving systems (EU & China), including UNECE regulations, Euro NCAP, and type approval
  • Act as the single point of contact for homologation affairs across engineering and commercial domains, enabling fast decision‑making and alignment
  • Manage type approval roadmap, timeline, integration, delivery, and monitoring from concept to SOP
  • Translate regulatory and customer requirements into execution by leading technical workshops, test drives, system tuning, and validation activities for driving and safety functions
  • Coordinate with OEMs, technical services, and authorities throughout certification and approval phases
  • Drive resolution of internal and external escalations, reducing delivery risk and maintaining customer confidence

All you need is:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Computer Science, Electrical, Mechanical, or similar)
  • 7+ years of experience in technical project or program management (automotive or high‑tech)
  • Strong understanding of ADAS and automated driving development lifecycles
  • Solid knowledge of European regulations (UNECE); Chinese standards are a strong plus
  • Experience leading multi‑site, cross‑disciplinary teams and working directly with OEMs or certification bodies
  • Strong organizational, communication, and problem‑solving skills
  • Fluent in English (German is a plus)
  • Willingness to travel within Europe and to China
Mobileye changes the way we drive, from preventing accidents to semi and fully autonomous vehicles. If you are an excellent, bright, hands-on person with a passion to make a difference come to lead the revolution!

title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer - Moonpay Enterprise
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Moonpay
description_html:
MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend.

MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100, made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running.


The role

We’re hiring backend engineers across several openings within MoonPay Enterprise. All roles share the same foundation of designing and operating reliable, secure, high-throughput backend services, but each opening has a distinct focus. When you apply, tell us which track (or tracks) excites you most.

Track 1: KYB / KYC & Compliance Platform

Build the systems that let enterprises onboard safely and stay compliant across dozens of jurisdictions. You’ll own services powering business (KYB) and individual (KYC) verification flows, risk scoring, sanctions and AML screening, case management, and integrations with identity and compliance vendors. The challenge is making rigorous compliance feel invisible: fast, automated, and globally scalable, without ever compromising on regulatory obligations.

Track 2: New Product Lines, starting with Custody

Join us at the ground floor of new enterprise products, beginning with Custody. You’ll design the backend for secure digital asset storage and management for institutional clients: key management workflows, policy engines, transaction authorization, ledger integrity, and audit trails. This track suits engineers who love ambiguity, greenfield architecture, and building products from zero to one with enterprise-grade security requirements.

Track 3: Blockchain, Stablecoin Issuance & On-Chain Infrastructure

Work directly with blockchain protocols to power our stablecoin issuance business and on-chain products. You’ll build and operate services for minting, burning, and managing fully reserved stablecoins across chains, develop smart contract integrations on EVM chains and Solana, and design the indexing, monitoring, and reconciliation systems that keep on-chain and off-chain state in sync. Prior Solana (Rust) or Solidity development experience is a strong plus here.

Across all tracks, experience with fiat rails, banking integrations, or payments systems is very welcome. Much of our hardest work happens where traditional finance and crypto overlap.

What you’ll do

  • Design, build, and operate backend services written in Rust that process high volumes of financial transactions with strong guarantees around correctness, idempotency, and auditability
  • Own features end to end, from shaping the product spec through technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring. You won’t just receive work from product: as a domain expert, you’ll help define what we build and propose the work you consider most useful
  • Integrate with external partners such as banks, payment processors, blockchains, and identity and compliance vendors, and build the abstractions that make those integrations reliable
  • Improve engineering quality across observability, incident response, security practices, and API design
  • Collaborate closely with product, compliance, and other engineering teams across MoonPay’s global network
  • (Staff level) Set technical direction for your area, mentor other engineers, and drive architectural decisions that span multiple teams

About you

  • 5+ years of backend engineering experience (8+ for Staff), with a track record of shipping and operating production systems at scale
  • Strong backend experience with a statically compiled language (e.g. Rust, Go, C#, C++) is a must. Deep fundamentals matter more to us than your specific language history
  • Prior professional Rust experience is not required, but interest in Rust and motivation to become an expert in it are very welcome, since our services are written in Rust
  • Solid fundamentals in distributed systems, API design, data modeling, and asynchronous processing
  • Comfort working in domains where precision matters, such as financial systems, double-entry ledgers, reconciliation, or similarly correctness-critical software
  • A pragmatic, autonomous, ownership-driven mindset. You care about outcomes, communicate clearly, and thrive on high throughput: on this team, features ship in hours to days and products in days to weeks
  • Strong critical thinking, including in how you use AI tools. You know how to drive AI-assisted development productively while staying firmly in control of correctness, security, and design quality
  • Interest in crypto, stablecoins, and the future of payments. Prior crypto experience is a plus rather than a requirement, except for Track 3, where hands-on blockchain development experience is expected

Bonus points

  • Professional or hobby experience writing Rust (open-source contributions count!)
  • Experience in fiat payments, banking integrations, card networks, or PSPs
  • Familiarity with KYC/KYB, AML, sanctions screening, or regulated financial products (Track 1)
  • Background in custody, key management (MPC/HSM), or institutional-grade security (Track 2)
  • Smart contract development in Solidity (EVM) or Rust (Solana), and experience with on-chain indexing or node infrastructure (Track 3)
  • Experience working in regulated, multi-jurisdiction environments

How we work

MoonPay Enterprise operates like a startup inside a scale-up: small, senior, high-throughput teams with real ownership, direct access to customers and decision-makers, and the backing of MoonPay’s global licenses, banking relationships, and distribution network. We move fast and expect engineers to act as product owners for their domain, not just implementers. This role is open fully remote, or hybrid from our Berlin, Germany hub if you prefer time with the team in person.

NYC Salary: $180,000 - $300,000 USD

Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including, but not limited to, hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, and leave of absence.

MoonPay is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our job application procedures for qualified individuals with disabilities. Please inform our Talent Team if you need any assistance completing any forms or to otherwise participate in the application process.

title: Head of Sales (m/w/d) Erfahrung mit SaaS
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Pont Connects e.K.
description_html:
Für meinen langjähringen Kunden bin ich auf der Suche nach einem Head of Sales (m/w/d)

Wir suchen einen Head of Sales (m/w/d), der nicht nur selbst erfolgreich verkaufen kann, sondern vor allem andere Vertriebler erfolgreich macht.

In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die vertriebliche Performance und Weiterentwicklung unseres gesamten Key Account Teams. Du führst als Player-Coach, entwickelst unsere KAMs individuell weiter und sorgst dafür, dass aus guten Vertriebsmitarbeitern zunehmend selbstständige und strategisch agierende Umsatzträger werden.

Dabei geht es nicht darum, die schwierigsten Deals selbst zu übernehmen. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich daran, dass dein Team diese Deals zunehmend selbst erfolgreich abschließt.

Aufgaben

Führung & Coaching

  • Du kennst die Stärken und Entwicklungsfelder deiner KAMs und entwickelst sie gezielt weiter.
  • Du definierst gemeinsam mit deinen Teammitgliedern konkrete Entwicklungsziele und Maßnahmen.
  • Du coachst direkt an realen Accounts, Opportunities und Kundensituationen.
  • Du entwickelst deine KAMs insbesondere in den Bereichen Neukundenakquisition, strategisches Account Management, Value Selling, Entscheider-Management, Verhandlung und Closing.
  • Du bereitest wichtige Kundentermine und Verhandlungen gemeinsam mit deinen KAMs vor und reflektierst diese anschließend.
  • Du gibst Verantwortung nicht an dich, sondern an dein Team zurück und entwickelst dadurch Selbstständigkeit und Ownership.

Vertriebssteuerung & Performance

  • Du übersetzt unsere Unternehmens- und Sales-Ziele in klare Ziele und Erwartungen für das Team.
  • Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit den KAMs Umsatz, Pipeline, Account-Entwicklung und Neukundenakquisition.
  • Du stellst eine belastbare Pipeline und einen realistischen Forecast sicher.
  • Du erkennst frühzeitig Risiken, Pipeline-Lücken und Performance-Abweichungen und leitest gemeinsam mit dem Team konkrete Maßnahmen ein.
  • Du führst regelmäßige Account- und Opportunity Reviews durch und stellst sicher, dass die richtigen Strategien und nächsten Schritte verfolgt werden.

Sales Excellence

  • Du etablierst klare und einheitliche Vertriebsstandards.
  • Du entwickelst Best Practices und sorgst dafür, dass diese im gesamten Team angewendet werden.
  • Du stärkst eine konsequente Akquisitions-, Wachstums- und Abschlussorientierung.
  • Du entwickelst das Team von reaktiver Kundenbetreuung hin zu aktiver und strategischer Geschäftsentwicklung.
  • Du stärkst die Ownership für Pipeline, Umsatz und nachhaltiges Subskriptionswachstum.

Player-Coach – ca. 20 % eigene Sales-Aktivität

Du bleibst selbst nah am Markt und an unseren Kunden. Rund 20 % deiner Zeit investierst du in eigene operative Vertriebsaktivitäten.

Dabei übernimmst du bewusst eine begrenzte Anzahl eigener Accounts und Opportunities, betreibst selbst Neukundenakquisition und arbeitest bei ausgewählten strategischen oder komplexen Opportunities gemeinsam mit deinen KAMs.

Deine eigene Vertriebsarbeit hat vor allem einen Zweck: Du machst Best Practices vor, bleibst nah am Markt und bringst deine Erfahrung direkt in das Coaching deines Teams ein.

Qualifikation

Du bist ein erfahrener Sales-Profi und hast selbst erfolgreich komplexe Vertriebsprozesse gesteuert.

Du bringst insbesondere Erfahrung mit in:

  • erfolgreicher Neukundenakquisition
  • strategischer Account-Entwicklung
  • komplexen Sales-Prozessen
  • Value Selling
  • Entscheider-Management
  • Verhandlung und Closing
  • Pipeline- und Forecast-Management
  • Partner- und Ecosystem-Selling
  • unternehmerischem und kaufmännischem Denken

Idealerweise hast du bereits Führungserfahrung im Vertrieb gesammelt oder möchtest den nächsten Schritt vom Senior KAM zum Head of Sales gehen.

Wichtig ist uns vor allem: Du kannst nicht nur selbst verkaufen – du kannst Vertriebskompetenz auf andere übertragen.

Was dich in dieser Rolle auszeichnet:

Du bist Coach und Führungskraft, ohne deinen Sales-Hintergrund zu verlieren.

Du gibst Orientierung, stellst klare Erwartungen und forderst Ergebnisse ein. Gleichzeitig verstehst du, dass nachhaltiger Vertriebserfolg entsteht, wenn Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen und sich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln.

Dein Führungsprinzip:

Vormachen → gemeinsam machen → Verantwortung übergeben.

description_html:
Pflichtpraktikum ab 6 Monaten | Remote-first | Raum für eigene Projekte

Du willst im Praktikum nicht nur mitlaufen, sondern eigene Ideen einbringen? Dann bist du bei Karriereweg richtig.

Bei uns arbeitest du an echten Projekten in der Personalberatung rund um Prozesse, Automatisierung, KI, digitale Tools, CRM und modernen Workflows. Du unterstützt uns dabei, Abläufe klarer zu strukturieren, wiederkehrende Aufgaben smarter zu lösen und digitale Arbeitsweisen in der Personalberatung weiterzuentwickeln.

Karriereweg verbindet Marketing, Sales, CRM, KI-gestützte Prozesse und digitale Workflows — genau diese Kombination prägt auch Deine Aufgaben im Praktikum.

Aufgaben

Woran du arbeiten kannst

Je nach Interesse und Schwerpunkt kannst du unter anderem an folgenden Themen mitwirken:

  • Workflows unser Projekte analysieren und dokumentieren
    Du schaust dir bestehende Abläufe an, strukturierst einzelne Schritte und hilfst dabei, Prozesse verständlicher und besser nutzbar zu machen.
  • Automatisierungspotenziale erkennen
    Du identifizierst wiederkehrende Aufgaben und entwickelst Ideen, wie diese einfacher, klarer oder effizienter ablaufen könnten.
  • Tools und Schnittstellen recherchieren
    Du vergleichst digitale Tools, prüfst mögliche Einsatzbereiche und bereitest Vorschläge für die praktische Umsetzung vor.
  • KI-gestützte Rechercheprozesse testen
    Du probierst aus, wie KI bei Markt-, Wettbewerbs-, Zielgruppen- oder Kandidatenrecherchen sinnvoll unterstützen kann — und dokumentierst, was wirklich funktioniert.
  • Prompts entwickeln und verbessern
    Du testest, wie gute Prompts aufgebaut sein müssen, damit Ergebnisse nutzbar, nachvollziehbar und qualitativ sinnvoll sind.

Das Besondere an dieser Stelle

Du erstellst nicht nur Content – du arbeitest mit einem KI-gestützten Marketing-System. Du nutzt, richtest ein und optimierst KI-Agenten, die Contentplanung, Social-Media-Abläufe und wiederkehrende Marketingprozesse unterstützen.

Aufgaben

KI-Agenten & automatisierte Marketingprozesse

• KI-Agenten für Contentplanung, Social Media, Kampagnen und Marketingprozesse im Arbeitsalltag einsetzen und sicher bedienen.

• Bestehende KI-Agenten und Abläufe kontinuierlich optimieren und Verbesserungsideen in die Praxis überführen.

• Contentpläne, Redaktionspläne und Social-Media-Pläne mit Unterstützung von KI entwickeln und weiterpflegen.

• Wiederkehrende Aufgaben automatisieren und digitale Anwendungen sinnvoll miteinander verbinden – beispielsweise mit Make oder vergleichbaren Tools.

• Marketingprozesse dokumentieren, testen und so weiterentwickeln, dass sie zuverlässig und effizient funktionieren.

Qualifikation

Content Creation & digitale Kanäle

• Ideen für Posts, Stories, Reels, Newsletter, Landingpages und Kampagnen entwickeln – von der Konzeption bis zur Veröffentlichung.

• Fotos und kurze Videos für unsere Kommunikation erstellen und mit geeigneten Apps bearbeiten. Ein hochwertiges Smartphone ist dafür völlig ausreichend.

• Landingpages und One-Page-Websites mit vorhandenen Templates pflegen und bei Bedarf neue Vorlagen aufbauen.

• Newsletter und E-Mail-Marketing-Kampagnen erstellen, vorbereiten und versenden – idealerweise mit KlickTipp.

• Plakate, Kundenstopper und weitere Werbemittel für Print und Online gestalten.

Du passt zu uns, wenn du ...

• im Master Digital Marketing, Marketing Science, Online-Marketing, Medien, Kommunikation, Digitalen Medien, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang studierst.

• bereits praktische Erfahrung im digitalen Marketing gesammelt hast und Dinge gern selbst umsetzt.

• Social Media sicher nutzt und ein gutes Gespür für Texte, Bilder, Videos und Gestaltung mitbringst.

• Interesse daran hast, KI nicht nur für Texte, sondern auch für Content, Ideenentwicklung, Bild, Video, Planung und Marketingprozesse einzusetzen.

• neugierig darauf bist, KI-Agenten praktisch zu bedienen, einzurichten, zu testen und laufend zu verbessern.

• dich schnell in neue digitale Anwendungen einarbeitest und keine Scheu davor hast, Tools selbst auszuprobieren.

• Erfahrung mit Canva oder vergleichbaren Design-Tools sowie mit Webseiten oder Landingpages hast.

• Erfahrung oder Interesse an Asana für Aufgabenplanung und Zusammenarbeit mitbringst.

• strukturiert, zuverlässig und eigenständig arbeitest – auch wenn mehrere Themen parallel laufen.

Wichtig: Du musst noch kein KI-Profi sein.

Wir erwarten keine professionelle Kamerabedienung und keine Programmierausbildung. Entscheidend ist, dass du digitale Zusammenhänge verstehen möchtest, gerne ausprobierst und bereit bist, dich in KI-Agenten, Apps und Automatisierungen einzuarbeiten. Die benötigten Anwendungen und ein hochwertiges Smartphone-Setup stellen wir dir zur Verfügung.

Benefits

Was wir dir bieten

• Kein klassischer Werkstudentenjob mit reinen Zuarbeiten: Du erhältst einen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich und sichtbare Aufgaben.

• Abwechslungsreiche Zielgruppen und Themen durch die Arbeit für eine Pflegeeinrichtung und unsere Gastronomie in MARTINIS.

• Digitale Tools und Anwendungen, die dir für deine Arbeit zur Verfügung gestellt werden.

• Ein Umfeld, in dem Eigeninitiative, Lernbereitschaft und gute Ideen ausdrücklich erwünscht sind.

So sieht Dein Arbeitsalltag aus:

Du kannst kurzfristig eine Veranstaltungsankündigung gestalten, einen Social-Media-Plan vorbereiten, einen KI-Agenten für die Contentplanung verbessern, eine Landingpage aufbauen, Produktfotos erstellen, einen Newsletter fertigstellen oder einen Marketingprozess effizienter machen. Du planst nicht nur – du setzt um und siehst, was daraus entsteht.

Uns interessiert nicht nur, was du bereits kannst, sondern auch, wie du an neue Tools und Aufgaben herangehst.

title: Senior Engineering Manager (hands-on) - Alan Clinic

description_html:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🤖 Who we are

Alan Clinic. A health companion and a digital clinic for everyone.

We're a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise. The Clinic is two crews building one experience:

  • Mo. An intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care. We kicked off in 2023 and launched Mo to all our French members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe.

  • Clinic Platform. The medical services behind the conversation: chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation, and care programs across primary care, mental health, and physiotherapy.

Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise (through chat, voice, or video) with AI agents working in tandem with real doctors and the health system. That's what we are building 🤖🏥.

🚀 What you'll build and who you'll work with

We're building a medical experience that works reliably, safely, and at scale. An AI agent, and the clinic behind it. You'll lead the engineering team and you'll keep building alongside them.

The crews work at the intersection of product engineering, ML engineering, and medical expertise. As their engineering leader, you own:

  • 💬 The team behind the most memorable chatting experience. Hiring, onboarding, honest feedback, and the mix of skills Mo needs as it grows. Talent density is yours to own.

  • ➕ The architecture for Mo's next chapters. More context, new skills, new countries. You guide the calls on our architecture and agentic framework, and you stay close enough to the code to make them well.

  • 🏥 The platform that turns conversations into care. Chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation at national scale, and the tooling doctors and therapists use every day. You drive alignment with the crews and medical teams on the other side, so members get from words to actions.

  • 🛡️ Operational excellence. Mo and teleconsultation are real-time services that have to be live 24/7. Latency, error rates, incident response, and an on-call rotation that doesn't burn people out.

If you're excited by the idea of building the future of healthcare, this is the team for you. We're at the start of the journey. If you're curious, here is a paper we published recently.

⚡ Why this role is special

  • Dual impact: Shape both technical excellence and team growth - your engineers become better while building better products

  • Leadership growth: Influence engineering culture, mentor future leaders, and drive technical strategy that shapes the future of healthcare delivery

  • Startup speed, Alan's platform. Mo operates with the focus of a startup, on top of Alan's infrastructure, distribution, and health expertise. Small team, huge reach.

  • Stakes that make the work matter. In medical AI, reliability and safety are the product. Every call you make on quality, architecture, and evaluation is a call about our members' health.

🔍 What we're looking for

We're looking for an engineering leader who gets excited about building state-of-the-art AI systems and applying them to real-world, high-stakes problems in healthcare.

Leadership experience

  • 3+ years leading engineering teams, with a track record of building high performers.

  • You partner with other product functions as a true equal: you shape the roadmap, name trade-offs honestly, and help the team commit to what it can actually deliver.

Technical foundations

  • Experience establishing engineering excellence standards, with the ability to guide architectural decisions.

  • First-hand experience shipping AI or LLM products to production is a big plus.

  • You're excited and eager to keep writing code. You still review it, and you still ship some yourself.

  • Comfortable with modern development practices and AI-assisted development tools.

What we value

  • Curious, self-starting, humble, collaborative, and eager to grow.

  • You develop people as much as you develop products.

  • Ex-founders are typically a great fit in our team.

Mission alignment

  • Healthcare technology and innovation excite you

  • You understand that great engineering teams are built on psychological safety and continuous learning

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply!

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

⭐️ The role ⭐️

As Alan Senior Life and income protection (Prévoyance) Insurance, you will be responsible for the 360° view of the technical performance of the Life and income protection (French Prevoyance) business, including profitability, pricing, support to underwriting, new products launch and reinsurance.

Profitability

  • Build and improve the Alan Life and income protection reserving, monitoring and profitability steering methodology, computation and tooling (accounting, best estimate).

  • Explain profitability, identify its key drivers, market trends, and assess the implications for renewals, including pricing and guarantee adjustments.

  • Develop the tools and analytics needed to forecast the portfolio performance and margin at scale, connecting to Finance & Risk.

  • Connect the dots with Prevention initiatives, including the relationship between Prévoyance coverage and absenteeism prevention.

Pricing

  • Define and improve methodologies for both theoretical and experience pricing.

  • Adapt analyses to the specific characteristics of each business segment, including small amounts, high-severity claims, and newly launched segments.

  • Contribute to the portfolio renewal strategies, in close collaboration with internal teams (Strategy, Product, Sales, etc.) and external stakeholders (insurer, reinsurers).

Underwriting & product launch

  • Support underwriting teams throughout the year with technical analysis, guidelines, ad hoc methodologies, as well as automation initiatives.

  • Provide technical input to the launch of new products or geographies.

  • Contribute to the reinsurance plans definition and optimisation year on year, including partnership management.

Team Growth

  • Create processes and resources to strengthen the team’s ability to price and steer the Prevoyance portfolio.

  • Support the identification and hiring of new talents for the Insurance team.

  • Build internal knowledge of Prévoyance both for newcomers onboarding and stakeholders upskilling.

⭐️ Is it you we’re looking for? ⭐️

You would be a good fit if you:

  • Have experience in insurance, portfolio monitoring and pricing

  • Are comfortable about both going deep on technical aspects, and keep a high level vision on the strategy and execution priorities and pace

  • Have a scientific background (statistics, actuarial sciences) and are capable of understanding technical, data, regulatory, and business questions related to death & disability insurance/reinsurance

  • Are comfortable with coding (SQL, and ideally R / Python), but also leverage AI in both your daily work and on data assets.

  • Are analytical and structured, with a fact-based decision-making style

  • Are enthusiastic about teamwork, curious, learning, teaching, and stakeholder management

  • Are willing to deeply change the insurance industry and challenge the status quo

  • Have strong written communication skills, including with a broad range of stakeholders like underwriting, finance, strategy, risk, product, and local teams

  • Are fluent in English (Alan’s working language)

⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job

Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership.

You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team, whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost.

Why is this role interesting?

  • High-impact scope: You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers.

  • Real ownership: You'll own initiatives end to end, from strategy and design to execution and adoption, not just delivery.

  • Builder's playground: You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale.

  • Tangible results: Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate.

What will you do with us?

You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works.

You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks.

 

⭐ Is it you we're looking for?

You'll be a great fit for the Revenue Operations team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 5 years of experience in a similar role (RevOps, Sales Ops, or Sales Effectiveness);

  • Demonstrate strong ownership and project management skills, and are comfortable running initiatives without hand-holding;

  • Have a builder mindset and love being hands-on;

  • Are confident with change management, including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating;

  • Have at least intermediate SQL queries reading skills. Being able to write and own queries autonomously is a nice to have.

  • Have proven experience with low-code tools and integrations (e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows

  • Have direct hands-on experience in Salesforce and/or Outreach (not just awareness or admin-level use)

  • Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce actionable insights, with clear business impact

  • Have excellent verbal and written communication skills;

  • Have full working proficiency in French and at least an advanced level in English.

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

For this role we are looking to hire within the C1-E level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

description_html:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job

Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership.

You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team, whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost.

Why is this role interesting?

  • High-impact scope: You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers.

  • Real ownership: You'll own initiatives end to end, from strategy and design to execution and adoption, not just delivery.

  • Builder's playground: You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale.

  • Tangible results: Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate.

What will you do with us?

You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works.

You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks.

 

⭐ Is it you we're looking for?

You'll be a great fit for the Revenue Operations team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 5 years of experience in a similar role (RevOps, Sales Ops, or Sales Effectiveness);

  • Demonstrate strong ownership and project management skills, and are comfortable running initiatives without hand-holding;

  • Have a builder mindset and love being hands-on;

  • Are confident with change management, including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating;

  • Have at least intermediate SQL queries reading skills. Being able to write and own queries autonomously is a nice to have.

  • Have proven experience with low-code tools and integrations (e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows

  • Have direct hands-on experience in Salesforce and/or Outreach (not just awareness or admin-level use)

  • Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce actionable insights, with clear business impact

  • Have excellent verbal and written communication skills;

  • Have full working proficiency in French and at least an advanced level in English.

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

For this role we are looking to hire within the C1-E level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

⭐️ The Business Segment Lead role ⭐️

At Alan, we split the French market in several business segments, each of them corresponding to a category of clients (whether by size, or industry).

The role of a Business Segment Lead is to reach market leadership in their given segment. To succeed, you will have to (1) articulate a vision for your segment, (2) define priorities and resources to deliver, and (3) make strategic decisions for your segment based on market insights.

The Business Segment Lead role is made for transversal influence as we operate based on distributed ownership. You will work closely with all teams involved in the success of your segment (Product, Insurance, Sales, Marketing). You will also collaborate with other segment leaders to build-up knowledge, share best practices, and create alignment around a long-term value plan.

Main missions include:

  • Market intelligence: You’ll build expertise on our market and competitive landscape. You’ll work both on the quantitative side (sizing) and the qualitative side (customers’ pain points and needs).

  • Value proposition and pricing: Our goal is to differentiate our offer from the market. You’ll relentlessly ask yourself: what is the best product offering to become leader in this segment?

  • Go-to-Market strategy: You’ll work both on renewal (account management) and expansion strategy (business development). This will require you to adapt and innovate when it comes to distribution channels, sub-segments, and partners management.

  • P&L ownership & Resources allocation: You’ll own the return on investment of your segment and are in charge of building the case for internal resources allocation based on your P&L.

  • Product trade-off: You’ll work together with product teams in order for us to build the best product based on market insights.

We are currently hiring for new segments:

  • It gathers several, high potential sub-segments where everything is to be built.

  • We will focus heavily on those new opportunities in the coming years.

  • At least 8 years of prior experience leading a business (product category, business segment, etc.)

  • Full working proficiency in French

  • An exceptional ability to establish transversal influence

  • Used to analyze and manipulate data to build a 360 degree view of your market

  • A strong business sense while being able to go deep into product considerations

  • Able to articulate clear strategies in spite of complexity/uncertainty

  • A prior experience working with senior leadership

  • You are a generalist self-starter (Vs a specialist of 1 single industry) able to adapt fast and not afraid to go on the field to support your team mates and learn from them

  • You are based in (or willing to relocate to) either Paris, Bordeaux, Lyon, Marseille, Brussels, Madrid or Barcelona.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Disclaimer: We're open to hire Account Executives across our Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes and Biarritz offices.

⭐️ The Account Executive (Small Businesses) job

Your mission

Join our Small Businesses team targeting companies with 10-30 employees across tech, consulting, and business services, the market segment where Alan has the strongest product-market fit and brand recognition. You'll work in a high-velocity environment with strong conversion rates, and the opportunity to make an immediate impact on hundreds of growing French companies.

What you'll own

  • Full sales cycle: From prospection to closing

  • Strategic relationships: Drive deals and manage key customer relationships

  • Education & demos: Deliver inspiring product demonstrations and guide stakeholders through the evaluation process

The Alan way of selling

We've developed the Alan Smart & Soft selling method:

  • Smart: Leverage precise messaging and materials to educate and inspire

  • Soft: Create tailored, high-touch strategies for each prospect

  • Experience: Deliver a seamless journey that reflects Alan's customer-first approach

Beyond sales

As an Alan team member, you'll:

  • Shape our product evolution

  • Contribute to improving our methods and strategy

  • Participate in growth initiatives

  • Be part of a collaborative team that thinks big

Join us in revolutionizing healthcare through technology and human connection 🌟

Meet Estelle Berdugo one of our Account Executives.


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Small Businesses Team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 3 years of experience managing the whole Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. Prospection is a key part of the role;

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English.

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills;

  • Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems;

  • Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building;

  • Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models;

  • Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team;

  • Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1;

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the B1-C0 level range.

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France.


Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

⭐️ The mission of the Union Relations Lead

Unions and social partners play a central and legitimate role in how social protection is designed, negotiated and implemented in France. We're looking for a Union Relations Lead to build and animate Alan's relationships with unions, their federations, and the broader paritariste ecosystem, making Alan a trusted, substantive and well-known interlocutor of French social partners, and supporting our Enterprise & Public Sector teams across large private employers and public institutions.


⭐ What makes this role genuinely unique

  • You'll shape how one of Europe's fastest-growing health tech companies builds its relationships with the French social partner ecosystem (from confederations to sector federations to paritariste institutions).

  • You'll operate at the highest levels of the paritariste ecosystem: CFDT and FO confederal leadership, sector federations, IP boards, organisations patronales.

  • You'll shape the strategy, not just execute it. Alan is at an early stage of building this capability (the playbook is yours to define)

  • You'll work directly with Founders, Public Affair as well as Public Sector and Enterprise leadership.

  • Real ownership from day one, in one of the fastest-growing tech unicorns in Europe.

⭐️ Your role

Relationships & Presence

  • Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships with the organizations that represent employees and members across the sectors that matter to Alan (unions, federations, and the structures that convene them).

  • Map the ecosystem, prioritize interlocutors, and design the engagement strategy at confederal, federal and branch level.

  • Represent Alan in federations, working groups, congrès and paritariste institutions where our sector’s future is discussed.

  • Be the credible consistent Alan voice social partners recognise

Partnership with Alan's Enterprise & Public Sector work

  • Be a partner to our teams serving large private employers and public sector clients, briefing them on the social partners context and how Alan’s offer speaks to their priorities

  • Introduce the right contacts at the right moment in the commercial cycle, turning Alan’s ecosystem relationships into concrete commercial leverage.

  • Share Alan’s content with social partners to help them assess Alan on its merits and form their own view.

Sector Engagement & Anticipation

  • Follow the dialogue at branch level and across the paritariste ecosystem and turn that understanding into internal clarity.

  • Represent Alan in the federations and working groups where our sector's future is discussed, contributing a constructive and recognizable voice.

  • Be a sharp, early internal voice on where social dialogue is heading and on the implications for Alan's strategy.

Build & Scale

  • Knowledge base: Build and maintain a knowledge library on social partner positions, branch agreements, and paritariste institutions shared with Enterprise and Public Sector deal teams to increase win rates.

  • Framework & tools: Implement processes and AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of our social partner engagement and documentation.

  • Collaboration: Share best practices with the broader Enterprise & Public Sector team and contribute proven methodologies to their scaled commercial operations.

  • Market intelligence: Provide competitive intelligence on how social partners and competitors position themselves in our key markets.


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Union Relations Lead role at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 8 years of total experience in social partner relations: in a union organization, a branch federation, a paritariste institution, or in an external affairs role at a mutelle, IP or insurer

  • Have legitimate credibility at federation level: ability to engage federation leadership as a peer, built through a personal representative past or years of substantive engagement at federation level on employer side.

  • Have deep knowledge of the paritariste ecosystem: branch agreements, confederal mandates, protection sociale reforms, and how institutions at each level function

  • Have proven ability to build trust with social partners from the employer/state side

  • Have outstanding stakeholder management: calm, long-game, trustworthy, discreet, able to represent Alan substantively without making it about yourself.

  • Have ability to translate Alan’s product and strategy into compelling narratives for social partner audiences

  • Demonstrable impact from prior social-partner work on an organization’s commercial and strategic outcomes

  • Are a self-starter: comfortable building from scratch in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

  • Are ego-free and lever-minded: you accelerate others, you don't seek the spotlight.

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris.

Nice to have:

  • A confederal or federal elected / permanent past.

  • Experience inside a paritariste institution

  • Experience inside a sector federation on its social dialogue agenda.

  • Legal background in droit social and comfort reading accords collectifs quickly.

  • International exposure to the European social dialogue ecosystem.

  • Prior experience with RFPs or tenders involving union-negotiated or paritariste schemes.


Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.
