⭐️ The Account Executive (mid-market) job

We’re expanding our Sales team in France and are looking for ‘full-stack’ Sales to engage with prospects and turn them into happy Alan customers. You will join a team that focuses on companies from one of the following segments: Tech & Engineering, Business Services & Media, Retail, Transport, HCR, Learn & Care, Food & Beverage or Metallurgy.

You will interact with everyone from HR executives to CEOs.

Meet Hakim in this article to learn more about makes the Metallurgy segment so interesting for an Account Executive.

Why is our Vertical approach interesting?

  • Market potential: Vast and dynamic markets with significant structural challenges, offering fertile ground for a modern, tech-driven solution like Alan.

  • Team readiness: We've honed our go-to-market strategy over the years, and it's paying off with increasing inbound leads and active field marketing driving strong pipeline momentum.

  • Passionate teams: Our dedicated teams brings deep sector expertise and genuine passion for the clients we serve; every day in the field sharpens our edge and fuels our conviction.

  • Growth opportunity: The addressable market is enormous, offering virtually unlimited opportunities for growth.

What will you do with us?

You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. The average sales cycle is 4-6 months, dealing with companies ranging from 30 to 300 employees, with an average ARR of 150K€.

At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects. We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless.

We expect you to understand and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method ensures the prospect experience is an integral part of the overall Alan customer experience—making it pleasant and delightful for everyone. We expect you to be instructive to prospects (Smart), as well as to define the best personalized high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company, challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base.

Meet Fanny Cibot who is Account Executive within the Business Services & Media Crew.

You’ll be a great fit for the Metallurgy Team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 4 years of experience managing the whole Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. Prospection is a key part of the role;

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English.

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills;

  • Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems;

  • Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building;

  • Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models;

  • Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team;

  • Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1;

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range.

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France.


Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

⭐️ The User Researcher role ⭐️

At Alan, research is not a checkpoint. It's a compass. Our User Research team sits at the intersection of product, design, and engineering, making sure every decision is grounded in what our members actually need, feel, and experience.

As a User Researcher at Alan, you will gather and prioritize the most important questions from across the company, and design the right research to answer them. That means running interviews, diary studies, surveys, and usability sessions throughout the full product cycle, not just at the end. You'll then turn those findings into insights that are clear, compelling, and genuinely useful to the teams who need them.

You'll work hand in hand with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers, and collaborate closely with our analytics and data science teams to tell a complete story about our product. You'll also help grow research culture across Alan, sharing your craft and mentoring teammates along the way.

At Alan, great research drives great product. If you love figuring out what people truly need and translating that into decisions that matter, this role is for you.

⭐️ If you have some of the following, you may be a great fit ⭐️

You may be a great fit at Alan if you have:

  • 4+ years of experience as a product/user researcher in a tech environment, with strong hands-on expertise in qualitative methods: interviews, diary studies, think-aloud usability testing, and direct observation

  • Solid quantitative research skills: you're comfortable with survey design, sampling, crosstabs, and core statistical concepts

  • Sharp critical thinking: you quickly identify what research is worth doing, scope it efficiently, and deliver insights that are focused and actionable

  • A strategic mindset: you know how to partner with product stakeholders, communicate the value of research, and tie your findings to concrete business impact

  • Compelling communication skills: you turn complex findings into clear narratives that resonate with any audience

  • Experience mentoring junior researchers or non-researchers, with the ability to give clear, actionable feedback that helps others grow

  • You're close to AI. Either you've built AI products, or you follow the space closely and have a clear view on where to leverage and how LLM systems behave in production.

  • You care about healthcare. Alan's mission has to genuinely matter to you. For us this is essential, not a nice-to-have.

  • English fluency, written and spoken

  • (As a plus) Fluency in French, Spanish, or another European language

For this role, we hire within the D-E level range.

Alan operates at the intersection of health insurance, prevention, and regulated data. The person in this role owns the security governance and risk posture of a company that handles sensitive health data for 1M+ members, operates under DORA and HDS certification requirements, and is regulated by the ACPR. They work in close partnership with Legal, Internal Audit, and the broader Risk function. It's a highly collaborative role.

🛡️ Your mission: Governance, risk & compliance

Own and operate the ISO 27001 ISMS. You are the accountable owner of the Information Security Management System: scope definition, Statement of Applicability, internal audit programme, and management review. You've led at least one full certification or recertification cycle and know what breaks down in the months between audits.

Be the security expert on regulatory and privacy matters. Legal leads on DORA, HDS, RGPD, PGSSI-S, and regulatory relationships. Your role is to bring the technical and operational security substance: translating regulatory requirements into controls, flagging implementation gaps, and making sure the security programme is solid when the regulatory team negotiates with the ACPR or ANS.

Run risk as an ongoing programme, in partnership with the broader risk function. You lead security risk cartography using EBIOS RM and ensure it feeds into, and is informed by, the company-wide risk framework. You facilitate risk workshops, produce treatment plans, and bring the security lens to forums where non-security risks are also on the table. You know when a security risk is really a business risk.

Own the controls framework, but distribute ownership of controls themselves. You define the framework, set the standards, and track coverage, but the controls live with the teams who build and run the things they protect. You work closely with Infrastructure, Platform, and Engineering to ensure foundational building blocks (identity, network, secrets management, logging) are designed with security requirements built in from the start. You work alongside those teams as a partner.

Run audit cycles with rigour, in close partnership with Internal Audit. You manage the security audit programme and coordinate with certification bodies. You work with Internal Audit to align scopes, avoid duplication, and present a coherent picture of control effectiveness to the board. You've sat in joint audit planning sessions and know how to make that relationship work well.

Manage third-party risk. You run vendor security assessments and define contractual security requirements (security annexes, DPAs). You partner with our Risk team, which oversees third-party risk, and own the security dimension.

Bring the health sector context. You understand the ANS framework, CERT Santé requirements, and what it means to handle sensitive health data in day-to-day operations. You're a useful partner to Legal when the question is "what does this regulation actually require us to do technically?"

Own incident governance and support DORA reporting. You classify and escalate ICT incidents internally, own BCP and DRP governance, and provide the security substance for DORA incident reports.

🚀 What you'll build and who you'll work with

Compliance Framework: ISO 27001, DORA, HDS, NIS2. Multiple regulators, multiple countries, one coherent governance backbone. Build the system that lets Alan scale from 1M to many millions of members without rebuilding compliance every time.

Automated Audit & Evidence Engine: Replace manual evidence collection with scripted pipelines plugged directly into engineering systems. Turn audit cycles into a continuous capability instead of a quarterly rush.

Risk Cartography: Risk treated as an operational signal that feeds directly into business and engineering decisions, with EBIOS RM at the core.

You'll work closely with Legal, DPO, Internal Audit, and the broader Risk function, and partner day-to-day with Infrastructure, Platform, Engineering, Product, and Operations. You're the bridge between regulatory complexity and operational simplicity.

⚡ Why this role is special

Direct Impact: You own the trust foundation that lets Alan handle health data for 1M+ members and operate in highly regulated markets. Your work is the precondition for everything else Alan does.

Complex Problems: 4 regulators across 4 countries, sensitive health data, and a regulatory landscape that keeps shifting (DORA, NIS2, AI Act), all to be modeled into a single, coherent control system.

Ownership & Growth: Board and executive exposure, real influence on company-wide risk decisions, and the autonomy to shape Alan's security culture across 800+ people.

🤝 What you will also do: Technical enablement

Automate compliance work wherever possible. You script evidence collection, automate control testing, and connect GRC tooling to engineering pipelines. You've used Python or similar to reduce the manual work of an audit cycle, and you actively look for the next process to streamline.

Configure and own GRC tooling. You can administer platforms like CISO Assistant, ServiceNow GRC, or Archer, designing workflows, building dashboards, and making them genuinely useful for the teams that feed them data.

Speak cloud governance fluently. You understand shared responsibility in HDS-qualified environments, know what CSPM tools surface and what they miss, and can reason about policy-as-code (OPA, SCP) without needing an engineer to translate.

Read architecture well enough to challenge it. You can review a proposed architecture, identify control gaps in identity, network segmentation, encryption, or logging, and push back credibly with engineers even though you're not one.

Interpret vulnerability data and drive prioritisation. You read scan outputs, work with engineering teams to prioritise remediation by business impact over CVSS score alone, and track resolution KPIs over time.

⭐️ Qualifications, mindset and soft skills

You translate risk into business language. You can brief a board or an audit committee and leave them genuinely informed. You know the difference between a finding that requires an emergency board call and one that belongs in a quarterly report.

You influence without authority. You align Legal, DPO, Risk, Engineering, Product, and Operations on security requirements without creating blockers or adversarial dynamics. People come to you early because you make their work easier.

You manage programmes with audit-grade rigor. You run structured, traceable roadmaps. You know where every commitment is, who owns it, and when it's due. You escalate proactively and don't let dependencies surprise you.

You build a genuine security culture. Your awareness programmes land because they're relevant to the people who take them. You foster proportionate risk ownership across the company, so teams make better day-to-day decisions.

You think in principles when frameworks shift. DORA is live. NIS2 transposition pace varies. The AI Act is arriving. When the regulatory landscape moves, you reason from first principles and adapt without waiting to be told what to do.

title: Senior Finance Manager Germany (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Andris Consulting GmbH
description_html:
Finance bekommt Ihre Handschrift.

Was würden Sie aufbauen, wenn Sie Finance für ein wachsendes Deutschlandgeschäft gestalten könnten?

Als businessnaher Senior Finance Manager entwickeln Sie die Finance-Funktion der deutschen Niederlassung eines internationalen Generikaherstellers. Sie sind die zentrale Finance-Person vor Ort und gestalten mit dem Country Manager die nächsten Schritte des Geschäfts. Der Konzern verfügt über eigene Wirkstoff- und Arzneimittelherstellung.

Vielleicht liegt Ihr Schwerpunkt heute in Commercial Finance, Controlling oder FP&A. Vielleicht verbinden Sie Finance und Markt bereits im Pricing, Tender Management, Pharmagroßhandel oder Arzneimittelimport. Entscheidend sind Ihr fundiertes Finance-Profil und praktische Erfahrung mit der Finanzmechanik des deutschen Generikageschäfts. Auch eine frühere Station kann dafür die Grundlage sein.

ANDRIS Consulting begleitet die Besetzung als Personalberatung im Auftrag des Unternehmens. Die Anstellung erfolgt beim Auftraggeber.

Aufgaben

  • Geschäftsideen weiterentwickeln: Sie bewerten neue Produkte und Marketinginitiativen, rechnen Szenarien durch und erarbeiten mit dem Country Manager Empfehlungen für Investitionen.
  • Gross-to-net verantworten: Sie gestalten die Prozesse rund um Krankenkassenrabatte, stimmen Forderungen ab und sorgen für nachvollziehbare Rückstellungen, Preisprüfungen und Freigaben.
  • Tender wirtschaftlich bewerten: Gemeinsam mit dem Head of Tender Management prüfen Sie Kalkulationen und gestalten tragfähige Angebote. Sie machen die Auswirkungen von Preisannahmen und Kosten auf die Marge sichtbar.
  • Finance mit dem Geschäft entwickeln: Sie verbessern Reporting und Abläufe, erkennen Risiken früh und begleiten die Umsetzung. Dabei arbeiten Sie auch mit Supply Chain und Logistik zusammen.
  • Planung und Liquidität steuern: Sie gestalten Forecasts mit Vertrieb und Supply Chain. Treasury und die laufende Liquiditätsübersicht für Deutschland verantworten Sie gemeinsam mit dem europäischen Finance-Team.
  • Das finanzielle Fundament sichern: Mit internen und externen Fachleuten stellen Sie Steuer- und Statistikmeldungen sicher, einschließlich Umsatz- und Körperschaftsteuer, und begleiten die Abschlussprüfung.

Qualifikation

  • Fundiertes Finance-Profil: Mindestens zehn Jahre Finance-Erfahrung, gerne auch in geschäftsnahen Aufgaben innerhalb von Pricing, Tender Management oder angrenzenden Bereichen.
  • Praktische Deutschland-Generika-Erfahrung: Sie kennen Gross-to-net, Krankenkassenrabatte und Rückstellungen aus eigener Arbeit und können Tender wirtschaftlich bewerten. Diese Erfahrung kann auch aus einer früheren Position oder einer passenden Aufgabe im Pharmagroßhandel beziehungsweise Arzneimittelimport stammen.
  • Freude am Business: Sie denken Geschäftsmöglichkeiten durch, vertreten Ihre Empfehlungen und möchten gemeinsam etwas aufbauen. Strategischer Blick und eigene Umsetzung gehören für Sie zusammen.
  • Sicheres Handwerk: Sehr gutes Excel und praktische Erfahrung mit SAP. Sie erklären wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge verständlich.
  • Deutsch und Englisch: Deutsch mindestens auf B2-Niveau, C1 bevorzugt, sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.
  • Hilfreiche Ergänzungen: Weiterführende Accounting- oder betriebswirtschaftliche Qualifikationen sowie Erfahrung mit dem Aufbau von Prozessen in einem wachsenden Unternehmen sind willkommen.

Benefits

  • Gestaltung in Deutschland: Sie übernehmen lokale Finance-Verantwortung und entwickeln die finanzielle Steuerung auf Basis vorhandener Prozesse weiter.
  • Nähe zu Geschäftsentscheidungen: Sie arbeiten eng mit dem Country Manager und dem Tender Management. Vor Ort berichten Sie an den Country Manager, fachlich an die europäische Finance-Leitung.
  • Zusammenarbeit in Frankfurt am Main: Hier entstehen Strategie und gemeinsame Entscheidungen. Gesucht ist jemand, der diesen persönlichen Austausch schätzt und vor Ort etwas entwickeln möchte.
  • Hybrid mit individueller Abstimmung: Ergänzende Remote-Anteile schaffen Spielraum für Beruf und Familie. Die Ausgestaltung stimmen Sie anhand der Aufgabe und Ihrer persönlichen Situation gemeinsam ab. Eine reine Remote-Tätigkeit ist nicht vorgesehen.

Das Vergütungspaket besprechen wir im persönlichen Austausch.

Was reizt Sie daran, Finance in Deutschland zu entwickeln?

Nutzen Sie die Bewerbungsfunktion und schreiben Sie uns ein paar Sätze dazu. Ein Motivationsschreiben brauchen Sie für den Einstieg nicht. Wir melden uns kurzfristig und behandeln Ihr Interesse vertraulich.

Christoph Andris
ANDRIS Consulting · Pharma Executive Search

description_html:
Alarmanlagen, Videoanlagen & IT – Leitstelle Potsdam

Eine Alarmanlage meldet eine technische Störung, eine Kamera liefert kein Bild oder ein Arbeitsplatzrechner funktioniert nicht richtig: Du gehst der Ursache auf den Grund und unterstützt bei der Lösung.

In unserer Leitstelle übernimmst du den technischen Erstsupport für Alarm- und Videoanlagen. Gleichzeitig unterstützt du unsere Mitarbeitenden bei alltäglichen IT-Problemen und richtest gemeinsam mit unserem IT-Administrator Rechner und Arbeitsplätze ein.

Du bearbeitest Standardfälle eigenständig innerhalb abgestimmter Abläufe. Bei komplexeren Problemen arbeitest du eng mit dem IT-Administrator und den zuständigen Technikern zusammen.

Aufgaben

• Technische Störungen aufnehmen und eingrenzen: Du klärst, was ausgefallen ist, welche Auswirkungen bestehen und welche Schritte bereits durchgeführt wurden.

• Erstsupport für Alarmanlagen: Du prüfst technische Störungsmeldungen, Erreichbarkeit und Verbindungen und unterstützt bei der Fehlerbehebung.

• Erstsupport für Videoanlagen: Du hilfst bei Problemen mit Kamerabildern, Übertragung, Zugriff und Verbindung.

• Unterstützung per Telefon und Fernzugriff: Du führst Kunden und Kollegen verständlich durch die erforderlichen Prüfschritte.

• Rechner und Arbeitsplätze einrichten: Gemeinsam mit dem IT-Administrator bereitest du Geräte, Software und Zubehör für den Einsatz vor.

• Alltägliche IT-Probleme lösen: Du kümmerst dich beispielsweise um Software-, Zugriffs-, Verbindungs- und Geräteprobleme.

• Komplexe Fälle sauber übergeben: Du dokumentierst Fehlerbild und bisherige Maßnahmen, damit der IT-Administrator oder ein zuständiger Techniker gezielt weiterarbeiten kann.

• Wiederkehrende Fehler nachvollziehbar machen: Du hältst Lösungen fest und hilfst dabei, Arbeitsabläufe und technische Anleitungen zu verbessern.

Qualifikation

• Technisches Verständnis und Freude daran, Fehler systematisch zu finden und zu beheben.

• Einen sicheren Umgang mit Computern, Software und technischen Geräten.

• Grundlagen zu Netzwerken und Verbindungen sowie Interesse an Alarm- und Videotechnik.

• Eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du prüfst Ursachen, statt wahllos Einstellungen zu verändern.

• Geduld und die Fähigkeit, technische Zusammenhänge verständlich auf Deutsch zu erklären.

• Zuverlässigkeit und einen verantwortungsvollen Umgang mit Kundendaten, Zugängen und sicherheitsrelevanten Systemen.

• Bereitschaft zur engen Zusammenarbeit mit Leitstelle, Technik und IT-Administrator.

• Ein einwandfreies Führungszeugnis.

Erfahrung im technischen Support, mit Sicherheitstechnik oder in der Arbeitsplatz-IT passt besonders gut zu dieser Aufgabe.

Benefits

Vollzeit · 32.000–36.000 € brutto pro Jahr.

Eine praktische technische Aufgabe direkt in unserer Leitstelle: Du unterstützt sowohl bei Störungen an Sicherheitstechnik als auch im täglichen IT-Betrieb. Dabei arbeitest du mit unserem IT-Administrator zusammen und bringst dich aktiv in die Fehlerbehebung ein.

Bewirb dich mit deinem Lebenslauf und beschreibe kurz, welche Erfahrungen du mit Alarmanlagen, Videoanlagen oder IT-Support mitbringst.

Stadtritter GmbH · Großbeerenstraße 139a · 14482 Potsdam

title: Principal, User Research
description_html:
ABOUT THE TEAM

At Mural, we believe great collaboration starts with deep understanding. Our mission is to help teams think and work together better. The Design and Research team uncovers the truths that power that mission, guiding product, design, and strategy through rigorous, human-centered inquiry. We combine behavioral science, market insight, and creative exploration to shape Mural’s future for how teams ideate, align, and collaborate together across the world.

YOUR MISSION

As the Principal, User Researcher at Mural, you’ll start a UX research practice and lead foundational and strategic research that shapes how the company defines its next generation of experiences. You’ll partner across product, design, sales, marketing, and strategy to identify new opportunity spaces, clarify evolving user needs, and guide the organization toward long-term innovation.

This is a primarily individual-contributor role focused on uncovering deep human collaboration insights that drive strategy, innovation, and long-term vision. You’ll also help shape and scale the UXR discipline at Mural by mentoring designers to confidently run tactical usability studies, and establishing the frameworks and best practices that elevate research across the company. Think of it as being the first research leader at a fast-growing startup, with the reach and resources of a global platform.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Player Responsibilities (Individual Contributor Work):

  • Lead mixed-methods research (qualitative and quantitative) that explores user needs, behaviors, and motivations across multiple product areas.

  • Drive foundational studies that reveal how teams collaborate and what barriers exist in business collaboration, hybrid, and distributed work.

  • Design and execute medium to large-scale studies that combine qualitative depth with quantitative rigor (surveys, logs analysis, segmentation, and concept testing).

  • Develop a tempo where actionable insights are timely and urgently positioned to shape key product decisions.

  • Translate ambiguous questions into clear learning plans and frameworks that guide product and strategy decisions.

  • Build artifacts (archetypes, frameworks, journey maps, mental models) that make complex insights accessible and actionable across the company, leveraging Mural products.

  • Present insights to an executive, cross-functional audience and provide strategic recommendations based on these insights.

Coach Responsibilities:

  • Build the research practice: mentor designers, and product partners in research best practices, helping to scale a culture of curiosity and evidence-based decision making.

  • Establish repeatable, high-quality research standards and methodologies across teams.

  • Partner with design and product leadership to shape Mural’s long-term research vision and roadmap.

  • Champion the role of research in early product strategy and company-wide initiatives.

Hybrid Responsibilities (Both Player & Coach):

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional leaders to prioritize research that informs Mural’s most critical next-generation bets.

  • Facilitate workshops and storytelling sessions that bring insights to life and influence direction across product, design, and business strategy.

  • Partner with Data Science and Market Research to integrate behavioral data, attitudinal insights, and business signals into cohesive, actionable narratives.

  • Shape how research connects to strategy, innovation, and experimentation at every level of the company.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • 10+ years of UX Research experience, including deep expertise in both qualitative and quantitative methods. PhD optional.

  • Proven track record leading foundational and strategic research that influenced product direction, vision, or long-term investments.

  • Ability to design and execute mixed-methods research independently: from ethnographic and in-depth interviews to survey design and statistical analysis.

  • Scale strategic insights: Experience driving organizational understanding through storytelling, synthesis, and actionable frameworks.

  • Strong systems thinking skills, with an ability to connect human insight to product architecture and long-term design strategy.

  • Experience shaping and scaling research practices in growing organizations.

  • Comfortable working in ambiguity and helping cross-functional teams find clarity and alignment.

  • Strong communicator who can engage both executive and hands-on audiences with empathy, clarity, and conviction.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE MURAL

You’ll shape new ways of working, as we interact with AI, team members, and customers. You’ll work on some of the most compelling and open-ended questions about the future of collaboration: how people align, make decisions, and innovate. You’ll have the freedom to define the big questions, run the right studies, and guide the company toward its next horizon.

At Mural, we “drink our own champagne” and leverage our product for online collaboration. This role is U.S. Remote. Your work will inform the strategy of a rapidly scaling company that believes research is the compass, not just the map.

Equal Opportunity

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

  • Du misst den Impact deiner Arbeit an klaren Zahlen und leitest daraus die nächsten Schritte ab

  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung (min. 1-3 Jahre) in Business Development, Operations oder Prozessmanagement

Unsere Vision: Wir vereinen das Skillset der besten kreativen und Daten getriebenen Menschen aus der Branche und skalieren so Ecom- und D2C Brands in ganz Europa.

❤️ Candor & Tough Love.

🧠 Always innovating.

💸 Creativity Sells.

🚀 Passion, fun and love.

description_html:
AlphaPrompt ist ein Münchner B2B-Software-Startup für die institutionelle Immobilienwirtschaft. Unsere Plattform hat zwei Säulen: einen intelligenten Datenraum, der das Dokumentenmanagement vollständig automatsiert, und einen Agentic Workspace, in dem KI-Agenten Prüfungen und Workflows übernehmen – von Mietverträgen über Nebenkostenabrechnungen bis zur Übergabe in Drittsysteme. Unsere Kunden sind derzeit über 50 (institutionelle) Asset- und Property-Manager in der DACH-Region, wir expandieren gerade aber in weitere Märkte.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

Du entwickelst die Plattform als solche weiter, damit AlphaPrompt im Kundenalltag reibungslos läuft: Vom Import bis zum Export, in enger Abstimmung mit unserem AI-Team mit dem Ziel: sauber integriert, getestet, für den Kunden nutzbar. Du arbeitest im Plattform-Team mit unserem Lead-Entwickler und eng mit den Gründern zusammen – und bekommst keine fertig zerlegten Kleinst-Tickets, sondern Themen mit Kontext und den Freiraum, sie selbst zu Ende zu denken.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Features über den ganzen Stack bauen – Backend in Python, Frontend in React – von der Idee bis zum Deployment.
  • KI-Funktionen und Agenten unseres AI-Teams in die Plattform integrieren – und verstehen, was dahinter passiert.
  • Das Onboarding neuer Kunden und Objekte vereinfachen: Konfiguration, die heute außerhalb passiert, in die Plattform bringen; Integrationen stabil weiterentwickeln.
  • Ergebnisse selbst prüfen und Kundenfeedback direkt in Verbesserungen übersetzen. Perspektivisch, wenn du willst: Ergebnisse direkt mit dem Kunden abstimmen.

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

  • Zwei bis vier Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise an einem SaaS-Produkt.
  • Full-Stack mit Schwerpunkt Backend (Python) – und du greifst auch ins Frontend (React/TypeScript), statt einen Bogen darum zu machen.
  • Produktverständnis: Du willst wissen, wofür ein Feature da ist, nimmst dir Themen eigenständig und denkst mit, statt nur Tickets abzuarbeiten.
  • Grundverständnis für LLM- und Agenten-basierte Anwendungen
  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch für die Arbeit mit deutschen Dokumenten, im Team und perspektivisch mit Kunden; gutes Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit im Team.
  • Du bist in München (oder ziehst her), willst im Office arbeiten und hast den Drive, dich hinzusetzen und zu bauen – schnell, pragmatisch, sauber.

Nice-to-have: Erfahrung mit ereignisgetriebenen Architekturen und Cloud-Betrieb, mit Dokumentenverarbeitung, OCR oder LLM-APIs – und Lust auf Kundenkontakt.

Benefits

Was wir bieten

  • Ein Produkt, das bei institutionellen Kunden im Einsatz ist – du siehst direkt, was dein Code beim Kunden bewirkt.
  • Kurze Wege: direkt mit den Gründern und dem Lead-Entwickler, Entscheidungen fallen im Raum, nicht im Ticket.
  • KI als Kern des Produkts, nicht als Buzzword – mit der Möglichkeit, dich Richtung KI-Entwicklung oder Kundenprojekte weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Verantwortung ab dem ersten Tag, Büro in München und eine faire Vergütung.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: Senior Embedded (ARM) Engineer - Quantum Computing (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at eleQtron GmbH
description_html:
eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future.

We are looking for a Senior Embedded (ARM) Engineer (m/f/d) to join us in Hamburg or Siegen and own the real-time firmware that turns our control electronics into a working quantum computer. You will work on our next-generation system, where the control electronics are being integrated into a single, highly integrated chip. You sit at the heart of the machine, between the hardware that generates the pulses and the higher-level software that describes the experiments. Timing is not a detail here; it is the product. You are the person who makes sure the right signal reaches the ions at the right nanosecond, reliably, run after run. 

Responsibilities:

  • Own the embedded firmware on our ARM-based control platform, from architecture through implementation to on-hardware debugging

  • Develop and maintain the real-time software layer that coordinates pulse sequencing, timing, and data flow across our highly integrated control chip

  • Write and maintain the low-level drivers and board support the hardware relies on

  • Guarantee deterministic, low-latency behaviour under hard real-time constraints

  • Lead firmware bring-up together with our electronics and physics teams, and debug at the boundary where software meets signal

  • Define the firmware architecture and engineering practices — build, test, and release processes for the embedded layer as the system matures

  • Contribute to the interfaces between the embedded layer and the rest of the stack, so experiments defined in software run correctly on the machine



Required Skills:

  • 5+ years of professional embedded software development for real-time or timing-critical systems

  • Deep command of C (and ideally C++) on ARM platforms, working close to the hardware

  • Experience with bare-metal and/or RTOS environments, and a clear understanding of when each is appropriate

  • Comfortable reading schematics and datasheets, and debugging real hardware with oscilloscopes, logic analysers, and JTAG

  • Strong grasp of real-time concepts: interrupts, DMA, timing, concurrency, and determinism

  • A track record of bringing up firmware on new hardware, not only maintaining existing systems

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with experimental physicists and engineers, and to turn imprecise physical requirements into robust firmware

  • Strong adaptability and a quick learning mindset

  • Good proficiency in English (written and spoken)

Nice to have (Bonus)

  • Experience on highly integrated SoCs, particularly ARM+FPGA platforms such as Xilinx Zynq / RFSoC

  • Working alongside FPGA/digital-electronics engineers at the software–gateware boundary

  • Rust for embedded systems

  • Embedded Linux on ARM (Cortex-A), including driver and kernel-module work

  • Signal processing or control-loop implementation on embedded targets

  • Experience with high-speed data acquisition or precision timing systems

  • Familiarity with laboratory, scientific, or measurement instrumentation

  • Prior experience with quantum computing or other deep-tech domains


What you can expect from eleQtron:

  • Competitive salary: We value our team members and therefore provide remunerations that reflect this, additionally rewarding achievements

  • Flexible working hours: We offer personal freedom through a variety of flexible work schedules

  • Team spirit: In our international and diverse team, and with our regular team events, having fun at work is simply part of the culture

  • Further development: We want to grow together and so we offer our team members needs-based, individualized further training as well as plenty of room for personal development

  • Wellness Package: We offer health-promoting benefits such as fitness programs like UrbanSportsClub to support your well-being

  • Bike Leasing: Stay Mobile and Sustainable with Our Company Bike Leasing Program

  • Moving Benefits: A warm welcome! We are happy to support employees who move for us with a bonus

  • At the forefront: Work at the forefront of technology, where academic research meets commercial applications 

  • Modern workplace: We have a high-quality infrastructure with laboratory space, offices and meeting rooms

  • Guarantee tenant isolation, so that quantum programs and results are never visible across customer boundaries, and manage secrets and credentials across the stack

  • Work with the quantum firmware and hardware teams on the interfaces between cloud services and the machine itself

  • Instrument the platform for observability and keep an eye on latency, throughput, and cost

  • Strong Python; additional systems-level language experience (Go, Rust, C++) is welcome

  • Solid API design skills (REST and/or gRPC) for services other developers have to use

  • Practical experience implementing authentication and authorisation in production systems: OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, token handling, and role-based access control

  • Secure engineering habits: least privilege by default, proper secrets management, and awareness of dependency and container supply-chain risks

  • Working understanding of GDPR and data residency requirements, and a genuine interest in digital sovereignty

  • Multi-tenant isolation patterns in SaaS platforms

  • Familiarity with quantum SDKs and toolchains (Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane, QIR) or hardware abstraction interfaces such as QDMI

title: Financial Analys - German language skills essential

description_html:
We are looking for an analytical, commercially minded Financial Analyst to strengthen our Finance function and support the company through its next stage of growth. This role combines FP&A, financial modeling, reporting, and German HGB expertise with a strong focus on building scalable finance processes, systems, and decision-support capabilities.

You will work closely with Accounting, Sales and other functions to translate financial data into actionable goals and insights.

Tasks

  • Own and improve budgeting, forecasting, rolling forecasts, long-term planning and data analysis ensuring that we are aligned with finances as well as our growth targets
  • Build, maintain, and improve integrated financial models covering P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, liquidity, investment cases, sensitivities, and growth scenarios
  • Perform detailed actual-vs-budget/forecast variance analysis, identify underlying operational and financial drivers, challenge assumptions, and recommend corrective actions
  • Deliver monthly and quarterly management reporting, KPI dashboards, executive analyses, and other materials for senior management
  • Maintain a strong understanding of German HGB accounting and reporting principles and ensure management reporting, planning, and financial analysis are appropriately aligned with statutory accounting
  • Partner closely with Accounting during month-end, quarter-end, and year-end processes, ensuring reliable financial data
  • Develop scalable FP&A processes, reporting structures, KPI frameworks, financial controls, and planning methodologies capable of supporting increasing revenue, headcount and organizational complexity
  • Conduct ad-hoc financial analysis supporting pricing, cost optimization,
    investment decisions, organizational planning and other strategic initiatives.
  • Establish and monitor relevant financial and operational KPIs, including revenue, gross margin, OPEX, EBITDA, cash flow, working capital, productivity, and other business-specific performance indicators
  • Support the evolution of the Finance function as we grow, including standardization, automation, internal controls, documentation, governance, and process improvement.

Requirements

  • Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field
  • CFA, Bilanzbuchhalter, Controller qualification, or similar professional certification is helpful
  • Experience in FP&A, Controlling, Corporate Finance, Financial Analysis, or a comparable finance role
  • Strong practical knowledge of German HGB and experience working with financial statements and reporting in a German business environment
  • Strong understanding of P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, management accounting, budgeting, forecasting, working capital, and financial performance management
  • Advanced Excel skills, including complex financial modeling, sensitivity/scenario analysis, PivotTables etc.
  • Able to operate effectively in a scaling company, including improving processes that may initially be manual, fragmented, or insufficient for future organizational requirements.
  • Strong analytical judgment and attention to detail
  • Able to identify the commercial implications behind the numbers
  • Able to communicate complex financial topics clearly and concisely
  • High degree of ownership, independence, and execution discipline; able to prioritize
  • German and English language skills are essential

Benefits

  • A distributed, open team with a passion for working on and within the open source community
  • Promoting and selling a product which pushes the boundaries of technology and with a global user and contributor community
  • A competitive salary
  • Flexibility for a healthy work-life balance
  • Time for personal growth and education

We are looking for somebody with ambition and drive who would like to grow and learn.

Please note that we don´t accept CVs from recruitment agencies or third parties and due to high volume of applications if you don´t hear from us within max. 3 weeks with an interview invitation please assume that your application as unsuccessful.

title: Salesforce Administrator (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Wemolo
description_html:
Wemolo runs its commercial engine on Salesforce and RevOps owns it — along with the wider system landscape around it. Our data model is non-standard and our motion is anything but off-the-shelf, so we need an experienced admin who can run and improve the whole setup largely on their own, with the Head of RevOps as a soundboard. This is a builder role on a builder team, not a ticket queue, in an environment that leans heavily into AI. You own the platform end-to-end and set the standard for how change happens on it.

What to Expect

  • Ownership: Own Salesforce as our commercial system of record — its health, architecture and evolution across our data model, run and improve the surrounding system landscape (Weflow, Demodesk, Amplemarket and their integrations).

  • Architecture: Drive Salesforce architecture improvements so pipeline data becomes trustworthy.

  • Build: Build no-code / low-code configuration (Flows etc.) customizing and combining tools to solve recurring operational problems.

  • Cross-functional impact: Own changes that span Marketing, BizDev, Sales, CSM, Product and Finance and never deploy one without bringing the affected users along. A change is done when it's adopted, not when it ships.

  • AI-first: Put AI to work in daily admin — drafting validation rules, auditing duplicates, QA — in line with our heavy AI bet.

  • Enablement: Provide technical mentoring to our Junior GTM Engineer and guide the working students on Salesforce and systems topics.

Inspire Us By

  • 3–5+ years as a Salesforce Administrator, ideally in a fast-moving commercial/RevOps environment

  • Proven ability to run and improve a CRM and its surrounding tool landscape largely independently — you don't need direction, you need a soundboard

  • Deep no-code / low-code craft: configuration, flows, third-party applications and combining tools/integrations to solve real operational problems

  • A data-quality mindset: You can trace why pipeline data is untrustworthy and fix it at the root

  • Structured, cross-team problem-solving and strong stakeholder communication; you write change announcements and documentation people actually act on

  • An ownership mindset: Builder, not service desk

  • Comfort working AI-first in daily admin

  • Salesforce certifications and experience with other GTM tools

  • English fluency, German is a plus

What we offer

  • Flexibility & Responsibility: Your workday, your performance – Our hybrid model empowers you to focus from home, get fresh perspectives during workation, and connect in person during our Anchor Days (Tuesday to Thursday)

  • Tailored Mobility: Full speed ahead – Whether it’s sustainable bike leasing or a public transport subsidy, we keep you flexible and on the move

  • Ownership & Autonomy: Your impact, your results – Take full ownership of your area and your KPIs

  • Security & Stability: Safe harbor, clear course – Your job with us isn’t a gamble, but set on a steady path. We grow sustainably so you can fully focus on your personal and professional development

  • Team Culture & Networking: Real connections – also beyond the day-to-day. Celebrate successes with us at legendary team events and spirit days

  • Productive Environment: Brainfood deluxe – Whether it's portafilter coffee, Bella&Bona online cafeteria, fresh fruit or our muesli bar – your wellbeing fuels your performance

  • Health & Balance: Stay in balance with EGYM Wellpass or Urban Sports Club – access 1,000+ gyms and wellness spots across Germany

  • Top Equipment & Ergonomics: Mac or Windows, in the office or remote – we make sure you’re set up for efficiency and comfort

  • Dress Code? Your Code: What you do matters more than what you wear – dress in whatever makes you feel your best

Innovation through diversity

Regardless of your background, origin, gender identity, or individual circumstances, it's your personality that interests us. That's why we're committed to building a culture of collaboration and respect, where every team member has a voice, can grow, and feels valued with us.

Montag bis Donnerstag unterwegs. Freitag gehört dir.
Klingt gut? Dann lies weiter.

Wir bei Wemolo bringen smarte Parkraumsysteme auf die Flächen unserer Kunden in ganz Deutschland. Als Servicetechniker bist du derjenige, der unsere Technologie sichtbar macht – vor Ort, beim Kunden, im echten Einsatz.

Und das Beste:
Du bist nur 4 Tage auf Montage – deine Fahrzeit zählt als Arbeitszeit.

 

What to expect

  • 4-Tage-Montagemodell: Du bist von Montag bis Donnerstag unterwegs. Freitag dient als Organisations-, Ausgleichs- oder freier Tag

  • Installation: Du montierst Kennzeichenscanner, Schilder, Automaten und Bildschirme auf den Parkplätzen unserer Kunden – deutschlandweit

  • Inbetriebnahme von Systemen: Du übernimmst die Inbetriebnahme und führst Funktionstests durch, damit unsere Systeme zuverlässig laufen.

  • Montagebereitschaft: Du hast Lust, von Montag bis Donnerstag auf Montage zu arbeiten – teilweise auch überregional.

  • Servicearbeiten: Du führst Service-, Reparatur- und Instandsetzungsarbeiten direkt vor Ort durch.

  • Wachstumsmöglichkeit: Du hast die Möglichkeit, schnell Verantwortung zu übernehmen und perspektivisch dein eigenes Montageteam zu leiten.

 

Inspire us by

  • Deine Qualifikation: Du verfügst über eine handwerkliche oder technische Ausbildung im In- oder Ausland oder bringst praktische Erfahrung in diesem Bereich mit.

  • Deine Erfahrung: Du hast bereits praktisch gearbeitet und weißt, wie Montage-, Installations- oder Servicearbeiten ablaufen.

  • Sprache: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und kannst dich sicher mit Kunden und im Team abstimmen.

  • Führerschein: Du besitzt einen gültigen Führerschein Klasse B oder höher.

 

What we offer you

  • Arbeitszeit, die fair geregelt ist: Deine Fahrtzeiten zählen vollständig als Arbeitszeit. Keine unbezahlten Anfahrten, keine Grauzonen – deine Zeiten werden transparent und nachvollziehbar erfasst.

  • Planbarkeit statt Überraschungen: Deine Einsätze stehen mindestens zwei Wochen im Voraus fest. So kannst du deine Freizeit und private Termine zuverlässig planen.

  • Professionelle Ausstattung: Du arbeitest mit hochwertigem Werkzeug und modernen Servicefahrzeugen. Deine Arbeitskleidung von Engelbert Strauß stellen wir dir selbstverständlich zur Verfügung.

  • Angenehme Bedingungen auf Montage: Ein attraktives Hotelbudget sorgt für ordentliche Unterkünfte. Reisekosten rechnest du digital und unkompliziert ab.

  • Digital statt Papierchaos: Einsatzplanung, Dokumentation und Zeiterfassung laufen digital – keine Zettelwirtschaft, keine unnötigen Formulare.

  • Stärkung für den Alltag: Mit einem monatlichen Essenszuschuss in Höhe von 30 EUR sorgen wir dafür, dass du jeden Tag voller Energie durchstarten kannst.

  • Regeneration & Fitness: Mit EGYM Wellpass oder Urban Sports Club trainierst du deutschlandweit in Fitnessstudios, Sportanlagen oder entspannst in Saunen – ein echter Ausgleich zur Montagetätigkeit.

  • Zuschuss zur Mobilität: Ob nachhaltig mit Bike-Leasing oder bequem mit Fahrtkostenzuschuss, wir halten dich mobil und flexibel auf Kurs

  • Starker Teamzusammenhalt: Regelmäßige Teamevents sorgen dafür, dass wir Erfolge gemeinsam feiern und als Team zusammenwachsen.

title: Paid Social Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Almedia
description_html:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 80 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

At Almedia, you’ll:

  • Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

  • Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.

  • Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

  • Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

UA Manager

Salary range: €65,000-80,000/annum

We're looking for a Paid Social Manager to take ownership of our core app user acquisition channels. This is a high-stakes, hands-on role built for someone who lives in the data, moves fast on optimizations, and knows how to scale app campaigns across AppLovin, Facebook, and TikTok.

You'll be managing significant budgets across live campaigns — this is not a planning role. It requires daily attention, sharp instincts, and the ability to diagnose and fix performance problems in real time.

What You'll Do 🎯

  • Own App UA at Scale: Take ownership of app install campaigns across AppLovin, Facebook, TikTok, Instagram, Snapchat, and DSPs - managing $500k+ in daily spend and optimizing toward revenue and predictive LTV targets.

  • Drive Daily Performance: Monitor live campaigns daily, make proactive budget and bid adjustments, and troubleshoot performance drops without waiting to be asked.

  • Lead Creative Strategy: Analyze top-performing creatives and competitive trends, identify what's working on TikTok and Facebook, and plan a balanced production mix of iterations and new concepts.

  • Manage a Creative Ecosystem: Coordinate with our internal creative team - briefing, reviewing, and prioritizing production to keep testing pipelines moving.

  • Navigate Attribution Complexity: Work across multiple campaign types, manage cross-channel attribution windows and settings, and use Adjust MMP to ensure clean app tracking and accurate performance reads.

  • Build Toward LTV: Set and optimize against primary KPIs rooted in revenue and predictive lifetime value - understanding not just surface metrics but the downstream signals that predict real business impact.

What You'll Bring 💡

  • App UA Track Record: Proven experience scaling app install campaigns across at least two of: AppLovin, Unity, Snapchat, Facebook, TikTok, or programmatic DSPs - with meaningful budget responsibility.

  • Spend-Scale Comfort: You've managed large daily budgets in a live environment and know how to operate with both precision and speed when campaigns are actively running.

  • Creative Judgment: You can analyze performance data to identify what creative is working, brief agencies effectively, and plan a testing roadmap that balances iteration with new concepts.

  • Attribution Fluency: Solid understanding of mobile attribution, MMP setup (Adjust preferred), and how different campaign types and attribution windows interact — especially across app and web.

  • LTV & Revenue Focus: Experience optimizing toward revenue-based KPIs and predictive LTV, ideally in gaming or subscription apps. If you don't have gaming background, you need to clearly demonstrate you understand the metrics that drive performance downstream.

  • Problem-Solving Operator: You diagnose, you act, you iterate. You don't wait for weekly reviews to catch a problem — you're in the account daily and you fix things before they become fires.

What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟

  • You treat a live campaign like it's always your responsibility - proactive, not reactive.

  • You think in signals and ratios, not just top-line spend.

  • You're a confident stakeholder manager who can align internal teams and external agencies toward a shared creative and performance roadmap.

  • You're comfortable with complexity - multiple campaign types, channels, and attribution layers - and you build clarity from it rather than getting slowed down by it.

Why Almedia? 🎁

  • Own Our Growth: We offer all Berlin-based employees equity in Almedia to truly be a part of our success.

  • Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.

  • Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.

  • Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

Compensation: €65K – €80K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

  • • €65K – €80K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

title: Junior Influencer Marketing Manager (m/w/d) | Deutschsprachig
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Yepoda
description_html:
Über Yepoda
Clean K-Beauty Innovation. Ohne Kompromisse.

Yepoda ist eine Clean K-Beauty Brand, die hält, was sie verspricht. Wir entwickeln koreanische Hautpflege ohne Kompromisse: klinisch getestet, 100 % vegan und nach Standards formuliert, die über die EU-Anforderungen hinausgehen. So vereinen wir die Innovation und Wirksamkeit, für die K-Beauty bekannt ist, mit einem echten Engagement für Nachhaltigkeit. Und das Beste: Unsere Produkte machen Hautpflege einfach, effektiv und zu einem Ritual, auf das man sich jeden Tag freut.

Gegründet wurde Yepoda 2020 von Sander Joonyoung van Bladel und Veronika Strotmann. Als zertifizierte B Corp™ und Mitglied von 1% for the Planet haben wir unseren Hauptsitz im Herzen Berlins. Unsere Produkte sind über unseren eigenen Onlineshop erhältlich und seit März 2025 außerdem bei Sephora Europe – online sowie in über 650 Stores.

Mit einem internationalen Team von mehr als 140 talentierten Menschen gestalten wir die Geschichte von Yepoda jeden Tag aktiv weiter.

Für unser Team in Berlin suchen wir aktuell einen Junior Influencer Marketing Manager (m/w/d). In dieser Rolle verantwortest du ein Portfolio strategischer Creator-Partnerschaften für den deutschen Markt und trägst maßgeblich dazu bei, Umsatzwachstum, Markenbekanntheit und nachhaltigen Business Impact durch leistungsstarke Influencer-Kooperationen voranzutreiben.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest und entwickelst ein Portfolio strategischer Creator-Partnerschaften mit klar definierten Umsatz-, Performance- und Wachstumszielen.

  • Du identifizierst, akquirierst und gewinnst Creator-Kooperationen mit hohem Potenzial und messbarem Business Impact.

  • Du führst Vertrags- und Konditionsverhandlungen eigenständig und findest die richtige Balance zwischen nachhaltigem Beziehungsaufbau, Unternehmenszielen und Profitabilität.

  • Du baust langfristige Beziehungen zu Creator:innen, Agenturen und Partnern auf und pflegst diese mit einem klaren wachstumsorientierten Fokus.

  • Du steuerst Influencer-Kampagnen mit besonderem Fokus auf Performance, ROI, Reichweite, Engagement und Umsatzbeitrag.

  • Du analysierst die Performance von Kampagnen und Creator:innen und leitest daraus konkrete Optimierungs- und Skalierungsmaßnahmen ab.

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst 1-2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Sales, Account Management, Partnership Management, Affiliate Marketing, Influencer Marketing, Media Sales oder vergleichbaren kommerziell geprägten Rollen mit.

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Marketing, Wirtschaft, Betriebswirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich

  • Du arbeitest datenbasiert, analysierst KPIs sicher und kannst Erkenntnisse in konkrete Maßnahmen übersetzen.

  • Du kennst die deutsche Digital-, Creator- und Beauty-Landschaft sehr gut.

  • Du hast eine Hands-on-Mentalität und übernimmst Verantwortung

  • Du verfügst über gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word etc.) und Google Workspace (Gmail, Google Sheets etc.)

  • Erfahrung in den Bereichen DTC, Beauty, FMCG, Lifestyle, Creator Economy oder in schnell wachsenden Unternehmen ist ein großes Plus.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Dynamisches Umfeld: Arbeite in einem engagierten und leidenschaftlichen Start-up-Team

  • Karriere-Booster: Übernimm Verantwortung ab Tag 1 – mit vielen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem wachsenden Unternehmen

  • Inspirierender Arbeitsplatz: Im Herzen von Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg, hundefreundliches Büro, kostenlose Getränke und wöchentliche Yoga-Klassen

  • Hybrides Arbeiten: Wir wissen, dass man manchmal zu Hause produktiver ist – oder einfach einen Tapetenwechsel braucht

  • Vielfalt ist für uns selbstverständlich: Ein diverses, internationales Team mit flachen Hierarchien und Vertrauen als Basis

  • Mitarbeiterrabatt: Profitiere von Vergünstigungen auf Yepoda-Produkte und teile sie mit deinen Liebsten

  • Add Ons: Ein monatliches Benefits-Budget, das du frei nutzen kannst. In der Probonio-App suchst du dir aus, was wirklich zu deinem Lifestyle passt

 

Möchtest du Teil unseres Teams werden? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! 🫰✨

Klicke auf „Jetzt bewerben“ und lade deinen Lebenslauf sowie ein Motivationsschreiben auf Deutsch oder Englisch hoch. Unser Talent Acquisition Team prüft deine Bewerbung und meldet sich so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

Bei Yepoda stehen wir für Chancengleichheit – unabhängig von Herkunft, Hautfarbe, Religion, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Familienstand, Behinderung oder jeglichem anderen gesetzlich geschützten Merkmal.

title: Senior People Operations Manager (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Voize
description_html:
🎤 Why voize? Because we’re more than just a job!

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don't replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission!

 

💡 Your Mission: Build the People Ops function voize will run on

As Senior People Operations Manager, you’ll own People Operations at voize - and build the function from the ground up.

This is our first dedicated People Ops role, so there’s no legacy setup to inherit and no standard playbook to follow. Instead, you’ll have the space to design how People Ops should work at a modern, fast-growing company: automated where it can be, self-service where it should be, and scalable enough to still work when we’ve doubled in size.

We build AI that gives nurses more time for what matters. Your job is to bring that same mindset to our People function - cutting admin, removing friction, and creating an employee experience that sets the standard for how modern companies should operate.

 

🚀 What You'll Own - the mandate in detail

  • Own the employee lifecycle end to end: Onboarding to offboarding with the mandate to redesign how it works, not just run it.

  • Be the trusted point of contact: Own the people topics that need judgment and discretion - and build the self-service, automation and agents that make routine questions disappear.

  • Build a first-class People Ops foundation: Modern, AI-native processes, clear ownership and documentation, and a seamless employee experience from day one.

  • Automate what shouldn’t be manual: Build a reliable source of truth and the workflows and AI agents around it - so documents, deadlines, data checks and repetitive admin run without human intervention.

  • Make us global-ready: Entity vs. EOR decisions, global payroll architecture and local employment compliance across every market we operate in - with audit-proof documentation the whole way.

 

🤝 Your Skillset – What you bring to the table

  • You've scaled People Ops before: Several years of ownership in a fast-growing tech company, and you know from experience which processes break at which headcount.

  • German payroll and employment law are your home turf: Payroll preparation, contracts, statutory deadlines and audit topics - you work at this level of detail without needing a lawyer for every question.

  • You've worked beyond Germany: Multi-country People Ops: entities, EOR, global payroll, local employment law. You've done at least one market entry and know where it gets expensive. US experience is a strong plus.

  • You're AI-first, like us: We work AI-first and expect the same from you: you build your own automations and agents. When you see a repetitive process, your instinct is to remove it, not to staff it.

  • You're a builder, not a caretaker: You've insourced, migrated or rebuilt a function before, you write documentation people actually use, and you'd rather own an ambiguous mandate than a tidy job description.

  • You are fluent German (C1+) and English.

🌱 Growing together – what you can expect at voize

  • We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will tackle challenges, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving healthcare professionals more time for real patient care

  • We foster an open, collaborative culture with regular team events, whether you work from our Berlin office or remotely from Germany

  • Become a co-creator of our success with stock options

  • Generous perks: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off, Germany Transport Ticket, Urban Sports Club, regular company off-sites, and access to learning platforms such as Blinkist and Audible

  • You decide when you work best, that means flexible working hours and a good hybrid set-up

 

✨ Ready to talk? Apply now! 🚀

The people who thrive in this role want real ownership. You’d rather write the playbook than follow one, and you’re equally comfortable designing the operating model and getting into the details that make it work. You move fast, adapt quickly and see changing priorities as a chance to build the next, better version.

If that sounds like your kind of challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Enterprise Sales Leader DACH
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at N8N
description_html:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

About the role

Your goal will be to build DACH into n8n's most predictable Enterprise sales region - developing a team of high-performing Enterprise AEs, instilling forecast and pipeline discipline, and creating a repeatable operating model that wins complex, multi-stakeholder deals

To make that happen, you'll be hands-on in coaching, deal inspection, and team development day-to-day, while staying close enough to strategic deals and customer executives to raise the bar on how we qualify, forecast, and win.

What you’ll be doing

 

DEVELOPING A HIGH-PERFORMING, PREDICTABLE DACH TEAM

  • Coach and develop a team of Enterprise AEs through structured 1:1s, field coaching, and deal reviews – raising both the floor and the ceiling on individual performance

  • Build a rigorous forecasting and pipeline management cadence that makes DACH's numbers predictable quarter over quarter, not dependent on late-quarter heroics

  • Create a repeatable operating model – clear playbooks, MEDDIC/MEDDPICC-based deal inspection, and coaching rhythms – DACH's execution shouldn’t rely on you personally driving every strategic deal

  • Hire, onboard, and scale the team over time, establishing career paths and succession plans as the region grows


SETTING THE STRATEGY FOR THE DACH TERRITORY

  • Prioritize and run the DACH Enterprise territory with focus – balancing new logo pursuits with expansion plays where community signals are strong

  • Set the strategy for the team's most complex enterprise cycles, from discovery to close, staying close enough to coach without taking the pen

  • Elevate sales methodology adoption (MEDDIC/MEDDPICC), ensuring meticulous qualification, mutual action plans, and disciplined inspection of technical + business wins


BUILDING A STRATEGIC, MULTI-THREADED SELLING MOTION

  • Build a strategic selling culture that shifts the team from “running opportunities” to multi-threaded, value-led enterprise execution

  • Orchestrate executive engagement across DACH accounts – aligning economic buyers, champions, and technical evaluators to keep momentum and unblock deals

  • Run high-quality deal reviews and QBRs that sharpen strategy, elevate coaching moments, and improve win rates, cycle time, and forecast accuracy

 

PARTNERING ACROSS THE BUSINESS

  • Collaborate cross-functionally (Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, RevOps, Product) to refine messaging for technical buyers, strengthen the enterprise playbook, and remove friction in the sales process

Requirements

MUST HAVES

  • 🏆 Enterprise sales leadership: 5+ years in frontline sales management, leading ICs through complex, multi-threaded enterprise deals

  • 🔎 MEDDIC/MEDDPICC mastery: Deep, practical command of MEDDIC/MEDDPICC and a track record coaching teams to adopt it with real inspection

  • 📈 Forecast & pipeline rigor: Track record running a disciplined forecasting and pipeline management cadence that makes revenue predictable, not reactive

  • 🧠 Strategic deal management: You’re fluent in qualification, mutual action plans, champion building, and executive alignment in longer-cycle deals

  • 🎙️ Executive presence: You confidently engage senior stakeholders, run tight meetings, and set a high bar for clarity, urgency, and outcomes

  • 🧑‍🏫 Coaching & talent development: You level up AEs through structured coaching, field observation, and actionable feedback

  • 🧩 Multi-stakeholder navigation: You’re skilled at aligning technical and economic buyers, de-escalating conflict, and maintaining deal momentum

  • 🇩🇪 DE location: You’re based in Germany and happy being on-site with customers

  • 🔧 Technical-buyer credibility: Experience selling into technical stakeholders and navigating evaluation-heavy sales motions

NICE-TO-HAVES

  • 🖥️ Open-source / PLG experience: You understand how community and bottoms-up adoption influence enterprise outcomes and how to partner with that motion

  • 🌉 Developer / infra SaaS background: Experience in DevOps, SecOps, IT Ops, data, infrastructure, or adjacent categories

  • 💡 Scrappy startup mindset: You’ve scaled in environments where playbooks are evolving and you enjoy building structure without slowing teams down

  • 📊 Operational excellence: Strong instincts for clean forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and turning data into coaching and better execution

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

* Country-specific details are provided in your contract.

title: On Holiday Support Agent
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at loveholidays
description_html:
Why loveholidays?

At loveholidays - we trailblaze together. We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers’ unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway. Our team is the driving force behind our role as our customers’ personal holiday expert - the smart way to get away.

Here, we're doing things differently to open the world to everyone, and our Customer Experience team is at the forefront of driving cutting-edge innovation. Join our fast-growing business where your ideas are heard and new thinking shapes how millions book their holidays.

You'll accelerate your growth in our fast-paced environment, tackling daily challenges and learning from inspiring leaders and teammates. Be empowered to create impact for our future by shaping the most-loved package holiday experience for millions. As we pursue ambitious plans to expand across Europe, you'll be part of a fun-loving international community achieving great things together.

About the team:

The On Holiday Support team helps customers resolve issues that arise while they are away. This can include transfer problems, accommodation concerns, supplier issues, flight disruption and other unexpected situations that may affect a customer’s holiday.

Customers may contact us when they are tired, worried, frustrated or unsure what to do next. Our role is to listen, understand what has happened and take ownership of finding the most appropriate resolution.

You will be part of the UK On Holiday Support team and report to an On Holiday Support Team Leader. You will also work closely with colleagues in our offshore partner team and with suppliers and internal departments across loveholidays..

Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. We welcome applications from candidates based in London and the surrounding areas. As this role requires some attendance at our London office, applications from candidates with a commute of more than 2 hours each way will not be considered.

The impact you’ll have:

You’ll support customers at moments when the service we provide can have a real impact on their holiday, taking ownership and responding with empathy, urgency and sound judgement.

This means investigating what’s happened, communicating clearly and working towards practical resolutions. Some cases will be straightforward, while others may require supplier contact, further investigation or escalation to specialist teams.

Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. A customer-first mindset and strong problem-solving skills are essential, particularly when handling more challenging cases and helping restore customers’ confidence in loveholidays. You’ll also support English-speaking customers across our international markets.

High performers may have opportunities to develop into specialist areas, including wellbeing and safeguarding.

Your day-to-day:

  • Support customers through telephone, chat and case-based contact while they are on holiday

  • Listen carefully, understand the customer’s circumstances and identify the most appropriate next steps

  • Take ownership of customer issues and work towards a resolution wherever possible

  • Use good judgement to balance customer needs, urgency, safety, policy and commercial considerations

  • Contact hotels, transfer providers, airlines and other suppliers to investigate issues and agree solutions

  • Make outbound calls when speaking directly with a customer or supplier is the quickest and most effective way to resolve an issue

  • Keep customers updated and set clear expectations throughout their case

  • Recognise risk and escalate safeguarding, wellbeing or major incident concerns through the correct process

  • Maintain clear, accurate and complete case notes

  • Work collaboratively with colleagues in the UK, our offshore partner and other loveholidays teams

  • Identify recurring customer or supplier issues and provide feedback so that the underlying cause can be addressed

  • Maintain an up-to-date understanding of relevant processes, policies, systems and travel-industry developments

Your skillset:

  • Strong and demonstrable customer-service skills

  • A calm, empathetic and professional communication style

  • Confidence speaking with customers who may be upset, frustrated or under pressure

  • Strong ownership and a willingness to see issues through to resolution

  • Sound judgement and the confidence to make decisions within agreed guidelines

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Strong problem-solving and investigative skills

  • Excellent organisation and attention to detail

  • Emotional resilience and the ability to work effectively with sensitive or challenging customer situations

  • A collaborative approach and confidence working with colleagues from different teams and cultures

The interview journey:

  1. Intro to a member of the Talent Acquisition team - 20 minutes

  2. Interview and assessment with the Hiring Manager and Team Leader – 60 minutes

Perks of joining us:

Other than an amazing environment for you to grow, have impact and show the world your incredible skills, we offer the following benefits:

  • Company pension contributions at 5%

  • Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up

  • Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends

  • 25 days of holidays per annum (plus 8 public holidays) increases by 1 day for every second year of service, up to a maximum 30 days per annum

  • Enhanced maternity/paternity leave

  • Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers

At loveholidays, we focus on developing an inclusive culture and environment that encourages personal growth and collective success. Each individual offers unique perspectives and ideas that increase the diversity and effectiveness of our teams. And we value the insight and potential you could bring on our continued journey.
