description_html:
Basés en plein cœur de Paris, nous faisons bouger l’industrie des jeux en ligne. Leader du poker et des paris sportifs en France avec 350 000 joueurs et 600 000 parieurs mensuels, nous sommes présents en Espagne, en Allemagne et bientôt en Italie et au Portugal. Nous offrons à nos joueurs une expérience exceptionnelle, à la fois technique, créative et qualitative. Innovation, unité et appartenance : nos valeurs façonnent une culture d’entreprise multiculturelle et unique.
 
Et si tu avais un futur dans le jeu ?
 
Techniquement, Winamax c’est :
  • Un moteur de jeu puissant et innovant : adaptation dynamique de l'offre de jeu, parties de poker hautement configurables, détection de fraude
  • Une architecture distribuée et scalable conçue pour traiter en temps réel les flux de la plateforme
  • Une plateforme modulaire soumise à des contraintes de haute disponibilité et de sécurisation des données, capable de gérer de fortes audience

Contexte
Nos mini-jeux reposent sur la même logique de fond : une session courte, une animation qui doit rester fluide du début à la fin, un résultat traçable et auditable par le régulateur. Chaque nouveau mini jeu repart pourtant de zéro, alors que l'essentiel est commun.
 
Comment concevoir un socle générique qui permette d'en sortir un nouveau en quelques semaines, sans rien céder ni sur la fluidité ni sur l'auditabilité ?

Objectifs du stage
  • Concevoir le template générique et les API associées : cycle de vie d'une session, actions du joueur, résultats
  • Développer le socle d'interface à partir des maquettes UX/UI : L'enjeu visuel est central : chaque mini jeu doit donner envie d'y jouer rien qu'en le regardant
  • Rédiger la documentation, puis passer le test grandeur nature : produire un premier mini jeu sur ce socle et le faire auditer.
    • Les impératifs à prendre en compte pour ce sujet : les exigences du régulateur, la forte volumétrie, et la faible latence nécessaire au plaisir du jeu. 

    Stack technique
    Frontend : React, TypeScript
    Backend : JavaScript, API JSON-RPC
    Infrastructure : AWS, Redis, MySQL

    Modalités du stage
  • Stage de fin d'études (Master 2) à pourvoir à temps plein uniquement à Paris, France
  • Opportunité de CDI à la fin du stage
  • Rémunération : 30k
    • POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ?
     
    En plus de notre univers poker et paris sportifs, nous avons d’autres avantages !
     
    • Une culture d’entreprise multiculturelle et unique 
    • Une semaine de travail en 4 jours
    • Opportunité de CDI si tu as atteint les objectifs du stage
    • Coaching de tes soft skills avec les Cours Florent
    • Un cadre de travail convivial, en plein cœur de Paris (rooftop tour Eiffel, salle de jeux vidéo et salle de sport…)
    • Une vie d’entreprise riche avec des soirées et événements organisés régulièrement (tournois de poker, soirées thématiques, barbecues tout l'été…)
    • Des primes d’intéressement et de participation si tu restes parmi nous à l'issue de ton stage
    • Un accès au programme de cooptation (bonus de cooptation jusqu’à 5000 €)
    • Un restaurant d’entreprise

    • Point d'attention particulier à la volumétrie des populations traitées, au coût des requêtes, à la traduction de critères techniques en quelque chose de manipulable par un non technicien, ainsi qu'à la gestion des traductions et aux garde-fous.

Comment construire une solution maison capable de définir, collecter et évaluer des règles de conformité sur l'ensemble du SI ?

    • Les maquettes de base sont fournies, mais on attend des propositions concrètes sur les cas limites : transitions, gestes, comportement en réseau dégradé. Sujet transverse, en contact direct avec la créa, l'édito et le produit.

Contexte
Notre plateforme de jeu repose sur des microservices stateless : chaque traitement est une fonction pure appliquée à un message et à un état. Sur le papier, c'est le rêve pour débugger. En pratique, l'outillage n'existe pas, et CloudWatch devient vite chronophage dès qu'il faut analyser les interactions entre services.
 
Comment rejouer les messages et les changements d'états pour reproduire un dysfonctionnement à l'identique ?

Objectifs du stage
Concevoir et déployer un outil réellement opérationnel, en trois briques :
  • Ingestion et indexation à l'échelle : capter les messages et les transitions d'états, définir un modèle de stockage scalable sans impacter la production
  • Générateur de tests local : isoler une séquence, reconstruire l'arbre d'états, et en sortir des tests de non-régression automatisés
  • Replayer : une API et un back-office minimaliste pour visualiser graphiquement les états et les interactions inter-services
    • Les points d'attention : la volumétrie, la fidélité de la reconstruction chronologique, la corrélation d'événements en environnement distribué, et l'industrialisation de l'outil (CI/CD, tests, documentation).

    Stack technique
    Javascript, React, DynamoDB, Kafka, S3, AWS, GitHub

    Modalités du stage
  • Stage de fin d'études (Master 2) à pourvoir à temps plein uniquement à Paris, France
  • Opportunité de CDI à la fin du stage

title: Tech Lead Full-Stack Rails Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Mitre Media
description_html:
About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8)

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

  • Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Required Technical Skills

Back-End

  • Ruby (5+ years, expert-level)

  • Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred)

  • PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

  • Elasticsearch

  • Redis

  • Docker

Front-End

  • StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6

  • Tailwind CSS

  • HTML

  • HTTP

AI Integration

  • Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications

  • Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic)

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Kubernetes for microservices orchestration

  • React for advanced front-end components

  • Graph databases for complex financial data

  • Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects

Required Soft Skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech

  • Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates

  • Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code

  • Team player comfortable as an individual contributor

Why Join Us?

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture.

  • Autonomy and Influence: Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate.

  • Competitive Compensation: $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits.

  • Remote Flexibility: Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC

  • Growth Opportunities: Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation.

  • Dynamic Culture: Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech.

About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform

Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data.

How to Apply

 

Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.

title: Sales Account Executive - Cybersecurity
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Crowdsec
description_html:
Passionate about Cybersecurity, open-source or network effect products? Interested in Sales?

Join CrowdSec to build a safer internet for everyone.

What we do

We aim to deter opportunistic and organized cybercrime through an Internet-scale, real-time security network. This network is powered by hundreds of thousands of servers sharing the aggression they block with our open-source software. By coupling this local behavior analysis and sharing its findings within our community, we create a real-time map of IP addresses used by cybercriminals, a large-scale reputation system, and a Crowd-Sourced Cyber Threat Intelligence of unprecedented magnitude that will counter the vast majority of technical hacks.

Who We Are

CrowdSec is a human-sized team of cybersecurity experts. Most of the team has worked remotely since day 1. The CrowdSec solution is used in 180+ countries, it is a well-known, unique, collaborative, open-source security solution that protects hundreds thousands of users. We are animated by a mission: making the Internet a safer place, all together.

Role

As an Account Executive (AE), you will work with the Sales team to help them scale, create new opportunities, interact with them, convert them to Leads, and take the accounts to signature. This will be done in collaboration with the BDRs, presales, Marketing, and Support teams to ensure the most pleasant customer journey.


Must-have

  • A track record of success in selling Cybersecurity software solutions

  • A pre-existing customer/contact base to work on to kickstart your tenure

  • Knowledges of fundamental cybersecurity mechanism

  • Good methodology to deal with inbound leads

  • Good outreach techniques to convert SQLs to clients

  • Experience covering the whole sales process from prospection to signature

  • The ability to build relationships and credibility with both SOC Managers/analysts, DevOps, SecOps, Risk Managers, and C-level Executives alike

  • Predictability and accurate forecasting capabilities

  • Fluency in English and at least a second language; any supplementary languages are considered a plus

Optional

  • You have sold to SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, MSSPs or MSPs

  • Knowledge of the open-software landscape

  • Languages other than English and French are considered a plus

  • Start-up experience

  • Experience with Hubspot

Soft Skills

  • You are a confident and polished communicator able to build strong and lasting relationships

  • You are autonomous, do not hesitate to share new ideas with the team, and are genuinely interested in learning your customer's needs

  • You are located in a +/- 6h from CEST Timezone

Why join CrowdSec?

  • You want to take part in an adventure with a bleeding edge tech startup

  • Work with a team of blackbelt pros in their fields and interact with an exciting community

  • You are driven and energetic, with a passion for prospecting and driving pipeline

  • We are a full-remote company, we meet twice a year to strengthen the team spirit during a 1-week seminar.

title: Staff Product Manager [Machine Learning expertise]
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Qonto
description_html:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,600+ Qontoers serving over 600,000+ customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Join us as a Staff Machine Learning Product Manager to enhance Qonto's customer experience through innovative solutions. You'll drive the maturity and scalability of our ML/AI capabilities, addressing concrete business problems while fostering innovation.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Own the ML product roadmap end-to-end: Define what we build, why, and in what order — gathering insights from engineering, data science, and business teams to develop a prioritized strategy that addresses real customer needs.
  • Drive key ML product initiatives: Lead the definition and design of ML solutions for products like Attachment Matcher, Transaction Categorizer — from discovery through delivery.
  • Collaborate across the full stack: Work with data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to ensure successful implementation of ML capabilities that drive measurable business value.
  • Own your decisions and communicate them clearly: Articulate the rationale behind priorities and engage key stakeholders — including customers, product, and executive teams.
  • Continuously improve through data: Monitor and analyze the performance of models and products, making data-driven recommendations to raise the bar.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • Product management experience with an ML focus: You have proven experience in product management, with concrete examples of ML products you significantly scaled. You think in outcomes, not features.
  • Technical fluency in ML: You have a solid grasp of machine learning concepts and applications, allowing you to collaborate effectively with technical teams and translate complex ideas into product requirements.
  • Strong stakeholder management: You excel at building relationships with diverse stakeholders and communicating complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Analytical thinking: You make data-driven decisions that balance customer needs with business objectives — and you're comfortable with hard trade-offs.
  • Strategic vision: You can develop a compelling product vision and roadmap that aligns with company goals and delivers measurable impact.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • A domain being reshaped by AI: ML is transforming financial services — from expense categorization to cashflow forecasting. You'll build products at the frontier of what's possible, not maintain existing ones.
  • Squad autonomy as the default: You own your roadmap and ship without red tape. No approval chains, no waiting on committees.
  • Real impact at scale: Your work will directly affect how 600,000+ SMEs manage their finances every day.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: You'll sit at the intersection of product, data science, and engineering — with a team that values craft and moves fast.
 

➡️ About your future manager

You'll work closely with Sophie, Manager of the AI Lab. Sophie has led cross-functional teams through the full product lifecycle at both fast-growing startups and established tech companies. She partners directly with Product and Tech leadership to align the AI roadmap with Qonto's strategic goals.

Her approach: give engineers real ownership, create space for experimentation, and empower the squad to adapt their ways of working in pursuit of real impact.

At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick — who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.
 
By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.
 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here
 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Recruitment scams are on the rise. Keep in mind, we will never work with third-party platforms or agencies that request payment from candidates.

Join us as a Product Manager for Due Diligence and help build one of the most sophisticated compliance engines in Europe.   • Partner daily with Ops: You'll ship changes that directly shape the daily work of a large, global operations team.

  • Compliance or risk product experience: You've shipped products in KYC, AML, fraud, or another regulated domain.

  • Ops-first mindset: You've partnered closely with operations teams and design for the people who use your tools every day.
  • AI-native workflow: You use AI to build faster, and you're excited to design agentic workflows that automate real decisions.
  • Fluent in English: You communicate comfortably in English.
 

➡️ What we can offer you

  • A domain mid-transformation: You'll join Due Diligence as it shifts from manual checks to agentic automation.
  • High-stakes impact: Your work will touch every Qonto customer, at every stage of their relationship with us.
  • A growing scope: As Qonto opens new markets and legal forms, your remit will keep expanding.
  • Direct access to leadership: You'll work closely with Quentin and the wider Customer Lifecycle product team on how Qonto builds trust at scale.
 

➡️ Your future manager

You'll report to Quentin, Director of Product for Customer Lifecycle. Quentin started his career as a consultant in Paris before spending four years building products for a challenger bank in Kuala Lumpur, and he's been shaping Qonto's product org since 2021.

title: Senior Analytical Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Octopus Energy Group
description_html:
Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech.
 
Comment on fait ?  On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer.

On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques.




Nous recherchons un•e Senior Analytical Engineer expérimenté•e et motivé·e pour rejoindre l’équipe data transverse au sein d’Octopus Energy France. 

La fonction data en France regroupe une quinzaine de data analysts, de data scientists et de data engineers, embarqués•es dans différents domaines métiers. Cette équipe transverse s’assure de construire des fondations solides, partagées et fiables.

Tu rejoindras cette équipe dans laquelle tu travailleras sur les fondations analytiques, la couche sémantique et la gouvernance de la donnée. Il s’agit d’un rôle transverse qui sera en interface avec les besoins métiers et des autres praticiens•nes data.

Tu seras en charge de renforcer et développer nos fondations data afin de fluidifier le travail de l’ensemble des métiers et praticiens•nes data.
 
Ainsi, tes principales missions seront les suivants : 

Modélisation de données et couche sémantique :

  • Concevoir, développer et maintenir des modèles de données partagés, au service des besoins métiers (notamment financiers) et de la direction

  • Être un point de référent technique pour l’ensemble des équipes financières et achats d’énergie

  • Structurer et organiser la gouvernance de données afin de garantir une seul et même source de vérité


    • Assurer la qualité de données et les standards :

  • Être garant de la qualité de nos modèles de données via la diffusion des bonnes pratiques et le suivi de la qualité de nos données

  • Éviter les redondances et l’accumulation de dettes techniques afin d’avoir un lineage propre.

  • Gérer les incidents sur nos modèles les plus critiques


    • Animer et faire monter en compétence la communauté data :

  • Animer ou co-animer des formations, du coaching et des routines dédiés aux équipes data

  • Être moteur de la transition IA de notre stack: création de skills, démonstration d’exemple et de cas d’usage

  • Assurer la qualité du code via les revues de code (PR reviews) sur les modèles dbt et les requêtes SQL produits par les autres praticiens data


    • Assurer la coordination internationale :

  • S’assurer de la cohérence et être le relais des pratiques communes du groupe Octopus Energy

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration de nos modèles partagés


    • Profil recherché :

  • Expérience & Compétences techniques

  • Minimum de 5 ans d'expérience en analytical engineering, data engineering analytique, ou analytics avec une forte orientation technique

  • Maîtrise avancée de dbt : expérience sur des projets de taille réelle, avec gestion de la structure, de la documentation et des tests

  • SQL expert — capable d'optimiser des requêtes complexes sur un data warehouse moderne (BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks ou équivalent)

  • Tu es à l’aise en Python pour l'automatisation et les scripts analytiques, en connaissant les bonnes pratiques de développement

  • Tu es à l’aise avec les outils de visualisation de données et les pratiques de gestion programmatique de ces outils (ex.: “dashboard-as-a-code”).

  • Tu as une bonne connaissance des patterns d'architecture analytique : Kimball, Data Vault, Medallion, ou hybride — et surtout du pourquoi derrière chaque choix

  • Expérience en gestion de la qualité de données

  • Parcours académique en statistiques / mathématique / économie, diplôme spécialisé en data, ou en école d’Ingénieur avec une forte appétence en Data

  • Appétences et Compétences interpersonnelles

  • Rigueur et souci du détail : la qualité de la donnée commence par la qualité du code

  • Pédagogie et envie de faire monter les autres en compétences pour éviter de créer des silos

  • Tu es à l'aise dans un environnement décentralisé : tu dois convaincre par la qualité de ton travail et la clarté de tes recommandations auprès des praticiens·nes data

  • Tu aimes les environnements dynamiques: Octopus Energy évoluent vite et les besoins peuvent changer

  • Notre stack:

  • Visualisation: Lightdash et Streamlit

  • Modélisation: dbt

  • Lakehousing: Databricks (sur AWS)

  • Orchestration: Airflow

  • Code: Git

  • IA: Claude Code, Copilot, Gemini

  • Langues: tu maîtrise de l'anglais à l'oral et à l'écrit pour interagir avec nos collègues internationaux


    • Ce que tu trouveras ici :
  • Un rôle avec une vraie surface d'impact transversale en travaillant sur une communauté data d'une quinzaine de praticiens actifs — tes décisions techniques affectent l’ensemble de la data d’Octopus Energy France. La culture Octopus Energy valorise l'autonomie et la responsabilité individuelles.

  • Le poste est basé à Paris avec 3 jours de présentiel et 2 jours de télétravail

    • Pourquoi tu vas adorer travailer chez nous ? 

    Tu as vu le salaire ou la fourchette prévu·e pour ce poste mais tu aimerais en discuter ? Demande-le nous ! Lors de notre premier contact, c’est un point que nous abordons toujours, car même si nous prenons soin de définir des grilles les plus justes possibles, il nous semble également important de faire correspondre ton expérience au bon salaire. Nous aurons l’occasion de t’en dire plus sur la manière dont nous avons défini le salaire et sur les autres avantages dont tu pourras bénéficier si tu nous rejoins ! Sache enfin que nous pouvons avoir un certain degré de flexibilité, car nous ne voudrions jamais que le salaire soit une raison pour laquelle quelqu’un·e ne postule pas chez Octopus - ce qui est le plus important pour nous est de trouver le bon Octofit !

    Certifiée depuis 2024 et 4e en 2025, Octopus Energy France est classée 1ère sur plus de 200 entreprises au classement Great Place to Work 2026 ! Cela reflète bien notre engagement pour un environnement de travail épanouissant !

    Nous sommes une organisation où les gens apprennent, décident et construisent plus rapidement. Où ils travaillent de manière autonome, avec des gens extraordinaires, sur des projets qui innovent. Intéressement au capital, flex-office, excellente mutuelle, forfait mobilité douce, prise en charge d’une partie de ton titre de transport au-delà du minimum légal, et même des jours de congés spéciaux pour t’investir dans un projet associatif qui te tient à coeur… Nous voulons que ton investissement soit récompensé par des avantages auxquels tu tiens vraiment !

    Chez Octopus, nous cherchons des personnes foncièrement bienveillantes et empathiques. L’égalité des chances nous tient à cœur et nous veillons à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et équitable. Nous t’invitons à postuler, quels que soient ton âge, genre, vie conjugale, couleur, handicap, grossesse ou parentalité, origine, convictions religieuses ou orientation sexuelle.

title: Manager Customer Success (Public Sector)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Malt
description_html:
🪐 Discover our galaxy
 
Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:
 
- A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries
- A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth
- Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI
- A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently
 
Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐
 
At Malt we believe that Ambition is the Way, so all lists of missions and responsibilities are non-exhaustive.

As our Manager Customer Success, you will play a pivotal role in scaling our operations dedicated to the Public Sector. Leading a growing team, you will drive operational excellence across client onboarding, renewals, and key programs. Positioned as a trusted partner to Sales and Operations leadership, your mission is to combine revenue growth, team development, process optimization, and a high-bar user experience at scale.

Key responsibilities ✨

  • Team Leadership & People Management:

    • Hire, onboard, coach, and nurture a high-performing team (permanent employees and freelancers).

    • Foster a performance-driven, high-energy environment aligned with a cohesive "One Team" culture.

    • Revenue & Performance Management:

      • Secure and drive revenue from project renewals and Malt OPEN opportunities.

      • Monitor team KPIs, track progress toward ambitious targets, and report key metrics to executive leadership.

      • Operational Excellence & Scalability:

        • Tailor team processes and workflows to meet the specific requirements and regulations of public sector clients.

        • Identify operational bottlenecks and user pain points by establishing structured feedback loops and analyzing performance data.

        • Lead automation initiatives and product improvements in close alignment with Business Operations, Product, Tech, Data, and IT teams.

        • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Sales Partnership:

          • Build trusted, strategic relationships with Sales and Client Operations leads to align roadmaps and goals.

          • Partner with Finance and Commercial teams on RFP responses to ensure seamless operational delivery for new accounts.

          • Subject Matter Expertise:

            • Serve as the internal SME for Public Sector operationalization (e.g., purchase order management, renewals processes).


    • About you 🧑‍🚀

    Experience:

    • 5 to 8 years of professional experience.

    • Proven track record in people management (managing teams of 3+ people).

    • Strong background in the Public Sector (or solid B2B services/consulting experience with public sector operational delivery).

    • Demonstrated experience in an Operations / Customer Success role or a Commercial / Sales team.

      • Hard Skills & Technical Expertise:

      • Process Optimization & Scale Mindset: Demonstrated ability to spot inefficiencies and drive technical or operational enhancements.

      • Business Acumen & Pipeline Management: Solid understanding of commercial impacts, renewals tracking, and revenue drivers.

      • CRM Proficiency: Experience using Salesforce or equivalent enterprise CRM platforms.

        • Soft Skills & Core Competencies:

        • Stakeholder Management & Influence: Ability to work effectively with cross-functional leadership (Heads of Sales, Client Ops).

        • Communication & Conflict Resolution: Skilled at handling internal/external friction and framing strategic messaging.

        • Adaptability & Ambiguity: Ability to thrive and execute in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment.


    How to join the mission? 🚀

  • First call with our Talent Acquisition team to better understand your background and aspirations 

  • Interview with Camille, your future manager to delve into your experience and the specifics of the role (45-60 minutes)

  • Home assignment to complete, which will be evaluated to assess your management logic and analytical skills

  • Final interview with a C-level executive to discuss Malt’s long-term vision.

    • Malt is the perfect space to thrive personally and professionally 💫
     
    - Onboarding: Before easing into your new role, you’ll spend your first week learning about our culture, products, and services with other new joiners at our office in Paris
    - Equity: Every Malter is entitled to stock options 
    - Lunch vouchers (legal benefit): €9/day on your Swile card
    - Transportation (legal benefit): 50% reimbursement (any type of transport)
    - Healthcare insurance (legal benefit) 
    - RTT: From 8 to 12 days off per year
    - Sports: Company participation to a Gymlib (Wellpass) membership
    - Malt sabbatical: Every three years, all Malters are entitled to a one month fully paid sabbatical leave
    - Free books: If you’re interested in learning more about any topic relevant to Malt’s business, just tell us the books you’d like to read, and we’ll order them for you—without any questions asked or approval processes to follow
    - Remote work: Hybrid policy balancing on-site and home office
    - Team building events organized every year
     
    Ready? Get your ticket to Malt 🪐 
     
    At Malt, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We recruit based on skills, experience, and potential, without any form of discrimination related to age, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, or disability. Our mission is to create a work environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and safe to thrive.
     
    Your profile may be subject to background screening. For more information see our candidate privacy policy.

title: Executive Assistant - Tech Leadership
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Mirakl
description_html:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 

The Team You Will Join 

 
You'll be part of our Executive Assistant team led by Claire, Executive Assistant to the CEO. The team consists of 3 Executive Assistants supporting Mirakl's most senior C-levels. Together, you'll ensure seamless operational support that empowers our executive team to focus on Mirakl's growth and strategic impact.
The team also works closely together to share best practices, learn from one another, and drive projects that improve efficiency, including through the use of AI tools.
 

What You"ll Do

Executive Support — Labs Leadership Team (CTO and Chief Data & AI Officer)

  • Coordinate and proactively manage executive business calendars (anticipate conflicts, prioritise competing demands, proactively optimize agenda with enough buffers)
  • Arrange travel end-to-end — flights, hotels, ground transport, visas — and ensure all logistics are in place well in advance of each trip
  • Prepare and process expense reports for executives when requested, in line with internal policies
  • Type, revise, edit Linkedin communications
  • Handle sensitive and confidential information with absolute discretion

Labs Team Support

  • Arrange and coordinate team meetings
  • Manage and coordinate specific projects in support of the labs teams, for example: client visits in Mirakl HQ in Paris, team building lunches
  • Aid in purchase management: raise purchase orders, track invoices, and liaise with Finance to ensure timely processing
  • Liaise with HR, Finance, and IT on behalf of both departments for any operational or administrative requests (Lucca, TravelPerk, Expensya)

Event Planning & Management

title: Technical Strategy Manager H/F
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Alta Ares
description_html:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Context

We are looking for hybrid profile, sitting at the intersection of strategy and engineering, able to rigorously evaluate the technology choices made by the R&D and innovation teams, audit our internal capabilities, and challenge product/tech trade-offs with a business lens. This is not a technical team management role, but a role of constructive counter-power and strategic alignment between engineering and business priorities.

You will ensure that our technological decisions (R&D, innovation, architecture choices, build vs buy, roadmap prioritization) are aligned with overall strategy, economically sound, and robust by actively challenging the relevant teams rather than rubber-stamping their proposals.

Role & Missions:

Strategic and technical challenge

  • Challenge the technical choices and roadmaps proposed by R&D and the Innovation team (architecture, stack, prioritization, build vs buy vs partner)

  • Question the underlying assumptions behind technical projects (feasibility, ROI, strategic alignment, technical debt incurred)

  • Produce well-argued, independent analyses not rubber-stamped validations

Technology and market watch

  • Run continuous technical and technology watch (competitors, emerging technologies, market trends, new tools, and platforms) to keep the company's decisions informed by the state of the art

  • Identify technologies or approaches that could create a competitive advantage, or expose the company to being left behind

  • Turn watch findings into actionable inputs for the R&D/Innovation roadmap and for COMEX-level strategic discussions

  • Build and maintain a structured watch process (sources, cadence, internal distribution) rather than ad hoc monitoring

Capability audit

  • Regularly map and assess the company's technical capabilities (skills, tools, infrastructure, external dependencies)

  • Identify areas of risk, over-investment, under-investment, or critical dependency

  • Benchmark our capabilities against the market and competitors

Technology strategy

  • Contribute to defining the company's technology strategy alongside the Strategy & Operations Director

  • Assess build, buy, partner, or acquisition opportunities on technology topics

  • Inform R&D resource allocation decisions with a strategic and financial lens

Reporting and governance

  • Produce syntheses and recommendations for COMEX on tech-strategy topics

  • Set up tracking indicators on technical execution vs. commitments made

  • Participate in R&D/Innovation committees as an independent strategic voice

Candidate profile

Experience

  • 5-6 years of overall experience, engineering background (degree in engineering or equivalent)

  • Ideal trajectory: 2-3 years of hands-on technical execution, followed by 2-3 years in a hybrid technical/business role e.g. Engineer → Technical Product Manager, Engineer → tech-focused strategy consulting, or Engineer → Chief of Staff to a CTO/VP Engineering

  • Profiles with only pure execution experience (no exposure to business trade-offs) or only early technical experience followed by years of generalist consulting (no longer technically credible) are not a fit for this role

  • Given the seniority level, the candidate should compensate for limited years of experience with either deep, recognized expertise in a specific technical domain (enough to be seen as a peer by R&D on that topic) or a strong, proven track record of challenging senior stakeholders from a strategy/consulting background.

Technical skills

  • Hands-on experience in a technical environment (dev, data, tech product, architecture, not consulting-only exposure)

  • Demonstrated ability to understand architecture choices and technical trade-offs, and to assess their relevance

  • Comfortable engaging as a peer with CTOs, tech leads, and senior engineers

  • Able to speak in concrete, specific terms about a real technical decision they challenged or questioned

Strategy / business skills

  • Ability to translate technical issues into business implications, and vice versa

Critical soft skills

  • Strong critical thinking and independence of judgment

  • Able to distinguish a genuine technical risk from a mere communication gap

  • Natural credibility: earns legitimacy through the rigor of the analysis, not through hierarchy

Success indicators (by month 12)

  • Technical capability map completed and kept up to date

  • A structured technology watch process in place, with regular outputs reaching R&D/Innovation and COMEX

  • Number of R&D/Innovation decisions meaningfully redirected following a well-argued challenge

  • Perceived quality of recommendations by COMEX and by the technical teams themselves

  • Measurable reduction in the gap between technical roadmap and strategic priorities

title: Chief of Staff
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at DiliTrust
description_html:
Ready to be part of the Legal Tech revolution?

DiliTrust is a global SaaS publisher transforming legal departments worldwide through cutting-edge technology.

Our vision: As a SaaS provider, DiliTrust is dedicated to offering an integrated suite of legal and governance solutions. Our vision is to digitize legal departments around the world and become the global leader in Legal Tech.

Our impact: From generating General Meeting reports to AI-assisted contract lifecycle management, our international teams are the driving force behind our global success. We proudly support customers across numerous countries and markets.

Our recognition: DiliTrust is at the forefront of Legal Tech innovation and has been integrating artificial intelligence into its solutions since 2022. The company is recognized for offering a positive and entrepreneurial work environment and has received the “Happy at Work” and “Tech at Work” labels.

The role

We are looking for a Chief of Staff to the CEO to help drive the company’s strategic priorities and coordinate key cross-functional initiatives.

This role is suited to an early-career, high-potential professional who is structured, analytical and hands-on. You will work closely with the CEO and senior stakeholders across the company, helping translate priorities into action, improving execution and ensuring that key topics receive the appropriate level of attention and follow-up.

The ideal candidate will have an engineering or technical background, or a strong affinity for technology, and will be comfortable working with data, complex business topics and multiple stakeholders.

This is an opportunity to gain broad exposure to the company while contributing directly to strategic decision-making and operational execution.

Missions

  • Support the CEO in preparing strategic analyses, recommendations, presentations and decision-making materials.
  • Coordinate important cross-functional projects from planning through execution, ensuring clear objectives, ownership, timelines and next steps.
  • Track company priorities, deadlines, risks, dependencies and key decisions, escalating issues when appropriate.
  • Analyse business data and prepare dashboards, management reports and concise executive-level updates.
  • Prepare leadership meetings, structure agendas, document decisions, follow up on actions and ensure accountability.
  • Work closely with teams across the company to improve execution, information flow and alignment around strategic priorities.
  • Help synthesize complex technical and business topics into clear, actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders.

Your Profile

  • The successful candidate will be a high-potential professional with approximately 2–5 years of experience in technology, consulting, engineering, operations, product or project management.
  • A structured and analytical approach, with the ability to break down complex topics and identify practical solutions.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage several priorities in parallel.
  • A proactive, reliable and hands-on mindset, with a strong sense of ownership.
  • The discretion and maturity required to work closely with the CEO and senior stakeholders.
  • The ability to work independently while knowing when to seek input or escalate an issue.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence presenting information to senior audiences.
  • The ability to build effective working relationships with teams across the company.
  • An interest in technology, SaaS and the way technology can transform business processes.

Technical knowledge

  • Strong proficiency with spreadsheets and business data analysis. Familiar with AI tools.
  • Ability to build or maintain dashboards, management reports and performance tracking tools.
  • Comfortable working with business metrics, KPIs and operational reporting.
  • Experience coordinating projects, action plans, deadlines and cross-functional dependencies.
  • Ability to prepare clear presentations and executive-level documentation.
  • Comfortable understanding technical concepts and collaborating with technology, product or engineering teams.

Languages

  • Fluent in French and English is required.
  • German, Italian or Spanish would be a strong advantage.

Recruitment process

  • Interview with a member of the Talent Acquisition team — 30 to 45 minutes.
  • Interview with the CEO — approximately 45 minutes.
  • Case study or practical exercise related to the role.
  • Final interview.

DiliTrust is committed to diversity, inclusion and professional equality at all levels.

title: Applied AI, Forward Deployed Machine Learning Engineer - (Internship)
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Mistral.ai
description_html:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

 

As an Applied Engineering Intern, you will work closely with our Applied AI Engineering team to facilitate the adoption of Mistral AI products among customers and collaborate with them to address complex technical challenges. This role is based in Paris, with an internship duration of 6 months. We are open to CIFRE programs as a continuation after the internship.

 

What you will do

 

• Contribute to the deployment of state-of-the-art GenAI applications, driving technological transformation with our customers.

• Collaborate with researchers, AI engineers, and product engineers on complex customer projects.

• Work with the product and science team to continuously improve our product and model capabilities based on customer feedback.

 

How We Work in Applied AI

 

- We care about people and outputs.

- What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it

- Bureaucracy is where urgency goes to vanish. You talk to whoever you need to talk to. The best idea wins, whether it comes from a principal engineer or someone in their first week.

- Always ask why. The best solutions come from deep understanding, not from copying what worked before

- We say what we mean. Feedback is direct, timely, and given because we care.

- No politics. Low ego, high standards.

- We embrace an unstructured environment and find joy in it.

 

About you

 

• You are currently pursuing a degree in AI, data science, or a related field from a tier 1 engineering school or university.

• You have strong programming skills in Python.

• You are familiar with machine learning algorithms and natural language processing techniques.

• You hold basic understanding of MLOps and deploying machine learning use cases.

• You have good communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

 

Ideally you have:

• Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch.

• Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and Linux shell environment.

• Experience working in HPC Environments

• Publication record in AI or a related field

Location & work authorization: This internship is available only in France. Please apply only if you have the required work authorization to complete the internship in the relevant country for its full duration.

 

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

title: Senior/Staff Product Designer | JetBrains
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Hirehire
description_html:
About JetBrains Air

JetBrains has been building developer tools since 2000 — including IntelliJ IDEA, Kotlin, TeamCity, and more, now trusted by 15M+ developers at 287K companies worldwide. The company is 100% private, profitable, and driven by a single thesis: great tools make developers better.

Air is what JetBrains is building next: an agentic development environment where multiple AI agents run tasks in parallel while the developer stays in control. It’s a genuinely new kind of developer tool — spanning a native desktop app, an expanding web experience, and cloud-based automations. It’s the next frontier after IDEs: not just helping developers write code, but helping them orchestrate it.

The Air design team is two people now — and you’d be the third. Your primary focus will be the web surface and the automations sub-team: an emerging part of the product that is ready for dedicated design ownership, with a real opportunity to raise the bar and shape the experience from the ground up.

What you’ll be working on

  • Design the web interface for Air: team management, automation setup, and a results overview

  • Shape the design process for the automations sub-team, working directly with developers to establish review and handoff practices

  • Take features from ambiguous briefs to shipped interfaces

  • Contribute to the shared design system: add and maintain components in Figma as the product grows

  • Vibe-code and use AI for prototyping when it helps move ideas forward faster

  • Participate in cross-team demos and quarterly planning, bringing a design perspective to where Air should go next

What you need

  • 5+ years of product design experience, with great examples of delivering results that impact the business.

  • Ownership instinct. You see features through from design to production. Delivery is part of your definition of done.

  • Excellent cross-team project delivery. You can work with limited context, clarify what matters, define the scope, and move projects forward across teams without needing constant hand-holding.

  • Active AI user. You use AI tools in your design workflow. You’ve experimented with building or prototyping with Cursor, Claude, or similar. This market moves weekly; you should too.

  • Solid Figma skills. Proficient with components, tokens/variables, and design systems — you can navigate an existing UI kit, understand how it works, and contribute new components as the product grows.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with developer-focused products or technical tooling (IDEs, dashboards, data tools)

  • Experience with vibe-coding, design engineering, or code-level prototypes

  • Familiarity with agentic or AI-native interface patterns — trust signals, human-in-the-loop, error handling at scale

What you get

  • Rare product scope. Work on a product that could define the next generation of developer tooling — small team, direct impact, decisions that ship fast.

  • JetBrains’ culture. Engineering-first, quality-focused, 100% private. No VC pressure, no artificial growth targets.

  • Competitive compensation and benefits — location-dependent, with a full breakdown available on request.

title: Junior Product Owner
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Erasys
description_html:
Your journey

ROMEO is the queer company behind the legendary ROMEO dating app, one of Europe’s longest-standing dating platforms for queer communities. We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Product team in Berlin and help shape how ideas and product requirements make their way into the hands of millions of users.

In this delivery-focused role, you will work closely with Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA and BI to turn product priorities into clear, actionable work for our development teams. It is a great opportunity to grow your product skills while taking real ownership of the day-to-day delivery process.


Your typical day

  • Support the Product Management team in refining product requirements and translating approved PRDs into implementation-ready epics, user stories and tickets.
  • Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria and are sufficiently refined before entering development.
  • Maintain and order the backlog according to priorities set by product leadership.
  • Take part in regular and ad hoc meetings to clarify product requirements with development, design and other delivery teams.
  • Support our two-week delivery cycle by ensuring development teams have the information and decisions they need to proceed.
  • Identify missing requirements, dependencies, open decisions and blockers early, and escalate them to Product or Delivery.
  • Work closely with QA to communicate product and release priorities, clarify acceptance criteria, and support defect triage and release-readiness decisions.
  • Support product acceptance and release readiness by checking delivered functionality against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Support the BI team by translating product questions, KPIs and tracking needs into clear data requirements.
  • Ensure agreed analytics requirements are captured as part of delivery, including relevant event tracking before work is considered complete.
  • Maintain clear and up-to-date product documentation in Jira and Confluence.


We look for

  • You are passionate about building products for LGBTQ+ communities and interested in contributing to the continued development of ROMEO.
  • You have initial experience in a Product Owner or similar product delivery role, ideally in a B2C environment. Experience in social, dating or community products is a plus. Being familiar with how our product works is a plus.
  • You have experience writing or refining user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • You have a good understanding of Agile product development and ideally hands-on experience with Scrum and/or Kanban.
  • You are comfortable working with Jira and Confluence. Experience with Xray is a plus.
  • You are organised, detail-oriented and reliable in following work through to completion.
  • You proactively follow up on missing information and drive requirements towards clarity.
  • You are based in Berlin or willing to relocate and are happy to work from our Wittenbergplatz office at least three days per week.
  • You have excellent written and spoken English skills, ideally at a native or near-native level.


What We Offer

  • A hands-on role working on an established European digital product during a significant phase of product and technology transformation.
  • Close collaboration with Product, Design, Engineering, QA and BI,
  • Hybrid working (3 days per week in our Berlin office at Wittenbergplatz)
  • €40 employer contribution towards the Germany Job Ticket
  • EGYM Wellpass (only €20/month employee contribution)
  • In-house German classes
  • Annual learning budget (e.g. for conferences, courses, certifications)
  • International team, English-speaking environment

title: Développeur C# confirmé H/F - ASP.NET / React
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Valsoft Corp
description_html:
À propos de nous

E-finances est un éditeur de logiciels B2B spécialisé dans les solutions de gestion financière et de trésorerie. Nos solutions permettent aux entreprises d'optimiser la gestion de leurs flux financiers, d'améliorer leur visibilité sur leur trésorerie et de renforcer leur performance financière.

Nous sommes en pleine phase de modernisation : refonte technique de nos produits historiques, lancement de nouvelles fonctionnalités, montée en puissance de nos stacks. C'est le bon moment pour rejoindre l'aventure et laisser une vraie empreinte sur ce que nous construisons.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Un vrai rôle de bâtisseur. Vous n'arrivez pas sur un projet figé : vous participez activement à la refonte de nos applications et à la définition de la manière dont elles doivent évoluer. Vos idées et votre esprit d'initiative sont attendus, pas seulement votre code.
  • De l'autonomie et de la confiance. Vous travaillez en petite équipe soudée (un Lead Tech, trois développeurs, un Product Owner), avec la liberté d'organiser votre travail et de proposer vos propres solutions techniques.
  • Des perspectives d'évolution concrètes. En rejoignant une équipe en croissance sur un produit stratégique, vous avez l'opportunité de faire grandir vos responsabilités techniques (architecture, mentorat, choix technologiques) au fil du temps.
  • De la flexibilité. Organisation de travail flexible et équilibre vie pro / vie perso respecté, dans un environnement où l'on juge sur les résultats plutôt que sur la présence.
  • Des sujets qui comptent. Modernisation d'un legacy réel (.NET Framework 3.5/4.8 vers .NET 8), dette technique à réduire, nouveaux features à concevoir de zéro : de quoi élargir votre expertise technique en continu.
  • Un process rapide et direct. un premier échange avec notre Lead Tech (en visio), puis une case study en présentiel avec la Directrice d'E-finances.

Vos missions

  • Développer :  concevoir, développer, tester et maintenir des applications en C#.
  • Moderniser :  participer activement à la refonte technique de nos solutions et à la migration vers les technologies récentes.
  • Réduire la dette technique :  contribuer à l'amélioration continue de notre codebase et proposer des solutions.
  • Collaborer en agilité :  participer aux rituels agiles (sprints, daily stand-ups, weekly meetings) au sein d'une équipe où la communication est directe et fluide.
  • Garantir la qualité :  assurer la qualité du code via des tests unitaires et les bonnes pratiques de développement.

Compétences principales requises

  • C# :  minimum 4 ans d'expérience.
  • .NET Framework 3.5 / 4.8 à .NET 8 :  maîtrise de ces technologies.
  • ASP.NET (Razor et jQuery) ou React :  expertise dans l'une de ces stacks.
  • SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle :  maîtrise de SQL et expérience avec au moins l'un des trois SGBD.
  • Git :  gestion des versions avec Git, Pull Requests et Code Review.
  • Tests unitaires :  expérience avec les TU pour garantir la qualité du code.
  • Agilité :  connaissance des pratiques agiles et des méthodologies associées.
  • CI/CD.

Profil recherché

  • Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en développement.
  • Basé(e) à moins d'une heure de Nantes.
  • Français et anglais courants.
  • Esprit d'initiative et mentalité « doer » :  à l'aise pour proposer, tester et itérer plutôt qu'attendre des consignes.
  • Adaptabilité :  capacité à monter rapidement en compétence sur de nouvelles technologies et à comprendre les enjeux métier.
  • Autonomie et goût du collectif :  capable de travailler aussi bien seul qu'en équipe.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et en résolution de problèmes.

title: Associate Director, Integrated Marketing - Pilotage Stratégique du Marché France
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Inautalent
description_html:
Inautalent recrute, pour le compte d'un de ses clients — un acteur international du secteur des applications lifestyle et relationnelles, en croissance active sur le marché français — un(e) Associate Director, Integrated Marketing, en charge du pilotage stratégique du marché France.

Le défi : ce poste consiste à identifier soi-même les enjeux et opportunités du marché français, puis à construire et exécuter la stratégie qui en découle — de bout en bout. Le poste est pensé pour quelqu'un qui est à l'aise pour opérer sans une large équipe, en portant plusieurs casquettes, et pour qui la construction d'une stratégie compte autant que sa mise en œuvre concrète sur le terrain.

Requirements

Le poste, en synthèse :

  • Piloter le marché France de bout en bout : diagnostic des enjeux et opportunités, construction de la stratégie, exécution.
  • Déterminer le marketing mix et faire des recommandations stratégiques sur le mix média payant.
  • Piloter la collaboration quotidienne avec l'agence média, garantir l'alignement stratégique et l'optimisation continue des canaux payants.
  • Construire des plans marketing intégrés multicanaux (média, influence, RP, partenariats), de la rédaction du brief à l'analyse de performance.
  • Communiquer régulièrement les enjeux du marché, la stratégie et les résultats à la direction et aux parties prenantes transverses.
  • Adapter les apprentissages globaux au marché français, et remonter les enseignements locaux à l'organisation globale.

Profil recherché :

  • Solide expérience en leadership, avec une capacité démontrée à superviser des responsables de canaux (channel leads) et à porter une stratégie globale cohérente.
  • 8 à 10 ans d'expérience en marketing de marque, marketing intégré ou marketing stratégique, idéalement dans la tech grand public, le lifestyle ou des marques à forte identité culturelle.
  • Expérience en marketing et/ou média avec une expertise approfondie et une réelle compréhension du marché français.
  • Expérience avérée de pilotage autonome d'un marché, du diagnostic des enjeux jusqu'à l'exécution.
  • Expérience avérée du lancement de campagnes multicanales générant à la fois de la connexion émotionnelle et des résultats mesurables.
  • Bonne compréhension du paysage média, des canaux et de la mesure de performance.
  • Solides compétences analytiques, avec une utilisation démontrée de la donnée et des indicateurs pour mesurer l'impact des actions et ajuster la stratégie en conséquence.
  • Expérience dans la gestion de partenariats avec des célébrités, talents, influenceurs ou créateurs de contenu, y compris la gestion de relations avec des agences, est un plus.
  • À l'aise pour opérer sans une large équipe, en portant plusieurs casquettes, de façon autonome.
  • Français natif ou bilingue, anglais courant indispensable.

Benefits

Conditions : France, full remote — Rémunération : 100 000 € à 111 000 € brut/an — Prise de poste : 1er octobre.

title: Staff Software Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Aircall
description_html:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

We are looking for an engaged and passionate Staff Engineer to join our growing engineering department and be a technical leader across our engineering teams.
 
As a Staff Engineer, you will be responsible for driving influence across teams and domains, leading solution delivery on cross-functional and strategic initiatives, and serving as a technical leader within the engineering organization. You will ensure the set quality standards and drive the adoption of best practices in architecture, security, and DevOps.
 
Quality, excellence, and agility drive our delivery processes and you will help us level these up. Using NodeJS and Typescript back-end stacks, appropriate for each requirement, but always hosted on AWS, we build added value and resilient services on top of voice and fully integrate with our customers’ business critical tools (CRM, Helpdesk, E-Commerce, …).
 

Your mission @ Aircall:
  • Lead transversal, complex projects, fully autonomously from ideation to completion, starting from a high-level problem statement.
  • Proactively communicate the technical vision across multiple teams, ensuring alignment and sharing knowledge across domains.
  • Act as a go-to expert, providing mentorship and guidance across teams.
  • Deeply understand multiple product domains; proactively identify improvements and advocate for customer needs across the company.
  • Lead and define technical strategies for complex, impactful problems.
  • Set and uphold higher quality standards and drive adoption of best practices in architecture, security, and DevOps.
  • Writes production-ready code, finding appropriate solutions for medium complexity challenges; participates in software design discussions; demonstrates a good understanding of system infrastructure and DevOps principles; contributes to performance and quality within their scope; applies a security-first mindset.
    •  

    A little about you:
  • A little about you:You have extensive experience (e.g., 10+ years) in back-end development, using TypeScript & NodeJS/Python/Ruby/Rails or other languages, with a focus on delivering for security, scalability, availability, and performance across multiple domains.
  • You lead and define technical strategies, demonstrating a strong understanding of system design to solve complex, impactful problems.
  • You are comfortable leading the development of complex projects affecting multiple teams and domains, driving initiatives from ideation to completion.
  • You are an expert at identifying opportunities for new impactful initiatives.
  • You have a deep understanding of multiple product domains and can anticipate long-term needs.
  • You possess effective and proactive communication skills, and can collaborate with different profiles and roles to ensure cross-domain alignment.

    • Our Tech Stack:
  • You do not need to be familiar with all of our technical stack or any specific functional area, but you have a strong willingness to learn and adapt quickly.
  • Typescript/Node.js, Python, REST API/GraphQL APIs, Ruby/Rails, React AWS/Serverless or EKS, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, Redis
    • Why join us?

    🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities
    💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall
    📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit
    🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset
    💶 Competitive salary package & benefits

    DE&I Statement: 
    At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion – irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations – are core to our journey. 

    We pride ourselves on promoting active inclusion within our business to foster a strong sense of belonging for all. We’re working to create a place filled with diverse people who can enrich and learn from one another. We’re committed to ensuring that everyone not only has a seat at the table but is valued and respected at it by providing equal opportunities to develop and thrive.  

    We will constantly challenge ourselves to make sure that we live up to our ambitions around diversity, equity and inclusion, and keep this conversation open. Above all else, we understand and acknowledge that we have work to do and much to learn.

  • Deliver analytics and insights across the full EMEA GTM funnel (BDR, AE, PAM, AM, SE, CE, FDE), translating data into clear, actionable recommendations

  • Lead process improvement initiatives that increase seller productivity, pipeline health, and forecast accuracy

  • Partner with the Global RevOps Center of Excellence, providing regional inputs and adopting standardized best practices, tooling, and methodologies

  • Drive annual planning for EMEA, including territory design, segmentation, and capacity/headcount modeling

  • Strong communication and storytelling skills; able to turn complex data into a clear executive narrative
